Play All site reports → 09 · questions What buyers ask us first How many villas are there, and what sizes?
+ Seventy-five private villas in one to four bedrooms, plus a Luxury villa — interiors run from fifty-one to two hundred and seventy-two square metres, each with its own private pool.
What is the architectural style?
+ Japandi — Japanese wabi-sabi combined with Scandinavian minimalism — inside a fully pedestrian, gated ecosystem designed for calm.
Is Aravita for short stays or for living?
+ It is designed for conscious long-term stays, from a month upward, with amenities to support living rather than a quick holiday.
What technology is built into the villas?
+ Automated door systems, adjustable kitchen-glass tinting and ABB electrical systems assembled and tested in HQC’s own MEP laboratory.
What does the lease structure mean for me?

Solana Village es un nuevo proyecto de apartamentos, el mayor que Taylor Wimpey España ha diseñado para complementar su oferta inmobiliaria en La Cala Golf Resort junto a Harmony y Natura.

El residencial se desarrolla en la cima de la colina que domina el Campo de golf Europa, con una posición predominante que le proporciona unas vistas panorámicas al golf y algunas viviendas también al mar.
Todos los apartamentos disfrutan de una orientación predominantemente Este o Sur – Suroeste con lo que se beneficia de una luminosidad permanente todo el día.

Solana Village se encuentra próximo a la Casa Club y al Hotel & Spa, donde los propietarios de los proyectos de Taylor Wimpey en el Resort se benefician de ofertas y descuentos EXCLUSIVOS, que les ofrece la Privilege Card: Solana Village viene a completar la gama de apartamentos y adosados existentes en La Cala Golf Resort.
Ideal para familias que buscan una vivienda de vacaciones o inversores que buscan rentabilidad para la explotación de alquiler de temporada.
El proyecto se reparte en dos parcelas con 105 y 90 apartamentos cada una, integrados en un mismo concepto arquitectónico.
Los apartamentos están situados en primera línea de golf y muy próximos al hotel y al Club de Golf, así como de las instalaciones deportivas y Spa.

Todos los apartamentos disfrutan de grandes terrazas con barandilla de cristal para disfrutar de las increíbles vistas al golf y los bajos disponen tienen vistas a los jardines del resort y al campo de golf que le rodea.
Las viviendas tienen una distribución moderna bajo el concepto “total living” donde se aprovecha al máximo los espacios, con un gran salón que se integra en la terraza a través de amplios ventanales.

Las viviendas vienen equipadas de serie, con armarios acabados, aire acondicionado, cocina amueblada con electrodomésticos, paquete de luces led instaladas y baños totalmente equipados con mueble, espejo y mampara.
Además, se ofrece un pack de extras para la personalización de la vivienda.
El residencial es una urbanización cerrada con diferentes opciones de aparcamiento: exterior e interior.
Y además, tiene una piscina de adultos, e infantil de chapoteo con jardines comunitarios con vistas al valle.
Solana Village P (Parking exterior): 2 dormitorios desde 80,5 m 2 y 3 dormitorios desde 101,9 m 2 Parking exterior.

La Cala Resort es reconocida como uno de los mejores complejos de golf del sur de Europa.

Situado en un entorno único, entre las montañas del bello Parque Natural de la Sierra de Mijas y el mar Mediterráneo, a tan sólo 10 minutos de las maravillosas playas de la Costa del Sol entre La Cala de Mijas y Fuengirola , 20 minutos de Marbella y a 30 minutos del Aeropuerto de Málaga , con acceso a través de la autovía A7 (N-340).

Su privilegiada situación le permite tener en un entorno de 30 Km las mejores zonas de ocio y diversión, las soleadas playas y los mejores campos de golf de la Costa del Sol Solana Village está ubicado junto al prestigioso campo Europa, a tan solo 1,5 Km de la Casa Club.
Desde el nuevo complejo, los nuevos propietarios podrán disfrutar de las vistas panorámicas al campo de golf, el mar y las montañas.
La Cala Resort ofrece múltiples actividades de ocio.
El más grande resort de Golf de España cuenta con 60 hoyos, distribuidos en 3 campos de Golf de 18 hoyos y una Academia de Golf de 6 hoyos, par 3.
Dispone instalaciones deportivas: pistas de tenis, campo de futbol profesional, sala de fitness, “leisure center”, Spa, dos restaurantes exclusivos, una bodega y un emblemático hotel de 4 estrellas.
Este complejo residencial está situado muy cerca de los puertos deportivos de Benalmádena y Puerto Banús en Marbella .
Los residentes pueden escoger entre distintas zonas de ocio, y una gran variedad de establecimientos de restauración existentes en La Cala de Mijas, Fuengirola, o Marbella .

Desde la nueva promoción de Solana Village , podrá visitar los pueblos andaluces de la zona: Mijas con sus maravillosas vistas y estrechas calles, Fuengirola con sus más de 7 kilómetros de playa y el Castillo Sohail, Ronda y su espectacular Tajo.

Un residencial en el entorno de Doña Julia Golf, donde paisaje y bienestar marcan el día a día.
En ABRIL, el entorno y las zonas comunes definen una experiencia residencial pensada para disfrutar del exterior, el deporte y la tranquilidad en la Costa del Sol.
Disfruta de: • Piscina infinity con playa.
• Gimnasio y spa.
• Espacio zen y zona de calistenia.
• Mirador con vistas al golf y al mar.
• Zonas comunes ajardinadas.
La promoción cuenta con 65 viviendas de 2 y 3 dormitorios, todas con aparcamiento y trastero.
Entre sus tipologías se incluyen bajos con jardín y áticos con amplias terrazas, diseñados para aprovechar las vistas abiertas al mar y al paisaje natural que rodea el conjunto.

Ubicada en Casares, en el entorno de Doña Julia Golf, ABRIL se sitúa en una zona que combina proximidad a la playa, oferta deportiva y servicios, en un enclave que invita a una vida activa al aire libre.
En línea con su compromiso con la sostenibilidad, ABRIL se certificará bajo los estándares del Sello VERDE y el Compromiso Domum de Calidad, Sostenibilidad y Salud de Metrovacesa.

Inquire Now 2 Bed 2 Bath 807 Floor Area (SQFT) Share Property Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share by Email Property Details Features Additional Information Location: Tamarindo, Costa Rica Great opportunity to invest in Costa Rica and purchase a NEW Condo!
Two and three-bedroom units – some with lofts – are being offered at competitive prices.
Located just a short 6-minute drive to the famous beach towns of Tamarindo and Langosta and within 15 minutes to the surfing destinations of Playa Avellanas and Playa Negra.
Pre-Sale offered now with only $5000.00 to reserve.
Payments are advanced as each phase of the build is completed with final payment made upon completion of the unit.
This upscale condo development is currently located within a thriving condominium gated community in Villa Real – with 24/7 security on premises.
The entire complex is enclosed with high aesthetically designed walls accented with mature garden landscaping.
The Clubhouse and entertainment area is already in place.

It boasts a large entertainment area with an outdoor kitchen and a resort size pool all surrounded by a well-maintained tropical landscape – perfect for entertaining family, friends and business associates.
There will be a total of three towers built with each tower consisting of 3 floors with 4 units to each floor – totaling 12 units per building.
The first phase/tower was completed in April 2023.
Delivery of the building C is planned at the latest for first quarter of 2026.
Each unit has its own private balcony.
Views vary depending on the level of the unit.
Top level has breathtaking views of the mountains and surrounding land while mid and floor levels will have views of the gardens and pool area.
Interior design packages will be offered to make the unit – turnkey – ready to move in or use as a rental property.
Sizes of the condos will range from 75 m2 up to 107 m2 – with floor plans that present plenty of room to spread out and allow ample room to entertain.

The main living area extends through sliding glass doors to a covered terrace – giving an additional space – overlooking gardens with exotic flora and fauna that takes advantage of the natural lighting and spectacular sunsets.
Each unit will include private off-street parking immediately next to their corresponding tower.

In summary - the units are priced competitively to ensure a good return on your investment and are part of a community strategically designed and placed to take advantage of easy access to several beaches along the Gold Coast – all the while being convenient to shopping, schools and medical facilities.
Because of its location adjacent to a main thoroughfare, you can be in Santa Cruz or Liberia (Airport) within 45 minutes.
And, if golfing is your passion, there is a professional golf course just 5 minutes away at the Luxury Hacienda Pinilla complex.
HOA fees – $300/month – include 24/7 Security, landscaping of immediate and surrounding property, pool maintenance and water.

Courtesy of Okan Tower.
The 70-story Okan Tower condominium project in downtown Miami has received its master construction permit, a significant step in its development.

The permit allows work to begin on all interior and mechanical systems, such as plumbing, HVAC, electrical, elevators and life safety, which marks the final step before full vertical completion and interior buildout.
So far, the builder, Okan Construction LLC, has reached the 30th floor of vertical construction, with the 50th floor expected by the end of the year.
The team is currently working on the hotel mezzanine level on the 30th floor and is erecting about one floor per week.
The building is projected to top off in 2026 and open to residents and guests in 2027.
“With this permit in hand, we now have the green light to complete every element of the building,” Okan Group Chairman Bekir Okan said.

“It’s a defining step that moves us from structure to experience — bringing to life the Hilton hotel, luxury residences, office space and amenities that will make Okan Tower a destination in itself.” The Hilton Miami Bayfront Hotel, which spans floors 14 through 30, is now structurally completed.

Besides the hotel, Okan Tower will include 236 condo -hotel units managed by Hilton Hotels & Resorts, 163 luxury Sky Residences, almost 68,000 square feet of class A office space and more than 80,000 square feet of amenities.
All amenity spaces — excluding the rooftop pool — have been completed.
Fortune Development Sales is handling marketing for the residences.

Dự án hoàn thiện đúng thời điểm thị trường căn hộ ven sông Hàn bước vào giai đoạn sôi động.
Các căn hộ The Ponte bắt đầu bàn giao từ tháng 3/2026, hiện đang trong giai đoạn hoàn thiện nội thất.
Sở hữu vị trí đắc địa sát sông Hàn, được ví như “Tọa độ ngắm cầu Rồng đẹp nhất Đà Thành”, ngay từ thời điểm mở bán, dự án đã nhanh chóng thu hút sự quan tâm lớn từ thị trường.
Dự kiến chỉ trong một đến hai tháng tới, khi những cư dân đầu tiên chính thức chuyển về sinh sống, Sun Ponte Residence sẽ ngày càng sôi động và giàu sức sống.
Đây cũng được coi là “cứ điểm” mới của thị trường căn hộ cho thuê thời gian tới tại Đà Nẵng.
Nhìn từ xa, tháp đôi The Ponte nổi bật với kiến trúc như một “cây cầu trên không” bắc ngang bầu trời bên sông Hàn.
Hai tòa tháp được kết nối ở độ cao từ tầng 19 đến tầng 24, tạo nên một biểu tượng kiến trúc mới.
Thiết kế vừa gia tăng hiệu ứng thị giác vừa giúp tối ưu mọi góc nhìn từ ban công căn hộ.
Tổ hợp căn hộ phát triển theo tiêu chuẩn cao cấp, hội đủ “DNA Sun Group” về chất lượng - đẳng cấp - khác biệt.
Sảnh đón sang trọng như khách sạn 5 sao với thiết kế rộng thoáng, ánh sáng hài hòa và cách bài trí tinh tế.

Phân khu The Ponte cũng được bố trí hệ thống tiện ích cao cấp ngay nội khu, đảm bảo đầy đủ tiện nghi cho cư dân tương lai như: khu vui chơi trẻ em, khu sinh hoạt cộng đồng, sân vườn, nhà hàng, cafe, bể bơi vô cực hướng sông… Sau thời gian dài khan hiếm nguồn cung, sự xuất hiện của các dự án căn hộ hoàn thiện ngay tại trung tâm Đà Nẵng đang góp phần khuấy động thị trường căn hộ cho thuê, đặc biệt tại những vị trí sát sông Hàn, thuận tiện kết nối đi muôn nơi.
Tỷ suất cho thuê căn hộ tại Đà Nẵng hiện duy trì quanh mức 8-9%, thuộc nhóm cao nhất nước, vượt xa mặt bằng phổ biến 2-3% tại Hà Nội và TP.HCM.
Nhóm khách thuê phổ biến là khách du lịch, chuyên gia, doanh nhân quốc tế đang làm việc và sinh sống tại Đà Nẵng.
Thực tế, một căn hộ 2PN có diện tích gần 90m² thuộc tòa The Panoma (dự án Sun Cosmo Residence gần cầu Trần Thị Lý), mới bàn giao khoảng 6 tháng trước, hiện được cho thuê ở mức 42 triệu đồng/tháng.

Lý giải về lựa chọn “an cư như nghỉ dưỡng” ngay sát sông Hàn, anh Châu Ngô - khách thuê Việt kiều Úc chia sẻ, nhóm khách quốc tế không chỉ nhìn vào vị trí của dự án mà còn quan tâm hệ tiện ích và cộng đồng cư dân xung quanh.
“Chúng tôi sẵn sàng trả thêm 20-30% chi phí để đổi lại sự an tâm và một không gian sống văn minh, đẳng cấp”, anh Châu Ngô chia sẻ.
Kỳ nghỉ lễ Giỗ Tổ và 30/4 - 1/5 vừa qua, Đà Nẵng tiếp tục khẳng định vị thế dẫn đầu cả nước khi đón tới 1,46 triệu lượt khách (tăng 35%), trong đó khách quốc tế đạt 621.000 lượt (tăng 24%).
Mức tăng trưởng ấn tượng của ngành du lịch được xem là “bệ đỡ” quan trọng thúc đẩy thị trường căn hộ tại Đà Nẵng tăng tốc mạnh mẽ.
Các sản phẩm mới ra mắt thị trường cũng ghi nhận tỷ lệ hấp thụ tích cực.
Đơn cử, tháp căn hộ Symphony 5, mảnh ghép cuối cùng của quần thể Sun Symphony Residence, đang thu hút sự quan tâm lớn từ cả nhà đầu tư lẫn khách mua ở thực.
Được kiến tạo theo chuẩn sống nghỉ dưỡng bên sông Hàn, Symphony 5 sở hữu hệ tiện ích nội khu hoàn chỉnh với phòng gym, spa, hồ bơi phong cách resort, sân tập yoga và khu vườn tĩnh tại trên cao.

Cộng hưởng cùng không gian sinh thái 19.000 m2 kế cận - quy tụ bộ ba công viên trung tâm, công viên ven sông và công viên thể thao, tòa tháp kiến tạo một chốn an cư cân bằng, nơi mỗi ngày trôi qua đều là một kỳ nghỉ dưỡng đích thực cho cả gia đình.
Symphony 5 còn kế thừa vị trí đắc địa của quần thể Sun Symphony Residence tại trục đường Hồ Hán Thương - Lê Văn Duyệt, giúp cư dân dễ dàng kết nối đến các tiện ích công cộng.

Từ dự án, cư dân chỉ mất khoảng 3km để tiếp cận bãi biển Mân Thái, khoảng 5km đến Da Nang Downtown - tổ hợp vui chơi giải trí biểu tượng và khoảng 7km tới sân bay quốc tế, mở ra lợi thế lớn cả về trải nghiệm sống lẫn tiềm năng khai thác lưu trú, cho thuê.
Sức hấp dẫn của Symphony 5 còn được củng cố bởi tiến độ thi công ấn tượng của quần thể Sun Symphony Residence.
Chỉ sau khoảng 2 năm ra mắt thị trường, các tòa S1, S2, S3 đã lần lượt tiến hành bàn giao cho khách hàng ngay từ tháng 5/2026.
Vì vậy, dù ra mắt sau, Symphony 5 lại sở hữu lợi thế lớn khi nằm trong một hệ sinh thái đã hình thành từ sớm, với cộng đồng cư dân đông đúc, tiện ích vận hành hoàn chỉnh và nhịp sống sôi động.

Đáng chú ý, ngay sau khi nhận bàn giao, cư dân các tòa căn hộ dọc theo sông Hàn như Sun Symphony Residence, Sun Cosmo Residence hay Sun Ponte Residence đều sở hữu “tấm vé VVIP” để thưởng ngoạn trọn vẹn Lễ hội Pháo hoa Quốc tế Đà Nẵng 2026 ngay từ ban công căn hộ.

Đây được xem là “bảo chứng” cho khả năng khai thác cho thuê và tiềm năng sinh lời bền vững, khi khu vực sông Hàn luôn là tâm điểm của những sự kiện, lễ hội quốc tế đẳng cấp và dòng khách du lịch đông đúc quanh năm.

Cover Story: Playing the long game at Forest City Tuesday 03 Nov 2026 BURSA SGX Home City & Country Make The Edge Malaysia your preferred source on Google This article first appeared in City & Country, The Edge Malaysia Weekly on September 28, 2026 - October 4, 2026 It was a scorching afternoon when Country Garden Pacificview Sdn Bhd (CGPV) executive director and chief of regional industrial business development Kevin Li and regional vice-president Syarul Izam Sarifudin arrived at The Edge ’s office in Petaling Jaya, Selangor.
The pair had flown in from Johor Bahru to give an update on Forest City, a high-profile project in Johor that has dealt with some hot issues since its inception.
“What we achieved [since 2015] up to 2025 was merely concentrating more on our operational stability, resource integration and preparing for our next phase of growth,” says Syarul.
“In the early years, we were primarily viewed as a residential real estate developer.

But we are now embarking into a new sector — managing townships and driving actual economic nodes of financial and industrial development in southern Johor.” The master developer of Forest City is a joint venture between China-headquartered developer Country Garden Holdings Co Ltd and Esplanade Danga 88 Sdn Bhd.

Operating as an independent local management unit under Country Garden Malaysia’s executive umbrella, CGPV is responsible for Forest City’s master plan development and management, industrial park development and Special Financial Zone (SFZ) operation.

Officially launched by the Malaysian government with duty-free island status in 2016, the 7,500-acre integrated development covers four reclaimed man-made islands over 5,000 acres and 2,500 acres on the mainland.
Located in Iskandar Puteri, it sits along the Straits of Johor near the Malaysia-Singapore Second Link, just 2km across the water from Singapore.

The ambitious development has made international headlines over the years, some of them for the wrong reasons, especially since it has fallen short of market expectations in terms of progress, sales and occupancy rates.
These challenges were compounded by the Covid-19 pandemic and the well-documented financial restructuring of its parent company amid China’s broader real estate liquidity crisis.

“When China’s property market faced a systemic downturn, amplified by global supply chain disruptions, macroeconomic shifts and strict pandemic controls, Country Garden — once China’s top property developer — was caught in the crossfire, just like many other big players in the country.
However, late last year, our parent group successfully executed onshore and offshore debt restructurings in China,” says Li, who is also the chief financial officer of Country Garden Malaysia.
Li: We will advance commercial and industrial land development earlier than originally scheduled to inject immediate economic vibrancy.
Our next focus is to bring in companies and industries to invest or establish their presence here.
(Photo by Low Yen Yeing/The Edge) Regardless of the situation faced by its parent company, he highlights that Country Garden Malaysia operates with complete operational and financial independence.
“Since Country Garden entered Malaysia as its first overseas destination back in 2010 and 2011, the local operation has relied on an independent management team.

For the past three years, our cash flow has been generated entirely within the country, allowing us to remain self-sustaining in terms of liquidity and debt servicing,” he says, adding that all five of its projects in the Klang Valley and Johor are performing steadily.
According to Li, Country Garden Malaysia’s sales and cash collection was RM1.3 billion in 2023, more than RM1.1 billion in 2024, and RM1.3 billion in 2025.

“More crucially, we utilised our local cash flows to fully settle bank borrowings and capital market obligations worth about RM2 billion over the past three years, including a RM1 billion sukuk … As at earlier this year, the remaining outstanding amount [of the sukuk] was only RM150 million.

We pre-repaid them as our cash flow was comfortable.” With most of its debts cleared, local rating agency RAM upgraded Country Garden Malaysia’s outlook rating from negative to stable in March, reflecting its balance-sheet resilience despite global sector volatility.
That financial stability has been supported by developments on the legal front.
Malaysian courts have recently upheld the validity of sales and purchase agreements in favour of the developer.

Dismissing buyer suits seeking to void contracts for reasons such as media portrayals of the project as a “ghost town”, the courts established that market downturns and post-purchase regret do not constitute grounds for breach.
The decisions shield CGPV against speculative contract cancellations and protect its revenue base.
“Forest City has completed 26,000 residential units so far.
We understand that we cannot make every single person happy, and it is normal to receive feedback or complaints.
We respect the buyers’ legal rights,” Li says.
“But we also have our internal KPIs [key performance indicators] to meet.
We are pleased to share that customer satisfaction consistently hits above 95% in our surveys and polls.
Generally, the majority of our 20,000 residents are happy to live here, or they wouldn’t choose to continue staying.

This is evidenced by our growing population.” Aerial view of Forest City at night (Photo by Country Garden Malaysia) A city waking up Today, Forest City is home to around 20,000 people living in 66 completed blocks, over 770 acres of the approved 5,000-acre reclaimed island land bank.
“If you pass by from Iskandar Puteri towards Batam, you can see the lights on across the residential towers at night,” Syarul says.
“It is a night-and-day difference compared with what people experienced immediately after the pandemic in early 2021.” Demographics have shifted significantly, he adds.

While buyers were once predominantly mainland Chinese, the current resident base is largely local Malaysians, many of whom commute daily to Singapore or work in nearby industrial parks, as well as expatriates of different nationalities.
“The township’s commercial pulse is also quickening,” says Syarul.

“The Fisherman’s Wharf commercial street has seen steady footfall, with duty-free shops, eateries and premier banking facilities, including branches of Maybank and CIMB, with Affin Bank and AmBank joining the fold soon.” Forest City attracts between 1.5 million and two million tourists annually.
Its crown jewel is Forest City Golf Resort, located on the mainland about 9km from the man-made islands.
Featuring two 18-hole international championship courses, it draws golfers from Japan, South Korea and Singapore.
There is also an affordable beachfront water park that offers weekend entertainment for visiting families.
“Forest City is probably the only sandy beach in Johor Bahru.
Otherwise, you have to go to Desaru, which is an hour away.
To draw more visitors, we are also collaborating with some watersports academies on courses for adults and children.
The beach and water park are very popular during school holidays and weekends, contributing to our growing annual tourist and visitor numbers,” Syarul says.
Meanwhile, Network School, a start-up society and experimental community based on Silicon Valley entrepreneur Balaji Srinivasan’s book The Network State, was set up in the township in October 2024.

The weekend crowd at the Fisherman’s Wharf commercial street (Photo by Country Garden Malaysia) Balaji’s private co-living and co-working hub at Marina Hotel drew hundreds of international digital nomads, crypto enthusiasts and tech workers.
However, in July 2026, the Iskandar Puteri City Council (MBIP) revoked the Network School operator’s business licence for breaching local licensing conditions.

The management of the school clarified that CGPV operates solely as a commercial landlord, and that the developer is fully cooperating with the local authorities to ensure all commercial tenants adhere to the regulatory framework.

Strategic shift Li says while Forest City’s master plan is unchanged, CGPV is shifting its focus towards commercial and industrial developments, in alignment with the government’s broader economic development plan for the state.
“We maintain the master plan as it is because, to us, it is still a very fantastic plan even after a decade.
Of course, for such a mega development, you have to do it in phases, and there will be small twists and adjustments in between.
But overall, we do not have plans to review the master plan.
Now, we are embarking on the third phase of development,” says Syarul.
The biggest “twists and adjustments” to the master plan were its integration into the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JS-SEZ) and designation as an SFZ.

In August 2023, the government announced that Forest City would be designated as an SFZ to boost foreign investment, with incentives such as a 15% income tax rate for skilled workers and lower business operating costs.

A year later, the government launched the tax incentive framework for the SFZ, which includes a zero tax rate for single family offices (SFO), a 5% corporate tax rate for fintech and global business services, and concessionary income tax rates.
In early 2025, Malaysia and Singapore signed a bilateral agreement to establish the JS-SEZ.
Under the agreement, Forest City was formally incorporated as Flagship G, one of nine primary flagship zones within the 3,505 sq km economic zone.
“We started [the master plan] with residential and, maybe, this made people misunderstand that Forest City is focusing on high-rise residential developments.
The SFZ designation puts us right back on track to [industrial projects],” says Li.
Syarul: Now, we are embarking on the third phase of development.

(Photo by Low Yen Yeing/The Edge) “Under the SFZ blueprint, the development is divided into two distinct functional zones, where the island component acts as a core financial services hub, focusing on single-family offices, fintech, foreign payment operating systems and back-office financial services.

Meanwhile, the mainland focuses on smart logistics, high-tech manufacturing and global business services.” To encourage direct investments in Forest City, the Malaysian government established the Iskandar Malaysia Facilitation Centre Johor (IMFC-J) at Forest City’s 42-storey primary office tower, Menara Delima Satu, to streamline the investment process.
The centre houses 18 government agencies under one roof and acts as a single processing point for foreign investors.
“A key cornerstone of the SFZ is attracting family offices.

The SC (Securities Commission) set an AUM (assets under management) threshold of RM30 million for family offices setting up in Forest City, a far more accessible entry point compared with Singapore’s S$15 million (RM47.9 million) requirement or Hong Kong’s HK$240 million (RM124.7 million) benchmark,” Li says.
Syarul stresses, however, that Malaysia is not competing with Singapore or Hong Kong in the SFO segment but is instead complementing them.
“It is about synergy.
Under the SFZ rules, family offices in Forest City can invest up to 90% of their AUM globally.

This means that investors can set up their operational base here in Forest City at one-third to one-fourth of the operational cost, while still leveraging Singapore’s capital markets just across the strait.
It is very attractive to many family offices,” he explains.

Under the SFO Incentive Scheme guidelines issued by the SC, it is mandatory to establish a physical office in Forest City to qualify for and maintain SC approval and the accompanying 0% tax incentive.
According to Li, over 40 SFOs have secured physi­cal office space in Forest City, with nine having formally received SC approval to date.
“We are very positive about this, though we do not have an actual target of having many of them in Forest City in the near future because it is beyond our control and SC has its plan.

But it is a strong catalyst in helping to add vibrancy to Forest City because when the offices come, they bring in their professional teams — accountants, lawyers and finance and investment experts,” he adds.
Forest City is also targeting global business services.

CGPV is in advanced discussions with two major international banking institutions — one looking to relocate its back-office operations from Singapore, and another expanding its operational footprint from Kuala Lumpur.

The 36-hole Forest City Golf Resort draws golfers from Japan, South Korea and Singapore (Photo by Country Garden Malaysia) Forest City 2.0 Despite the tailwinds from the SFZ, Li and Syarul acknowledge that transforming the mega project into a self-sustaining regional economy is not without immediate, real-world hurdles.
The most pressing challenge currently is cross-border physical connectivity and accessibility.
“While the project is geographically proximate to Singapore, seamlessly moving people, goods and daily commuters across borders remains a complex, multi-jurisdictional effort,” says Li.

“Furthermore, regional competition from peers like Thailand, Indonesia and Vietnam means that Malaysia must continually sharpen its execution speed and policy delivery to stay ahead.” To close this connectivity gap, Country Garden is taking interim measures while lobbying government authorities for long-term infrastructure approvals.
“Before all the major government infrastructure projects are completed, we are bridging the gap ourselves.
We currently run daily direct shuttles transferring residents and workers to the Sultan Abu Bakar CIQ Second Link complex,” Li says.
For the long term, the developer has submitted plans to the joint Malaysia-Singapore ministerial committee under the Iskandar Regional Development Authority (IRDA) for a dedicated ferry terminal.
Once approved, ferry routes will connect Forest City directly to Raffles Marina in Singapore and Batam in Indonesia.

“We are also asking the government for assistance to permit a direct highway connection linking straight to Tuas, and to integrate Forest City into upcoming regional rail routes like the RTS [Rapid Transit System], ART [Automated Rapid Transit] and transport corridors heading to Kulai and Senai,” he adds.

“Moving people efficiently is crucial to unlocking the full value of the JS-SEZ but because these are country-to-country matters, we have to keep pushing and following up continuously.” Simultaneously, the master developer is pivoting to boosting population density and creating high-value local jobs, away from traditional residential property sales, towards what the team calls “Forest City 2.0”.
“We are not launching any more residential projects in the near future, but focusing on clearing the inventory.
We will advance commercial and industrial land development earlier than originally scheduled to inject immediate economic vibrancy,” Li says.

“Our next focus is to bring in companies and industries to invest or establish their presence here.” CGPV has secured a 40-acre industrial land deal in Phase 1 of its 418-acre industrial zone in Forest City (Photo by Country Garden Malaysia) Acknowledging the importance of generating sufficient jobs to increase Forest City’s population, CGPV is actively trying to draw data centres, logistics players and manufacturers to its upcoming 418-acre industrial park.
“We need to create real economic dynamics.
If you don’t generate jobs and economic substance, you cannot sustain a population,” Li stresses.
The response to this industrial shift has been positive.

In the first half of this year alone, the developer logged over 300 company enquiries and secured a 40-acre industrial land deal with a manufacturer in Phase 1 of the industrial park, paving the way for ready-built factory developments in Phase 2 should market demand sustain.

In another strategic partnership, Country Garden recently signed a term sheet with Penang-based Oriental Holdings Bhd (KL: ORIENT ) to develop a RM750 million healthcare hub in Forest City, anchored by a 500-bed hospital alongside comprehensive medical supply chain services.
“Internationally, we are actively introducing Forest City to big-name [multinational corporations].
It is not so much for their name, but the entire supply chain.
We are looking to bring in ‘queen bee’ investors,” Li says.
“We have been doing roadshows, especially in China, to introduce the JS-SEZ and Forest City SFZ.

We went to Shenzhen and Suzhou, which have some of the most successful industrial parks in China.” Apart from the industrial park, CGPV has also received enquiries from international investors interested in private island parcels.
“It is something that we are looking at.
Instead of standard residential towers, we can custom-reclaim approved island plots, such as 1.5 to two acres, based entirely on an investor’s specific operational or residential requirements.
It’s about being adaptive to what the current market actually demands,” he says.

Country Garden Danga Bay in Johor Bahru is the only development that is 100% held by Country Garden Malaysia (Photo by Country Garden Malaysia) Road to 2030 and beyond Apart from Forest City, Country Garden Malaysia has four other major developments in Johor and the Klang Valley, executed largely through JVs.
“Out of our five projects in Malaysia, four are structured as JVs,” Li explains.
“Only Danga Bay is 100% held by Country Garden Malaysia.

We welcome JVs because local partners bring value to the table, though for master site design, we prefer to lead.” In Johor Bahru, Country Garden Central Park has completed three phases comprising over 3,000 residential units that are nearly fully sold.
The developer is now planning subsequent sub-phases over a 10- to 12-year development cycle.
In Kuala Lumpur, the initial two phases of township development Lake City in Taman Wahyu are completed and sold out, with Phase 3 scheduled for launch next year.
The remaining four parcels have been earmarked for development over a 15-year period.
In Semenyih, Selangor, residential development Diamond City launched its final landed parcel in September 2025, which is expected to wrap up construction within two years.
With a substantial land bank in its existing portfolio, the developer will focus its resources on executing its active pipeline over the next decade.
As the interview draws to a close, both Li and Syarul reflect on the long-term nature of master township development.
“Rome was not built in a day,” Li says.
“When we first came to this coastal area in Johor, it was completely rural.
Today, the infrastructure is firmly established.
Development never moves in a straight upward line; it moves in spirals, but it always moves forward.
“We wish the public to know that since the first day Country Garden has been here in Malaysia, we have wanted to be here long term.

Of course, there are twists and turns over the years, but we cannot deny the contribution of the company in Malaysia.” He says Country Garden has invested RM32 billion in Malaysia, including RM20 billion in Forest City alone.
“We have created jobs, contributed to the country’s tax revenues and trained local skilled workers.
Most importantly, after so many challenges and uncertainties, we were here, and we are still here today.
The fundamentals are in place, and we have absolute faith in what Forest City will become.” Save by subscribing to us for your print and/or digital copy.

The Chatt Huahin‑Pran - Project Overview The Chatt Huahin-Pran is a boutique pool villa development designed for those who value privacy, modern comfort, and convenient access to Hua Hin and Pranburi ’s beaches and lifestyle amenities.
Each villa sits on a generous land plot and features contemporary interiors paired with a tropical outdoor-living concept that enhances everyday relaxation and comfort.
This limited collection of 3- and 4-bedroom private pool villas includes 4×8 m pools, full turnkey furnishing, and high-quality finishes throughout.
With a serene coastal location and an expected completion in Q2/2027, the project is ideal for second homes, holiday rentals, or peaceful long-term living.
The Chatt Huahin‑Pran - Villa Types The 3-bedroom pool villa offers a well-balanced blend of comfort and functionality, featuring 3 bathrooms, a 4×8 m private pool, and a generous 117 sq.
wah land plot (approx.

With a 306.5 sq.m built area and full turnkey furnishing—including air-conditioning units, a built-in kitchen, TVs, and essential appliances—this villa provides a ready-to-live environment ideal for both residence and rental use.
The 4-bedroom pool villa delivers a more expansive living experience with 4 bathrooms, a larger 256 sq.
wah plot (approx.
1,024 sq.m), and a 332 sq.m built area.
It maintains the same 4×8 m private pool and complete furnishing package, offering ample space for families or those who prefer additional privacy and comfort.
Both villa types are available in freehold or leasehold ownership options.

Design, Lifestyle & Facilities At The Chatt Huahin‑Pran The Chatt Huahin-Pran embraces a modern tropical design with clean architectural lines, expansive glazing, and a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor spaces.
Natural stone and timber finishes create a warm, contemporary atmosphere, complemented by private landscaped courtyards that enhance both privacy and relaxation.
Every villa is delivered turnkey, ensuring a smooth move-in or immediate rental operation with thoughtfully selected interior packages.

Lifestyle features emphasize comfort, efficiency, and convenience, including four split-type air-conditioning units, LED lighting options, and provisions for solar panels to help reduce long-term utility costs.
Residents benefit from a free standard water meter installation, private 4×8 m pools, walled gardens, and spacious parking with EV-charger readiness.
Each villa also comes equipped with a built-in kitchen, modern appliances such as a refrigerator and dishwasher, and dedicated TV points—supporting a modern, effortless living experience.

Location & Nearby Amenities At The Chatt Huahin‑Pran The Chatt Huahin-Pran is positioned along the highly desirable Hua Hin–Pranburi coastal corridor, giving residents quick access to beaches, lifestyle hubs, and essential services.
This area is well-known for its relaxed coastal atmosphere, making it popular for both holiday stays and long-term living.
Surrounding the project are many key attractions and conveniences, including Hua Hin Beach (approx.
10–15 minutes), Pranburi Beach (approx.
8–10 minutes), and popular lifestyle spots such as Cicada Market and Tamarind Market (approx.
15–20 minutes).
Shopping and dining options like Bluport Mall (20 minutes), Tesco Lotus Pranburi (10 minutes), and local cafés are all within easy reach.
Healthcare access is also convenient, with Bangkok Hospital Hua Hin located around 20–25 minutes away.
Residents can enjoy nearby recreational areas such as Khao Tao Reservoir, Khao Kalok Beach, and scenic coastal viewpoints, all ideal for outdoor activities and weekend leisure.
Who is The Chatt Huahin-Pran for?

The Chatt Huahin-Pran is ideal for families seeking a private and spacious second home near the beach, lifestyle buyers looking for a turnkey low-maintenance villa with high privacy, and investors targeting strong holiday-rental demand in a stable coastal market.
It also suits both Thai and foreign buyers who want an upscale pool villa with flexible ownership options, including freehold for eligible buyers and leasehold alternatives for foreigners.

Use of Cookies Cookies are small text files that a website can write to your computer or other device.

They are widely used in order to make websites work or work more efficiently (such as remembering your preferences or recommending relevant content), as well as to provide information to the owners of the site.

The following is a summary of the types of cookies that are used on this site: Cookie Type Purpose Strictly Necessary Cookies These cookies are essential in order to enable you to move around the website and use its features, such as accessing secure areas of the website.
Without these cookies, services you have asked for, like payment services or account authorization, cannot be provided.
Performance Cookies These cookies collect information about how visitors use a website, for instance which pages visitors go to most often, and if they get error messages from web pages.
These cookies do not collect information that identifies a visitor.
All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous.
It is only used to improve how a website works.
Functionality Cookies These cookies allow the website to remember choices you made (such as your user name, language or the region you are in) and provide enhanced, more personal features.
These cookies can also be used to remember changes you have to parts of web pages that you can customize.
They may also be used to keep track of which notices you have already viewed to avoid repetition.
The information these cookies collect will not personally identify you and cannot track your browsing activity on other websites.
Targeting Cookies / Advertising Cookies These cookies are used to deliver advertisements more relevant to you and your interests.
They are also used to limit the number of times you see an advertisement as well as help to measure the effectiveness of the advertising campaigns.
They are usually placed by advertising networks with the website operator’s permission.
They remember that you have visited a website and this information is shared with other organizations such as advertisers.
Quite often targeting or advertising cookies will be linked to site functionality provided by the other organization.
For example, in our remarketing or retargeting campaigns, we will serve targeted ads to you after you have visited or taken action on our website.
In terms of technical execution, remarketing is the process of using a JavaScript tag to place a cookie in your browser.
The cookie then informs a remarketing platform to serve specific display ads through an ad exchange, based on the pages or products you have engaged with or searched for on our website or app.
How do I refuse my consent to the use of cookies?
If you do not want cookies to be stored on your device, you can adjust the setting of your browser to reject the setting of all or some cookies, and to alert you when a new cookie is added.
For further information about how to do so, please refer to your browser help documentation.
Please note that if you use your browser settings to block all cookies (including strictly necessary cookies) you may not be able to access or use all or parts or functionalities of our website.
If you want to remove previously-stored cookies, you can manually delete these cookies at any time.
However, this will not prevent the sites from placing further cookies on your device unless you adjust your browser setting as described above.

For more information on the development of user-profiles and the use of targeting and advertising cookies, please see www.youronlinechoices.eu if you are located in Europe, or if you are in the United States, www.aboutads.info/choices .
Most web browsers allow some control of most cookies through the browser settings.
Please check the browser which you normally use.

rujan 2025.
u 22:00 Foto: pd Nedavnim otvaranjem Molum Hotel and Residences, Sveti Filip i Jakov upisao se na kartu premium destinacija na hrvatskoj obali.

Taj novi resort, prvi takve kategorije u ovom dijelu srednje Dalmacije, donosi spoj suvremenog dizajna, mediteranske tradicije, personalizirane usluge i brojnih vrhunskih sadržaja, čineći ga savršenom destinacijom za sve goste željne spoja odmora, ali i luksuza.
Molum Hotel and Residences smješten je u jednom od najljepših dijelova Dalmacije, u blizini grada Zadra i brojnih atrakcija.
Smješten na više od 25.000 četvornih metara vanjskih površina i 12.000 četvornih metara zgrada, Molum obuhvaća šest elegantno oblikovanih objekata s ukupno 60 soba i 60 rezidencija.
Domaći gosti pri vrhu Riječ je o investiciji tvrtke Sunčani Resort, u vlasništvu obitelji Andabak, poznate po brojnim uspješnim hotelijerskim i turističkim projektima diljem Hrvatske.
U sklopu projekta, uskoro se otvara prva faza luke Molum Marine Club uz resort, a vlasnici se spremaju i za otvaranje druge faze za sljedeću sezonu, što će stvoriti još sadržaja za nautičare.
U razgovoru za Poslovni vikend direktor Moluma Dino Sokol otkriva nam kako je proteklo prvih nekoliko mjeseci rada tog luksuznog resorta.
“Za nas u Molum Hotel & Residences ovo je prva sezona i za nas ona još traje.
Gosti nam dolaze prema rezervacijama, borave i uživaju u našem resortu.
U sezonu smo ušli s jasnom vizijom – stvoriti prepoznatljivu destinaciju koja spaja visoku razinu usluge, suvremeni dizajn i osjećaj privatnosti i mira.
Ostvareni poslovni rezultati i broj noćenja potvrđuju da tržište pozitivno reagira na naš koncept te da postoji stvarna potreba za mirnijim luksuzom kakav nudimo.
Naš fokus ostaje na daljnjem razvoju brenda, kontinuiranom unapređenju usluge i stvaranju personaliziranog iskustva za svakog gosta”, rekao je za Poslovni vikend Dino Sokol.
Struktura gostiju je prilično koncentrirana na nekoliko tržišta.
Zanimljivo, u vrhu su – domaći gosti.
“Najviše gostiju dolazi nam iz Hrvatske, Njemačke, Austrije, Poljske i Velike Britanije.

Posebno nam je zadovoljstvo što značajan udio čine domaći turisti, jer želimo biti prepoznati i kao odredište za kvalitetan odmor unutar Hrvatske, ali i kao atraktivna destinacija za strane turiste koji traže mir, kvalitetu i vrhunsku uslugu”, otkriva Sokol.
Prilike za napredak Ovogodišnju turističku sezonu karakterizira nešto slabiji “nalet” gostiju u srpnju i kolovozu.
Sokol potvrđuje da su dijelom osjetili pad noćenja u određenim periodima tijekom visoke sezone.

kupnja Do 480 km dosega i prostran prtljažnik: upoznajte MGS5 EV Pametan potez Investicija koja ne traži velike uplate ni stalno planiranje: zlato možete stjecati automatski, iz mjeseca u mjesec “Kao novi resort nemamo podatke za usporedbu s prethodnim godinama, no povremeno smo zabilježili nešto slabiji ulaz rezervacija, što je u skladu s općim trendovima na tržištu.
Unatoč tome, personalizirani pristup i fokus na kvalitetu omogućili su nam da zadržimo dobru popunjenost kroz cijelu sezonu”, kaže Sokol.
Od posezone se, kao i u ostatku Hrvatske, u Molumu dosta očekuje, ako je suditi po početku rujna.
“Dolasci i rezervacije za rujan i listopad premašili su naša očekivanja.
Gosti prepoznaju prednosti odmora izvan vrhunca sezone – u mirnijem okruženju i uz vrhunsku razinu usluge.
Upravo na tome gradimo svoj brend: na kvaliteti, autentičnosti i stvaranju posebnog doživljaja za svakog gosta”, otkriva Sokol.
Dojam je da je Sveti Filip i Jakov, unatoč neprijepornim prirodnim ljepotama, desetljećima bio u svojevsrnoj turističkoj stagnaciji.
Nove investicije, međutim, mijenjaju tu sliku.
Što nedostaje destinaciji Sveti Filip i Jakov da bi se mogla nositi s konkurencijom u Hrvatskoj i na Mediteranu?

“U svojoj karijeri naučio sam – i tim se principom vodim i danas – da je važnije tražiti prilike za napredak nego fokusirati se na nedostatke, kako bi projekti i destinacije mogli razviti svoj puni potencijal.
Vjerujem da Sveti Filip i Jakov ima ogroman potencijal.
Smješten je u srcu Dalmacije, između Zadra i Šibenika, s prekrasnim plažama, bogatom kulturom i prirodnim atrakcijama.
Ovdje postoji prostor za daljnji razvoj, od gastronomije do kulturne baštine.
Svjesni smo izazova, ali gradimo priču u koju vjerujemo i uvjereni smo da destinacija može rasti i razvijati se te postati ravnopravna s najboljim odredištima na Mediteranu.”, jasan je Sokol.
U sklopu projekta otvorena je prva faza luke Molum Marine Club, a vlasnici planiraju i drugu fazu za sljedeću sezonu.
Kakvav je početak i kakva su očekivanja za iduću godinu?
“Prva faza luke je otvorena, trenutačno imamo 127 vezova, a luka je već ove godine bila kvalitetno popunjena.
Vjerujemo da će Molum Marine Club, u kombinaciji s resortom, značajno doprinijeti destinaciji.
Time zaokružujemo priču koja spaja kopno i more, nudeći sigurnu luku za nautičare i mjesto kojem se rado vraćaju.
U drugoj fazi planiramo dodatni objekt s raznovrsnim sadržajem za nautičare koji traže vrhunsku destinaciju za svoje avanture”, otkriva Sokol.
Popularnost leasbacka Zanimljivo, premium rezidencije unutar kompleksa dostupne su i kao dio investicijskog programa.
Upravitelj Molum Hotel & Residences jamči minimalni godišnji prinos u iznosu od 5 posto od iznosa investicije u prve četiri godine, odnosno do kraja 2027.
godine.
Rezidencije se prodaju kao etažno vlasništvo, namijenjene turističkom iznajmljivanju, a vlasnik ih može koristiti uza sve prednosti koje pruža Molum Hotel & Residences.
Interes za takav vid aranžmana zasad je ugodno iznenadio.
“Interes je značajan.
Kupac ulaže u premium rezidenciju s pet zvjezdica i sklapa ugovor prema kojem rezidenciju iznajmljuje natrag resortu.
Naš tim preuzima upravljanje i iznajmljivanje, dok vlasnik ostvaruje prihod, bez brige o održavanju.
Uz to, može koristiti rezidenciju dio godine i sve sadržaje resorta.
Riječ je o provjerenom leaseback modelu koji postaje sve popularniji”, poručuje Sokol.
Zanimljivo je da više od 90 posto zaposlenih čine domaći ljudi, a lokalni proizvođači su srž gastronomske ponude.
Sokol otkriva kako im je to uspjelo… “Od početka nam je cilj bio uključiti lokalnu zajednicu u razvoj premium destinacije.
Kroz dobre uvjete rada, kvalitetan koncept i jasnu viziju, uspjeli smo formirati snažan domaći tim koji je srce cijelog projekta”, otkriva Sokol.
Vrhunska gastronomija je, uz dizajn i ponudu, jedan od važnih stupova identiteta Moluma.
Koncept restorana Maisa, temeljen na suvremenoj mediteranskoj kuhinji i lokalnim sezonskim namirnicama, nabavljenih od lokalnih OPG-ova.
U sklopu Moluma uskoro se otvara i novi coffee shop Moka, koji predstavlja savršenu lokaciju za specialty kavu i lagane zalogaje za van.
Mnogi će reći da hrvatskom turizmu nedostaje više takvih, luksuznih sadržaja.
Produženje sezone Sokol se slaže s tom tezom, ali vidi da se stvari mijenjaju nabolje.
“Nedostaje sličnih sadržaja, ali svake godine razvija se više kvalitetnih projekata.
Molum je poseban jer na jednom mjestu objedinjuje hotel, rezidencije, nautičku luku i sadržaje za goste, vlasnike i nautičare.
Iskoristili smo prirodne prednosti i nadogradili ih dodatnim sadržajem kako bismo maksimalno iskoristili potencijal kraja.
Time smo također pridonijeli produženju sezone u Svetom Filipu i Jakovu”, kaže Sokol.
Resort neće raditi tijekom cijele godine, no planovi za iduću sezonu vrlo su ambiciozni.
Sunčani resort Molum, Sveti Filip i Jakov “Resort radi sezonski, zatvaramo krajem listopada, a ponovno otvaramo na proljeće.

Što se tiče iduće sezone, očekuje nas niz noviteta, uključujući drugu fazu Molum Marine Cluba i dodatne sadržaje unutar resorta, posebno naš koncept Molum Moments koji će gostima pružiti jedinstvena iskustva”, zaključuje Sokol.

Za kraj, ali ne i najmanje važno… Dizajnersku priču resorta potpisuje studio Velinda Dizajn, pod vodstvom Velinde Ljubičić, čiji tim je osmislio prepoznatljiv vizualni identitet prostora – istovremeno topao, suvremen i inspiriran prirodom.
On je postignut prirodnim materijalima poput drva, jute i kamena te bogatom hortikulturom koja prostoru daje karakter luksuznog mediteranskog vrta.
Molumovi vrtovi puni su autohtonog bilja i brojnih kutaka za odmor koji čine oazu uklopljenu u okolinu resorta.
Interijeri su također osmišljeni tako da također potiču spontanost i opuštanje, s brojnim prostorima za povezivanje i boravak.
Ime Molum inspirirano je povijesnim korijenima mjesta, odnosno latiniziranim nazivom luke Rogovo, “Molum Rogue”, iz koje je kroz stoljeća izrastao današnji Sveti Filip i Jakov.
Upravo je to suptilno ispreplitanje povijesti i suvremenosti nit vodilja cijelog koncepta resorta, od dizajna i sadržaja, pa do atmosfere.
U svakom slučaju, Molum Hotel and Residences pozicionira Sveti Filip i Jakov kao novo središte za visoku razinu smještaja i usluge na hrvatskoj obali.

Upravo s projektima poput ovog, Hrvatska može postati destinacija visoke dodane vrijednosti, ali i destinacija koja brine o svom prostoru, ljudima, kvaliteti života – a što je i proklamirani strateški cilj hrvatskog turizma.

Promotional Video Project Location Sales Office İstasyon, 1441 Sk., 34290 Küçükçekmece/İstanbul +902124738886 Google Maps Yandex Maps Gallery Sıkça Sorulan Sorular Where is Hayat Flora located?
Hayat Flora is a distinguished residential project located in Küçükçekmece on the European side of Istanbul, offering sea and lake views with a central location.

It enjoys a unique position in terms of transportation, being within walking distance to Marmaray Halkalı Station and the M11 Halkalı–Istanbul Airport Metro Line, and close to the E-5 and TEM highways.
How can I get to the Hayat Flora Sales Office?
By Public Transportation The Hayat Flora Sales Office is located just a few minutes’ walk from Halkalı Marmaray Station .
After arriving at Halkalı Station via Marmaray, exit the station and head towards İstasyon Neighborhood (İstasyon Mahallesi) .
Our Sales Office can be reached with a short walk from there.

Guests traveling from the Anatolian side of Istanbul can reach Halkalı directly via Marmaray from stations such as Gebze, Pendik, Bostancı, Söğütlüçeşme, Ayrılık Çeşmesi, and Üsküdar , without the need for transfers.
By Car Guests arriving via the TEM Motorway can follow the Mahmutbey–Halkalı connection road towards Halkalı.
By following the signs for Halkalı Center (Halkalı Merkez) and İstasyon Neighborhood (İstasyon Mahallesi) , they can easily reach the Hayat Flora Sales Office.

Guests traveling via the E-5 (D100) Highway can take the Küçükçekmece–Halkalı exit , continue towards Halkalı, and easily access our Sales Office upon reaching İstasyon Neighborhood (İstasyon Mahallesi) .
What types of apartments are available at Hayat Flora?
The available apartment types at Hayat Flora generally include 1+1, 2+1, 3+1, and 4+1 units, as well as duplex options (with gardens or terraces).
Are Hayat Flora prices advantageous compared to the area?
Hayat Flora stands out as an attractive alternative for investors with its competitive pricing.

Its walking distance to metro and Marmaray lines, proximity to E-5 and TEM highways, and the developing location advantages of Küçükçekmece—combined with the project’s quality and high living standards—further enhance its appeal, especially with ongoing campaigns.
When is the delivery date of the Hayat Flora project?
Constructed with the assurance of Emlak Konut REIT (Revenue Sharing Model) and the quality of Özak GYO, the planned delivery date of the project is February 2029.
What are the total size and unit details of the Hayat Flora project?

Built on a large land area of approximately 92,440 m², the project consists of 21 blocks, offering over 1,380 residential units and more than 45 street-level commercial units that will add value to the region.
What is the parking capacity of the project?
For the comfort of residents, the project offers a spacious parking capacity for a total of 2,318 vehicles.
Is Hayat Flora suitable for families and living with children?
Hayat Flora provides a suitable living environment for families and children with its green areas, playgrounds, secure site layout, and social amenities.
What are the social amenities and lifestyle like at Hayat Flora?
Social areas and site life at Hayat Flora are designed with a family-oriented, green, and socially engaging concept.
Landscaped walking paths, children’s playgrounds, sports areas, relaxation and seating zones, along with a secure entry-exit system, offer residents a comfortable and peaceful living environment.
Is Hayat Flora a good investment opportunity?

Hayat Flora can be considered an attractive investment due to its walking distance to metro and Marmaray lines, proximity to E-5/TEM connections, competitive pricing, and the growth potential of the surrounding area.
What is the soil structure of Hayat Flora, and is it earthquake-resistant?
The Hayat Flora Project has been designed in accordance with the latest Turkish Building Earthquake Code (TBDY-2018).
The seismic behavior of the structures was analyzed using internationally recognized engineering software such as ETABS, SAFE, and SAP2000.

The project’s earthquake and structural calculations were reviewed and approved by experts from Istanbul Technical University Faculty of Civil Engineering and the Emlak Konut REIT Project Directorate.
Reinforced concrete shear walls with thicknesses of 35–40 cm were used in all blocks to safely carry earthquake loads, along with a core shear wall system.
In basement levels, 40 cm thick continuous retaining walls were applied considering soil pressures.
The structures were built on raft foundations with a thickness of 140 cm under blocks and 70 cm in parking areas.
The raft foundation was designed to extend beyond the building footprint, significantly contributing to structural rigidity.
As part of comprehensive soil studies, 87 boreholes were conducted on-site.
To enhance soil safety, ground improvement was carried out using unreinforced bored piles, with a total of 1,710 foundation piles installed.
Additionally, geogrid-reinforced engineered fills were used beneath the foundation to ensure balanced load distribution to the ground.
In the structural system, C35/45 concrete was used in foundations and C40/50 in the superstructure.
Concrete quality is regularly tested by inspection firms and ready-mix suppliers, with results consistently exceeding regulatory standards.
The Hayat Flora Project has been developed under multi-layered supervision by ÖZAK GYO, Emlak Konut GYO A.Ş., independent inspection firms, academic consultants, and experienced technical teams.
How many floors do the project blocks have?
The project consists of three sections and includes blocks with ground floor + 13 floors.

initial 25yr term is below 30yr standard Low Overview Melasti Cliff Villas is an off-plan collection of luxury three-bedroom villas in Melasti, Ungasan — a cliffside sub-location of Uluwatu that has established itself as one of Bali's premier addresses for high-end villa living and short-term rental investment.

Available in two configurations — Ocean View and Jungle — the development delivers each villa with a private swimming pool set on a wooden deck, a private jacuzzi, open-air bathrooms with stone soaking tubs, floor-to-ceiling windows, and fully equipped western kitchens, all delivered furnished.

The dual-configuration model allows buyers to select between panoramic Indian Ocean outlooks and more private, vegetation-framed settings within the same development, depending on rental target market or personal preference.

Each villa carries a 25-year leasehold title with a contractual option to extend for an additional 25 to 30 years — providing a total effective tenure of 50 to 55 years, meaningfully above the 25 to 30-year standard common across Bali's leasehold market.
Construction is estimated at 12 months from the date of purchase, with payment structured over the build period to match capital outlay with construction progress.

The development's Melasti location places it within walking distance of Uluwatu's 5-star hotel corridor — including Anantara and Bulgari — international schools, the New Kuta Golf Course, and the restaurant and beach club infrastructure that underpins the Bukit Peninsula's position as Bali's fastest-growing premium tourism address.

Melasti represents one of the most constrained development environments in the Uluwatu sub-market: cliffside terrain, complex land access, and the premium placed on ocean-view parcels limit viable new supply in a meaningful way.

This structural scarcity, combined with the Bukit's rising international profile, has consistently supported above-average capital appreciation for well-located cliff-front developments in recent completed sale cycles, providing a demand-supply backdrop that is more favourable for capital preservation than the higher-volume apartment corridors in Seminyak and central Canggu.

Indonesia allows foreigners to own property under Hak Pakai (Right to Use) title for up to 80 years.

Ask Us on WhatsApp What is the price of Dasa Ubud?
+ Dasa Ubud is priced at $349,000 USD leasehold or $379,000 USD through a PT PMA on a right-to-build title (Hak Guna Bangunan).
Most new developments in Bali are leasehold-only.
One villa is all that remains, so this is the last opportunity to secure either structure within this development.
Can foreign buyers hold Dasa Ubud through a company?
+ Yes.
Freehold (Hak Milik) title in Indonesia can only be held by Indonesian citizens.
A PT PMA, a foreign-owned Indonesian company, can hold the villa on a right-to-build title (Hak Guna Bangunan), and you own and control the company.
This structure is legal, well-established, and commonly used by international buyers in Bali.
Our legal team can walk through the specifics.
What is the projected rental yield for Dasa Ubud?
+ At $280 per night and 80% occupancy, Dasa Ubud projects roughly 15% annual ROI.
Monthly revenue at that occupancy rate is around $6,810, with running costs of approximately $900 to $1,100 per month.
Ubud's wellness tourism base tends to hold occupancy more consistently through low season than beach markets - which is reflected in the yield stability.
Why invest in Ubud rather than Canggu or Uluwatu?
+ Lower entry price, different guest profile, and more consistent year-round demand.
Ubud draws wellness travellers, long-stay retreats, and cultural visitors who typically book longer, rate higher, and churn less than beach tourists.
Nightly rates are lower than Uluwatu, but so are land and build costs - the yield margin is comparable.
And Ubud has considerably less short-term rental supply, which supports occupancy.
Can foreigners legally purchase at Dasa Ubud?
The leasehold option is available directly to foreign individuals - no company structure required.
The lease runs 30 years with a 30-year extension option.
All contracts are prepared by qualified Indonesian notaries and registered under Indonesian property law.
What are the ongoing running costs?
+ Budget approximately $900 to $1,100 USD per month for a fully managed villa.
This covers management fees, utilities, routine maintenance, and landscaping.
Cost fluctuates slightly with occupancy - higher bookings bring higher cleaning costs, but those are offset by the additional revenue.
When does rental income start?
+ Dasa Ubud is an off-plan development.
Once construction completes, rental income typically begins within 4 to 8 weeks of handover: time for final furnishing, professional photography, listing setup, and confirmed first bookings.
Balitecture's rental team starts pre-marketing before handover to reduce that gap.

On verified figures, price-per-living-sqm is competitive: the 1BR at USD 132,000 over 97 sqm = ~USD 1,361/sqm; the 2BR at USD 177,000 over 154 sqm = ~USD 1,149/sqm.
The defining constraint is the 28-year leasehold — relatively short versus many peers — so buyers should model returns over the lease life and confirm renewal terms before purchase.
No developer rental yield is published, so any income case must be built from comparable Areguling/Kuta nightly rates rather than vendor projections.

The project offers one- and two-bedroom private-pool residences on a 28-year leasehold, the standard route for foreign buyers in this part of the island.
At the time of research it was at an early stage, with Phase One site preparation in progress.
The unit mix is compact and rental-oriented.
The one-bedroom villa occupies a 160 sqm plot with 97 sqm of living area (67 sqm covered) and an 18 sqm private pool, priced from USD 132,000.
The two-bedroom villa sits on a 236 sqm plot with 154 sqm of living area (92 sqm covered) and a 21 sqm pool, from USD 177,000.
Both types are delivered furnished, each with its own pool.

Infrastructure is handled at villa level — a private electricity panel, dedicated water storage and pump, and a 120-metre well — supported by a communal guest lobby, a practical response to the patchy municipal servicing common in rural South Lombok.

Areguling is an emerging, uncrowded coastal area known as an intermediate-to-advanced surf spot, roughly 3 km (about 10 minutes) from Kuta Mandalika and approximately 25-35 minutes from Lombok International Airport.
It benefits from the broader Mandalika Special Economic Zone investment cycle while remaining quieter and lower-density than central Kuta.
The proposition suits buyers seeking a low-entry, furnished rental asset or a lock-up-and-leave second home.

As an early off-plan project, the developer identity, total unit count, completion date and exact beach distance are not yet published and should be confirmed directly with the selling agent before any commitment.

Developed by Nakheel, the visionary force behind Palm Jumeirah, this exclusive frond offers residents a lifestyle defined by crystal-clear waters, thoughtfully designed communal spaces, and the kind of tranquility that is increasingly rare in a city that never slows down.
Whether you are seeking a permanent family home or a prestigious investment, Frond A delivers on every level.

Prime Location: Dubai, Palm Jebel Ali Situated on the iconic Palm Jebel Ali — the larger and more expansive sibling of Palm Jumeirah — Frond A occupies a prime position along the palm's outer crescent, granting residents direct access to a private beachfront and unobstructed sea views.

Palm Jebel Ali itself is located along Dubai's southern coastline, within the broader Jebel Ali district, a zone that has undergone dramatic transformation into one of Dubai's most sought-after residential corridors.
The address carries genuine prestige, offering the seclusion of island living while remaining firmly connected to the pulse of the city.
Connectivity and Accessibility to Key Locations Despite its island setting, Palm Jebel Ali – Frond A is surprisingly well-connected to Dubai's major destinations.
Residents benefit from smooth road access via the dedicated Palm Jebel Ali bridge and trunk road network, placing key city landmarks within comfortable reach.

Dubai Marina and JBR – approximately 20 to 25 minutes by car Expo City Dubai – under 15 minutes drive, making it ideal for professionals in that district Al Maktoum International Airport – roughly 20 minutes away, a significant advantage as the airport expands into a global hub Downtown Dubai and Business Bay – approximately 35 to 40 minutes via Sheikh Zayed Road Jebel Ali Free Zone – under 10 minutes, ideal for business owners and entrepreneurs The surrounding road infrastructure continues to develop in tandem with the Palm Jebel Ali masterplan, ensuring that connectivity only improves over time.
Property Types and Sizes Frond A at Palm Jebel Ali is designed to cater to discerning buyers who value space, privacy, and architectural quality.
The residential offering spans a curated selection of villa typologies that balance grandeur with livability.

Signature beachfront villas with private beach access and panoramic sea views Garden villas positioned along the frond's quieter inner edge, offering lush outdoor spaces Generous plot sizes designed to accommodate private pools, landscaped gardens, and outdoor entertaining areas Interiors spanning multiple floors with flexible layouts suited to families of varying sizes Detailed Amenities and Facilities The amenities at Palm Jebel Ali – Frond A have been carefully planned to support an elevated everyday lifestyle, moving well beyond the standard offering found in most Dubai developments.

Crystal lagoon and pristine private beachfront for residents' exclusive use Cascading waterfalls and a beautifully landscaped boulevard for leisurely walks and evening strolls Poolside leisure decks designed for relaxed outdoor living throughout the year A fully equipped gym and multipurpose room for fitness and wellness activities Cinema lounge for private screenings and community entertainment Dedicated kids' play area in a safe, supervised environment Unique Architectural Features and Design Elements The villas at Frond A draw inspiration from contemporary coastal architecture, with clean lines, expansive glazing, and natural materials that create a seamless dialogue between interior living spaces and the surrounding seascape.
High ceilings, open-plan layouts, and floor-to-ceiling windows are characteristic features, allowing natural light to flow freely throughout the day.
Private terraces and rooftop spaces extend the living area outdoors, while thoughtful landscaping ensures that each villa feels like a private retreat rather than simply a house within a development.

Lifestyle and Community Aspects Living on Frond A is about more than the physical property — it is about belonging to a small, carefully curated community of like-minded residents who value quality, space, and a slower pace of life without sacrificing access to the city.

A low-density residential environment that preserves privacy and a genuine sense of exclusivity A walkable seafront boulevard that encourages a healthy, active outdoor lifestyle Family-friendly facilities that make daily life comfortable for residents of all ages A secure, gated community with professional property management and maintenance services Proximity to beach clubs, retail, and dining destinations planned as part of the wider Palm Jebel Ali development Investment Potential and Market Value Palm Jebel Ali is widely regarded as one of Dubai's most significant real estate opportunities of the decade.

With beachfront land in Dubai becoming an increasingly finite commodity, properties on Frond A sit at the intersection of scarcity and demand — a combination that historically drives long-term capital appreciation.

Dubai's sustained population growth, its status as a global business hub, and the ongoing expansion of Al Maktoum International Airport all contribute to a robust outlook for the wider Jebel Ali corridor.
Investors entering at this stage of development typically benefit from pre-handover pricing, with values expected to rise considerably as the infrastructure matures and the community takes shape.
Developer Profile: Nakheel Nakheel is one of Dubai's most recognized property developers, with a legacy built on transforming ambitious ideas into landmark destinations.

The company is responsible for creating Palm Jumeirah — arguably the most recognized man-made island on the planet — as well as a portfolio of master-planned communities, retail destinations, and hospitality projects across the emirate.
Now merged under the Dubai Real Estate Developer (DRED) umbrella alongside Meydan, Nakheel brings decades of delivery experience and deep institutional backing to every project it undertakes.
With Palm Jebel Ali, the developer is drawing on that accumulated expertise to create a development that sets a new benchmark for waterfront living in Dubai.

Do the residences come furnished?
Owners have the exclusive opportunity to purchase a meticulously crafted and custom-designed furniture package tailored for each unit, ensuring a cohesive and luxurious living space.
What will the furniture package include?
Each residence benefits from a professionally curated furniture package developed by an esteemed international design group, enhancing the overall aesthetic and comfort of the living spaces.

The furniture package will provide a full complement of beds, tables, consoles, chairs, sofas, lamps, drapery, mirrors, soft furnishings, artwork, planters, televisions, audio, and outdoor tables, chairs, loungers.
What is the cost of the furniture package?

Are the condominium residences part of a Home Owners Association or Strata Corporation?
Yes, each condominium residence is associated with its own Strata Corporation.
This organizational structure ensures efficient ownership and maintenance of common areas.
The Strata Corporation oversees common area upkeep, and centrally managed utilities like refuse removal and elevator maintenance.
Is the beach private?

While the stunning Turks and Caicos beaches are accessible to the public, our property will feature a private upland section of the beach with exclusive cabanas, sunchairs, and umbrellas for Kempinski owners and guests.
Our dedicated beach-front team ensures personalized service, including food and beverage offerings from the beach bar.
Will there be security on the property?
The property boasts twenty-four-hour security to prioritize the safety and well-being of our esteemed guests and residents.
Will pets be allowed?
Subject to rules established and approved by management and by the regulations of the Turk and Caicos Islands.
Do I have to rent my condo?
Participation in the rental program is mandatory.
Owners are always welcome to enjoy the benefits of their residence and spend time at the resort.

Do you have a Kid’s Club?

Kempinski Hotels, Europe’s most established luxury hotel company, renowned for its hospitality and shareholder support for over 125 years, will manage the residences and villas.

Who will manage rentals of the residences?
The rental program will be exclusively managed by Kempinski Hotels, ensuring a seamless and high-quality experience for both owners and guests.
Are owners required to participate in the rental program?

This ensures a consistent level of amenities and services, including Kempinski-curated dining, beverage, spa, and service experiences.
Rental revenue will be split on a 50/50 basis, contributing to premium amenities and helping lower the cost of ownership.
If I participate in the rental program, is there a limit to the number of days for Owner usage?
No, owners have the flexibility to use their residence at any time based on the rental program requirements.
May owners hire a third party to rent out their residence?
No, to maintain the highest standards, residential rentals will be exclusively managed by Kempinski Hotels.

What is the strata fee?

The anticipated Strata fee is estimated to range between USD$18 and US$21 per square foot per year excluding insurance, based on current luxury resort benchmarks, aligning well with the Island average.
What will the rental split be?
The owner retains 50% of the adjusted rental income, with the remaining 50% going to the management company, aligning with standard practices on the island.
Are there any taxes in Turks and Caicos?
There is a one-time stamp duty applicable on the real estate purchase price, amounting to 10% of the purchase price for purchases over US$500,000.
This is payable at the time of title transfer.
Notably, there are no annual property taxes and no income taxes in the Turks and Caicos Islands, providing a favorable tax environment.
Will I own fee simple?
Do I need a local trustee to hold title?
In the Turks and Caicos Islands, real estate can be held as freehold title absolute or leasehold.
Strata titles are fee simple and are commonly used as the structure for condominium developments.
A local legal advisor can guide you on the best practices for purchasing property in Turks and Caicos, ensuring a seamless and secure process.

Numandi is a luxury residential community in Avellanas offering architect-designed modular homes with premium finishes, private pools, enclosed garages, and modern tropical living.

What types of homes are available?

Standing 230.50 metres tall and comprising 64 storeys (ground floor + 63), it will become the tallest residential tower in Europe and a new icon on the city’s skyline.

Its silhouette tapers progressively towards the top, inspired by the organic forms of the marine environment, evoking corals that emerge and intertwine, and ensuring that every home enjoys privileged views and a direct connection to the sea.
The development offers one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom flats, with two quality ranges — Excellence and Premium — to suit every lifestyle, delivered on a turnkey basis.
FACILITIES TM Tower redefines the concept of high-end residential living with over 10,000 m² of communal areas designed for everyday wellbeing.

Its amenities include a fitness floor (floor 21) with strength and cardio rooms, a yoga garden and a kids’ club; an entire floor dedicated to Spa & Wellness (floor 22) featuring a thermal circuit, heated jacuzzis, a heated indoor swimming pool, a Finnish sauna, a Turkish bath, an ice fountain and massage areas; and a rooftop on floor 63 — the highest in Europe — with a Skybar and an astronomical observatory.

Within the development, there are several swimming pools (for adults, children, a year-round heated swimming pool and a jacuzzi), a chill-out area, children’s play areas and a sports area with tennis courts, padel courts and a multi-purpose court.

Inside, the flats are fitted out to a high standard: a fully fitted kitchen with a Silestone worktop and Miele extractor hood; a heat pump air-conditioning system for heating and cooling with domestic hot water production; external PVC joinery with double glazing (energy rating A); large-format porcelain floor tiles (120×60 cm), bathrooms fitted with Hansgrohe taps and Villeroy & Boch sanitaryware, motorised blinds, pre-installation for home automation (Schneider Wiser) and a garage space with pre-electric vehicle charging point.

The Premium range features corner terraces with private jacuzzis, Italian-designed kitchens, Miele appliances, Axor taps, advanced home automation, underfloor heating and zone-controlled air conditioning.
LOCATION TM Tower is being built in the Poniente Beach area of Benidorm, one of the city’s most sought-after and up-and-coming areas, on Avenida de México and just 50–150 metres from the beach.

It is being built on the plot situated directly opposite the Intempo, with which it will share prominence on the skyline, in a setting that combines Mediterranean charm with the tranquillity of a residential area away from the hustle and bustle, yet with all amenities close at hand.
Poniente is a less densely populated area with a more peaceful atmosphere than Levante Beach, ideal for year-round living or as a second home by the sea.

Vandal The location offers convenient access to the centre of Benidorm, with its array of restaurants, shops and leisure facilities, as well as nearby attractions such as La Marina Shopping Centre, golf courses (Las Rejas, Villaitana) and the theme parks Terra Mítica, Aqualandia and Mundomar, all just a few minutes’ drive away.
Furthermore, the town is around 30 minutes from Alicante-Elche International Airport and the high-speed rail station, ensuring it is always well connected.
