The project is in an advanced stage of construction, with the building already having Act 14, Act 15 is expected in September 2026, and the planned deadline for receiving Act 16 is November 2026.
The complex includes a total of 12 apartments, of which 10 are currently available for sale.
The areas of the available apartments range from 33.42 sq m to 151 sq m, which provides opportunities for both a compact holiday property and a spacious home for year-round living.
The prices of the available apartments start at 55,143 euros and reach 241,600 euros excluding VAT, at prices from 1250 to 1300 euros/m 2 excluding VAT.
The buyer does not owe a commission.

Excellent location in Bansko One of the main advantages of the building is its convenient location, which allows quick access to both the central city area and the sports and tourist infrastructure of Bansko.
Just 20 m from the entrance of the building there is a padel court, and about 50 m away - the TermePulse SPA and thermal pool.

In the immediate vicinity are also: - Billa supermarket � about 150 m; - the central square and the market of Bansko � about 350 m; - school � about 400 m; - polyclinic - about 400 m; - tennis court � about 650 m; - the ski lift � about 10 minutes walk.
The location makes the properties particularly suitable for both year-round living and for holiday use or rental during the winter and summer tourist seasons.
High-quality and energy-efficient construction The building is designed with attention to energy efficiency, comfort and durability of the materials used.
The exterior and partition walls are made of energy-efficient ceramic bricks/blocks with a thickness of 25 cm, combined with 10 cm of EPS external thermal insulation.
The facade is finished with high-quality Baumit textured plaster, and the pitched roof is thermally insulated with mineral wool.
For maximum thermal and acoustic comfort, high-class joinery with 70 mm K?mmerling profiles and energy-saving three-layer, two-chamber glazing with "WINTER/SUMMER" technology is provided.
Apartments, completed "turnkey" The apartments are offered in a "turnkey" state of completion, with flooring installed, finished bathrooms and toilets, and a planned kitchen.
The necessary electrical, plumbing and sewage installations have been completed.
The heating is electric, and each apartment has outlets and power for the installation of air conditioners.
Built-in structures for hanging toilets and hygienic showers are installed in the sanitary facilities, with the exception of one-room studios.
The apartments are designed to allow the integration of a full range of built-in kitchen appliances, including a dishwasher and washing machine, even in compact homes.
Parking - Parking spaces/garages are offered for the building at prices from 19,000 euros excluding VAT, providing additional convenience for the owners and their guests.

Four jewel-like neighbourhoods are woven into this natural haven.
Four neighbourhoods Amazi Cove — wadi-inspired waterfront garden homes facing the lagoon, each with its own gardens, exclusive canal waterfront access and the option of private jetty ownership.

Amazi Islands — a ribbon of small, connected islands where every residence sits on the waterfront.

Amazi Beach — absolute beachfront living.

3–5 bedroom privately owned residences open directly onto the 7 km white sandy beach, set along a crescent waterfront with sandy bungalows and residents' pools that dissolve the boundary between home and lagoon.

Muriya is one of Oman's foremost developers of Integrated Tourism Complexes (ITCs) — large, master-planned seaside towns that blend freehold homes, hotels, marinas and leisure into a single destination.

Founded in 2006 as a joint venture between Orascom Development Holding , the Swiss-listed integrated-town specialist behind El Gouna and Andermatt, and OMRAN Group , Oman's government tourism-investment arm, Muriya builds and operates two of the Sultanate's flagship coastal destinations: Jebel Sifah near Muscat and Hawana Salalah in Dhofar.

2006 Founded Muscat, Sultanate of Oman Headquarters Two flagship ITC destinations with multiple delivered communities and over 1,000 homes handed over Projects delivered View Muriya About Hawana Salalah Muriya's flagship beachfront destination on Oman's green Dhofar coast.
Hawana Salalah is southern Oman's flagship beachfront resort — a 13.6 million sqm Integrated Tourism Complex master-developed by Muriya , the joint venture between Orascom Development and OMRAN.

Strung along 7 km of white-sand Arabian Sea coastline , it wraps a 170-berth inland marina (the only yacht haven in the south), the Hawana Aqua Park — Oman's first, at 65,600 sqm with 12 slides — and four hotels including the Salalah Rotana, Fanar Hotel & Residences, Juweira Boutique Hotel and the Souly eco-lodge.

As a designated ITC it offers 100% perpetual freehold to buyers of any nationality , with Omani residency bundled in, 0% property and personal income tax , and a resident community of 2,000+ from over 20 nationalities.
The demand engine is the Khareef monsoon , which drew more than a million visitors to Dhofar in 2025 — turning a beach apartment here into one of the most efficient holiday-let products in Oman.
Freehold homes at Amazi start from OMR 98,000 , just 20 minutes from Salalah International Airport.

Features of “QUILL RESORT OKINAWA condominium hotel” A location that offers breathtaking views and a quiet environment The hotel’s most distinctive feature is its privileged hilltop location that overlooks the East China Sea.

Extending in front of the building is the coastline of the Ocean Expo Park, which is known for the Okinawa Churaumi Aquarium, and unfolding in the distance are views of Ie, Sesoko, and Minna Islands and an unobstructed horizon.
At sunset, guests and owners can gaze out at the red glow of the sky and sea from the balcony*, offering a liberating and tranquil experience not found in daily life.
Located in the northern part of Okinawa Island, Motobu-cho is enveloped by the lush natural environment of Yambaru, drawing visitors from both Japan and overseas.

Thanks to its proximity to key attractions such as a new theme park and other large-scale activity facilities, the Okinawa Churaumi Aquarium, Kouri Island, and the Nakijin Castle Ruins, the town is highly regarded as a tourism hub for the northern part of the island, offering convenient access to nature, culture, and leisure.
* Not applicable to the first-floor guest rooms.
A tranquil suite that opens up to the sea and sky The door opens to reveal a sweeping panorama of the sea.
Each guest room is a suite of at least 50 square meters, featuring a spacious living area and a six-meter span that seamlessly connects the interior with the outdoor views.

A balcony extends from each room, offering the luxurious experience of simply gazing out at the sky and sea and watching them transform as time goes by.* The rooms are also equipped with a kitchen, washing machine, and an entrance space with storage, providing an ideal environment for longer stays.
Designed to enable guests to enjoy their stay as if they were living there, these exquisite hilltop guest rooms offer both tranquility and functionality.

An infinity pool will be placed at the front of the site, blending together sea and sky while offering spectacular views of Ie Island and a liberating sense of openness.
A semi-open-air bath with a sauna offers an ideal place for unwinding after activities.
The combination of a high-heat sauna, cold plunge, and outdoor air exposure delivers the kind of restorative experience only a resort can offer.
The club lounge also provides a space for quiet reading and refreshments, offering a moment of personal reflection.
The all-day dining restaurant serves cuisine prepared with seasonal local ingredients, which can also be enjoyed from terrace seats with ocean views.
The specialty restaurant offers seasonal cuisine to be savored in an elegant atmosphere.
The property also includes a main swimming pool, a kids’ pool, and an indoor pool that can be enjoyed throughout the year.
By providing both the comforts of a resort experience and the convenience of daily living, the spatial design delivers a unique stay experience.

How can foreigners own condos in Thailand?
Foreigners can own a condominium Freehold in their own name.
Condominium ownership is best explained by looking at an example of a project that has 100 units for sale.
In this example, 49 of the total units in this building (or 49% of the total salable area) can be owned outright by non-thai nationals in their name.
The ownership titles of these 49 units is referred to as Freehold or Foreign Quota.
This leaves 51 units remaining in the building (or 51% of the total salable).
The freehold rights to these units are reserved for Thai nationals in what is commonly referred to as the Thai quota.

Designed as an exclusive collection of modern seaview pool villas , the project offers buyers an unparalleled blend of luxury, privacy, and convenience.
With sweeping 180° panoramic views of the turquoise sea and lush jungle, this development encapsulates island living at its most elegant.
The villas come in two distinct configurations : a single-story 3-bedroom villa and a two-story 4-bedroom villa , each crafted with attention to detail and premium finishes.
Land sizes range between approximately 345 sqm and 400 sqm , with total built areas between 270 sqm and 325 sqm .
This project emphasizes contemporary tropical architecture , blending indoor and outdoor living through large glass openings, infinity pools, and sunken salas.
Each residence is designed for both lifestyle enjoyment and long-term investment growth.
Ownership is freehold , adding lasting value for international buyers.
Le Reve Villas – Unit Types Le Reve 3-Bedroom Single-Story Villa The 3-bedroom villa spans a land plot of about 370–400 sqm , with a built area of 260–270 sqm .
Its open layout is carefully planned to maximize the 180° seaview , seamlessly connecting living spaces with the outdoor terrace and private infinity pool .
Each of the three bedrooms comes with en-suite bathrooms, and the master suite is positioned to enjoy direct views of the ocean.
Lifestyle features include a sunken sala with ceiling fan , a European-style kitchen , and a laundry room .
Parking for one car is provided.
This villa is ideal for families or couples who value a single-level design with easy access (no steep hill drive required).
Design & Lifestyle at Le Reve Villas Koh Samui Le Reve Villas are conceived with a contemporary European-tropical design philosophy , where clean architectural lines meet natural finishes.
The homes feature teak wood doors , porcelain flooring , and natural stone decorations , balancing durability with elegance.
The interiors are bathed in natural light through high-quality aluminium Euro frames and expansive windows, framing uninterrupted sea views.

The luxury European-style kitchens include islands for sociable cooking and entertaining, while bathrooms are fitted with rain showers, terrazzo sinks, and smart mirrors , combining sophistication with functionality.
Lifestyle facilities are woven into the living experience: infinity pools, sunken salas, outdoor showers, and landscaped terraces encourage open-air relaxation.
For added comfort, villas are fitted with Haier air-conditioning systems , ceiling fans, and Philips lighting solutions .
Behind the scenes, each home is supported by private deep wells, filtration systems, and central hot-water systems, ensuring a seamless and sustainable lifestyle.
Living in Le Reve Villas Koh Samui’s Location Positioned in Bophut , one of Koh Samui’s most prestigious addresses, the project offers both tranquility and accessibility.
The villas are just minutes from Chaweng Beach , Bangrak Beach , and the charming Fisherman’s Village , known for its vibrant dining and boutique scene.
Practical conveniences are close at hand, with Big C Supermarket (6 km) and ISS International School (5 km) offering daily ease for families.
The airport is only a short drive away, making international travel seamless.
Despite its centrality, the location retains a sense of calm, tucked into the lush hillsides with easy access (no steep inclines) .
For homeowners, this means enjoying serene ocean panoramas without sacrificing urban convenience.
Who Is Le Reve Villas Koh Samui Ideal For?
Le Reve Villas are perfect for discerning international buyers, families, retirees, and investors who dream of combining lifestyle and return.
They suit those seeking a freehold villa in Koh Samui that balances modern luxury with authentic island living.
Ideal for anyone who values privacy, panoramic views, and proximity to Koh Samui’s cultural and social hubs.

Le Reve Villas amplify this potential by offering freehold ownership , a rarity for international investors.
The project’s blend of architectural elegance, prime location, and panoramic views enhances both resale value and rental demand.
Villas are close to international schools, beaches, and nightlife, making them appealing for long- and short-term rentals alike.
With land on Samui becoming scarcer, properties with such vistas are likely to appreciate steadily in value.

The 3-bedroom single-story villas start at 13,500,000 THB , with some plots (partial seaview) from 11,900,000 THB .

Login Here LATEST NEWS STOCKS COMPANIES BONDS REAL ESTATE FINANCE COMMODITIES ECONOMY INDUSTRIES LAOS CAMBODIA Home Real Estate Phu My Hung launches new limited-edition development 'The Sculptura' Oct 20th at 13:58 20-10-2025 13:58:25+07:00 Phu My Hung launches new limited-edition development 'The Sculptura' Phu My Hung has unveiled The Sculptura, its latest residential project, marking a return to the market after an 18-month pause in new launches.
Phu My Hung Development Corporation introduced The Sculptura on October 11 and opened its show units at the company’s Sales Gallery.

The launch follows nearly a year and a half since the developer’s last projects – The Aurora and Phu My Hung L’Arcade in 2024 – and adds a new source of primary housing supply to Ho Chi Minh City’s property market.

The opening of Phu My Hung’s The Sculptura Sales Gallery took on October 11 The event attracted nearly 700 guests, following an overwhelming response to online registration – more than 750 sign-ups were recorded through the Phu My Hung App within just four hours.

According to Bui Huy Toan, director of Sales and Marketing at Phu My Hung Development Corporation, after more than 32 years of development, Phu My Hung has established itself as one of Ho Chi Minh City’s leading urban areas, recognised for its planning, infrastructure, and management standards.
He added that the company continues to pursue improvements in design, technology, and operations to enhance the living environment.

"Thanks to that spirit, even though Phu My Hung is already recognised as a modern and well-planned city, we continue to invest in comprehensive upgrades – from urban landscapes and housing standards to high-end amenities, healthcare, cultural facilities, and management services," said Toan.

"Our goal is for Phu My Hung City to remain one of the most desirable places to live while evolving into a leading centre for culture, education, healthcare, commerce, entertainment, and tourism in the region.
We call this vision 'Phu My Hung 2.0'," he added.
Spanning over 2,370 square metres and rising 12 stories high, The Sculptura features 75 apartments and 10 retail shops, making it an exceptionally limited-edition development.
It is also one of the few remaining premium-class projects within Phu My Hung City.
Under the Phu My Hung 2.0 strategic direction, only 15 per cent of the city’s remaining residential land will be dedicated to high-end and luxury developments.

Located on Ha Huy Tap Street, a 31.5-metre-wide main road, The Sculptura lies in the heart of Canh Doi, one of the city’s lowest-density residential zones, where 60 per cent of the area is allocated to low-rise housing.
To the south, the project faces the prestigious Phu Gia Villa Compound.
To the north, adjacent to the building’s podium, is a 3,500 sq.m park currently being upgraded in parallel with The Sculptura’s construction.

Nearby landmarks include Crescent Lake, Anh Sao Bridge, and several top schools such as Saigon South School, Dinh Thien Ly School, and Saigon South International School (SSIS), along with several upcoming iconic developments by Phu My Hung.
Phu My Hung collaborated with DP Architects (DPA), a leading Singapore-based architectural firm with nearly 60 years of experience, to design The Sculptura.
DPA has an impressive global portfolio including Dubai Mall, Resorts World Sentosa, Singapore Hub, and Esplanade Theatres on the Bay.
The Sculptura is designed to meet luxury apartment standards, with the majority of units featuring three bedrooms ranging from 109 to 127 sq.m (about 83 per cent of the total).
Two-bedroom units (84 sq.m) account for 10 per cent, while Tophouse units range from 182 to 226 sq.m.

Explaining the product mix, the developer noted that while the market currently favours smaller affordable units, Phu My Hung designed The Sculptura specifically for high-end owner-occupiers who demand spacious, elegant living environments with ample functional space for long-term comfort.
These discerning buyers also value privacy and exclusivity, preferring communities with moderate density and like-minded neighbours.
All materials and furnishings are carefully curated from renowned European brands such as Gessi and Villeroy & Boch.

In addition to the nearby 3,500 sq.m park and surrounding amenities, The Sculptura offers a private suite of facilities including an infinity pool, BBQ area, jacuzzi and hydrotherapy, gym, yoga studio, sauna, children’s playroom, and more.

The project’s completion will align with the rollout of several billion-VND-scale infrastructure and amenity developments, including the Crescent Lake landscape enhancement, Kenh Dao redevelopment, Phu My Hung Art and Cultural Centre, Tam Anh General Hospital with 1,000 beds, and a 5-star hotel and international-grade retail complex.

Phu My Hung’s Sales Gallery is located on Tran Van Tra street in Phu My Hung New City, Tan My ward, Ho Chi Minh City, and the company is expected to host the official sales launch for The Sculptura in November.

Get free newspaper Buy Rent New launches Find agents Get free newspaper News Resources Print Edition Reviews CloutHaus Residences, KLCC: Branded Luxu… CloutHaus Residences, KLCC: Branded Luxury Living Facing the Petronas Twin Towers June 24, 2026 Updated: 4 months ago Add EdgeProp as preferred source In a city where skyline prestige defines property value, CloutHaus Residences emerges as one of the most talked-about new launches in Kuala Lumpur’s coveted KLCC enclave.
Positioned along the iconic Jalan P.
Ramlee and directly facing the Petronas Twin Towers, this development is more than just another high-rise—it represents a convergence of luxury living, branded hospitality, and urban connectivity.

As one of the few remaining prime plots in the area, CloutHaus Residences captures attention with its bold ambition to redefine modern city living, appealing to both discerning homeowners and investors seeking a statement address in the heart of the capital.
Location & connectivity CloutHaus Residences sits along Jalan P.
Ramlee, right in the heart of Kuala Lumpur City Centre (KLCC), one of the most prestigious addresses in Malaysia.
The development occupies a rare remaining parcel directly facing the iconic Petronas Twin Towers, giving it strong locational prestige and unobstructed skyline views.
Connectivity is a major strength.

Residents enjoy immediate access to key highways and arterial roads, while public transport options such as the KLCC LRT, Ampang Park MRT, and nearby monorail stations provide seamless mobility across the city.
ADVERTISEMENT This central positioning places the development within walking distance of KL’s core business, lifestyle, and tourism zones—ideal for both owner-occupiers and short-term rental demand.
Nearby amenities Living in KLCC means being surrounded by one of the most comprehensive urban amenity ecosystems in the country.
Retail options are abundant and cater to both everyday needs and luxury lifestyles.
Suria KLCC, located just steps away, offers a curated mix of international designer brands, dining outlets, and entertainment facilities.
Slightly further out, Pavilion Kuala Lumpur and Fahrenheit88 expand the retail experience with a wider variety of fashion, lifestyle, and F&B offerings.
Healthcare access within the city centre is well established, with private medical centres and specialist clinics located nearby, ensuring convenience for both residents and expatriates.

While KLCC itself is more commercially oriented, reputable international schools and higher education institutions are accessible within a reasonable driving radius, particularly in areas such as Ampang, Mont Kiara, and Bangsar.
The presence of KLCC Park adds a rare green element to an otherwise dense urban environment.
It serves as a lifestyle anchor for jogging, leisure, and social interaction, enhancing the overall liveability of the area.

Project details Developer TA Global Berhad Land size 2.259 acres Total units 615 serviced apartment units Unit sizes 549 sq ft to 1,216 sq ft (Studio to 3-bedroom, including dual-key layouts) Tenure Freehold (commercial title) Target completion 2029 Key project highlights CloutHaus Residences features a dual-tower integrated scheme with a hotel component operated by Paradox Hotel, combining branded residences and hospitality services within a single prestigious address.
It offers direct frontage facing the Petronas Twin Towers and is positioned on one of the last remaining prime land parcels within KLCC.
The residences are designed as branded units with full Paradox Hotel services, catering to a luxury lifestyle experience.
Selected layouts include dual-key configurations, providing flexibility for rental strategies and income optimization.

Overall, the project is positioned for global urban elites, emphasizing exclusivity, prestige, and connectivity, with a core concept centered on influence, connection, and elevated urban living beyond a typical residential development.
Facilities CloutHaus Residences offers a curated set of lifestyle and productivity-focused facilities which designed to blend wellness, work, and networking—appealing to modern urban lifestyles.

Resort-style swimming pool Fully equipped gymnasium Co-working spaces for professionals Social lounges and communal areas Hotel-managed services and concierge Build & spec In line with its premium positioning, CloutHaus Residences places strong emphasis on build quality and interior specifications.
Units are expected to feature contemporary layouts with efficient space planning, catering to both own-stay comfort and rental viability.
Finishes and fittings are aligned with branded residence standards, incorporating quality materials, modern kitchen setups, and thoughtfully designed living spaces.
The integration with a hotel operator also implies a higher level of maintenance and operational consistency, which is particularly important in preserving long-term property value.
The design language leans towards modern elegance, appealing to a global audience rather than being overly localised in style.
Pricing & availability CloutHaus Residences enters the market at a premium price point, reflecting both its location and branding.
Indicative prices start from approximately RM1.9 million, with larger or better-oriented units reaching well above RM3 million.
On a per square foot basis, pricing is positioned in the upper tier of the KLCC market, generally ranging from RM2,600 psf and above.
This places it among the more expensive new launches in the area, competing directly with other luxury and branded developments.
While the pricing may appear steep, it is largely justified by its rare frontage, integrated concept, and overall positioning within the KLCC hierarchy.
Market positioning CloutHaus Residences is clearly positioned within the luxury branded residence segment, targeting a niche but globally mobile buyer pool.
It is not designed to compete with mid-range serviced apartments, but rather with high-end developments that offer a combination of prestige, services, and location.
Its competitive edge lies in three main areas: branding through hotel integration, genuine proximity and views of KLCC, and a modern product offering tailored to current market demands.
This positions it as both a lifestyle purchase and a status symbol.
Market insights The KLCC residential market has long been associated with prestige and international appeal, but it is also characterised by high supply levels, particularly in the high-rise segment.
As a result, rental yields tend to be moderate, and capital appreciation may be more gradual compared to emerging growth areas.
However, not all KLCC properties perform equally.
Developments with strong branding, superior management, and unique selling points—such as unobstructed views or integrated hospitality—tend to stand out over time.
CloutHaus Residences , with its branded residence concept and prime positioning, is structured to compete within this more resilient sub-segment of the market.
Investors should adopt a long-term perspective, focusing on asset quality and differentiation rather than short-term gains.
Lifestyle & community CloutHaus Residences caters to a distinctly urban and international lifestyle.
The typical resident profile is likely to include expatriates, business travellers, and high-net-worth individuals who value proximity to the city’s financial and lifestyle hubs.
The development’s design encourages interaction and networking, particularly through shared spaces such as lounges and co-working areas.
This creates a community that is more dynamic and transient compared to traditional family-oriented residential projects.
For owner-occupiers, it offers a vibrant city living experience.
For investors, it aligns well with the expectations of the modern urban tenant.
Conclusion CloutHaus Residences represents a bold addition to the KLCC skyline, combining location, branding, and contemporary living into a single development.
Its strongest appeal lies in its status as a prime, visually connected address to the Petronas Twin Towers, reinforced by a branded hospitality component.
While the premium pricing and broader KLCC market dynamics may present challenges from an investment standpoint, the project’s differentiation and positioning provide a level of resilience.
It is best suited for buyers who prioritise lifestyle, prestige, and long-term asset quality.
In essence, CloutHaus Residences is less about affordability or yield-driven investment, and more about owning a piece of Kuala Lumpur’s most iconic urban landscape.

Orla Dorchester Collection by Omniyat · Palm Jumeirah, Dubai · JRE Dubai Projects Areas Developers Guides Insights Videos Global Advisory EN AED Agent login Home / UAE / Dubai / Orla Dorchester Collection On sale Omniyat Orla Dorchester Collection Palm Jumeirah , Dubai From AED 57,230,250 Handover Q4 2026 Enquire Brochure Overview Gallery Residences Payment Amenities Location Documents FAQ The Project From AED 57,230,250 Status On sale Handover Q4 2026 Size 7,352–10,527 sqft Residences 2 Construction 60% complete Furnishing Yes Service charge 45 AED/sqft Orla Dorchester Collection sits on Palm Jumeirah and is developed by Omniyat, a Dubai-based developer whose portfolio concentrates on ultra-prime residential.
The building holds two four-bedroom residences, both furnished and completing in Q4 2026, currently at 60 per cent construction progress.

# The tower and its position on Palm Jumeirah Palm Jumeirah is a consistent reference point for international buyers because its geography is legible: a contained, low-density island with direct sea frontage and a finite supply of genuinely large homes.

Orla Dorchester Collection occupies a beachfront position on the island, associating the Omniyat project with the Dorchester Collection brand, a hotel operator whose portfolio runs from 45 Park Lane in London to Le Meurice in Paris.
The building itself houses only two residences.
That figure defines the project more precisely than any description of the architecture.
At this scale, the comparison is not with apartment blocks but with private freehold properties that happen to sit within a managed structure.
Construction is 60 per cent complete, with handover scheduled for Q4 2026.
# Two residences: scale, layout and specification Both units are four-bedroom residences.
The smaller runs to 7,352 sq ft, priced at AED 57.23 million.
The larger reaches 10,527 sq ft, priced at AED 81.33 million.
These are not large apartments by Palm Jumeirah norms.
They are, in floor-area terms, closer to sizeable villas.
Both residences are delivered furnished.
Service charges are set at AED 45 per sq ft, which on the larger unit amounts to roughly AED 473,000 annually.
Buyers should account for that in their yield or cost-of-ownership modelling.
The developer's specification references Italian travertine and marble alongside design input from Yodezeen, an interiors practice with a recognisable body of work in high-end residential.
Kitchens are fully equipped with professional-grade appliances.
# Amenities within the building The amenity programme is extensive relative to the number of residences it serves.
A resident-only beach club with an indoor pool is the headline facility.
Beyond that: a spa with treatment rooms, salon and sauna; cycling and yoga studios; plunge pools and jacuzzis; a cigar lounge; a private cinema; and a library lounge.

The business centre includes two meeting rooms, a boardroom and a multi-functional events space, which suggests the building is designed to accommodate owners who work from home or host professionally.
There is also a pet grooming salon.
With two households sharing all of this, the ratio of amenity space to residents is, practically speaking, without comparison in the Dubai market.
# Distances and daily practicalities The Imperial Beach Club is four minutes by car at 1.2 km.
Al Nakheel Mall is five minutes away.
Redwood Montessori Nursery is an eight-minute drive at just over 5 km, relevant for families with younger children.
Dubai Marina Mall sits approximately 19 minutes west; the Burj Al Arab is 18 minutes south.
Dubai International Airport is 37.2 km, or around 35 minutes in normal traffic conditions.

The Palm's road connection to Sheikh Zayed Road means access to the broader city is direct, even if the island itself maintains a noticeably quieter register than the mainland neighbourhoods it overlooks.
# Who this project suits and where it sits in the market At between AED 57 and AED 81 million per unit, Orla Dorchester Collection targets a buyer who is not primarily optimising for yield.
The service charge alone exceeds what most Dubai investors would accept on a buy-to-let basis.
The relevant comparison is with titled mansions on the Palm's frond network or signature penthouses in buildings such as One at Palm Jumeirah, also by Omniyat.
The two-residence structure appeals to buyers who want the security and managed infrastructure of a building without sharing facilities with dozens of neighbours.
It functions, in effect, as a private compound with hotel-operator management underpinning it.
For a London or Singapore-based buyer seeking a Gulf base that requires minimal active management, that configuration has a clear logic.
The furnished delivery reinforces the same point: this is designed to be occupied immediately and maintained at a consistent standard without owner involvement.

A lushly landscaped deck features a large-scale infinity pool and a separate children's pool, while a private beach offers food and beverage service, attendants, loungers and umbrellas.

Every living space and bedroom carries high-end Armani/Casa fittings, from designed kitchens and bathrooms to metal profiles, skirting and spotlights, framed by generously proportioned ceiling heights.

Owners choose between two exclusive interior collections: the darker Bridge palette with natural stone, sukupira and oak, or the lighter Checkers palette with precious woods, exclusive lacquers and textured glass.

Kitchens arrive fully equipped, bathrooms feature the Armani/Casa Island Collection, and each residence includes built-in wardrobes, a maid's room, a guest bathroom and smart home control of climate and lighting.

Location description and benefits Palm Jumeirah is a luxurious community located on an artificial island that is shaped like a palm tree, with a trunk, fronds, and a crescent-shaped breakwater that surrounds the island.
The community is home to a variety of high-end residential properties, including apartments, villas, and townhouses, as well as some of the most luxurious hotels and resorts in Dubai.
The community is known for its stunning views of the Arabian Gulf, its pristine beaches, and its world-class amenities.

In addition to residential properties and hotels, Palm Jumeirah is home to a range of retail and dining options, including the iconic Atlantis, The Palm resort, which features an array of restaurants, bars, and entertainment venues.
The island also boasts a range of recreational activities, including water sports, beach clubs, and golf courses.

How to buy in Mexico Questions about MAYĀMAR Where is MAYĀMAR located in Puerto Vallarta?

MAYĀMAR is in Amapas, the hillside neighborhood directly above Puerto Vallarta's Romantic Zone and Los Muertos Beach, within walking distance of restaurants, galleries, nightlife and everyday services.
How much do residences at MAYĀMAR cost?
Pricing starts at $7,524,000 MXN ($396,000 USD), with premium residences and penthouses above $1,000,000 USD.
Price depends on tower, floor, layout and view exposure.
Availability and pricing change as the project sells, so request the live price list rather than relying on a published figure.
What type of residences does MAYĀMAR offer?
71 residences across two towers, from one bedroom plus Flex to two bedrooms plus Flex, with 802 to 2,486 square feet of interior space plus private terrace.
The Flex room works as a second bedroom, office or media room depending on how you use the residence.
Can a foreign buyer purchase at MAYĀMAR?
Yes.

Amapas sits inside Mexico's restricted zone, within 50 kilometers of the coast, so a foreign buyer holds title through a fideicomiso, a Mexican bank trust granted for renewable 50-year terms with full rights of use, rental, sale and inheritance.
On a Torre Sur pre-construction purchase the trust is usually constituted at delivery, when title transfers, and the purchase contract governs the period before that.
Our in-house team handles the trust, the notario público, escrow, and RFC and SAT registration.
How does the payment schedule work?
Torre Norte: 80% down, 20% on delivery.
Torre Sur: three payment plans, including 80% down and 20% on delivery at 30% off list for a limited time.
The exact schedule, the currency of the contract, and the clauses covering delays and penalties vary by project, so we review the full contract with every buyer before signing.
Request the current payment schedule for the residence you are considering.
What amenities are available at MAYĀMAR?
A rooftop lounge pool with ocean views, pet-friendly garden, spa, fitness room, concierge service, 24/7 security, parking with an EV charging option, and storage.
Can MAYĀMAR be used as a vacation rental?

Amapas draws strong short-term rental demand because of its position above the Romantic Zone, but rental use is governed by the condominium regime and house rules, which should be reviewed before you commit.
Owners who rent in Mexico register with the SAT, obtain an RFC, and collect and remit the lodging tax (ISH) and IVA.
We can share the regime documents and introduce established management options.
Why buy in Amapas rather than elsewhere in Puerto Vallarta?
Two structural reasons.
The terrain limits how much can be built, so supply stays constrained in a way flat neighborhoods do not, and elevated views above Los Muertos cannot be built out from below.
Add walkable access to the Romantic Zone, and you get a location that performs for full-time living, seasonal use and rental income at the same time.
How can I request current pricing, availability, or floor plans?
Use the MAYĀMAR request form.

We will send current pricing, the available residences by tower and floor, full floor plans, the payment schedule and the delivery timeline, and a Coldwell Banker La Costa agent will follow up directly.

This review covers the concept, location, the full unit line-up and prices (launch was from $224,776; from $235,995 per the 01.09.2026 price list), yield, owner costs and ownership, so you can judge whether it fits your investment goal.

Contents Project concept Location: the Layan area Units and layouts Dusit management and branded residences Infrastructure Prices, instalments, fees Price dynamics and the handover forecast Yield and rental Ownership What can be verified instead of reviews How the purchase works: steps Who it suits and pitfalls 1.
Project concept Layan Verde is a self-sufficient seaside district across 7.5 hectares with bionic eco-architecture: nature-inspired forms, lagoon pools, abundant greenery.
The “mini-city by the sea” concept implies its own infrastructure so essentials are within walking distance.
Scale — 774 residences .
It is worth understanding how this format differs from a typical Phuket new build.
A standard condo project is one or two buildings with a pool and a lobby, and a resident’s life happens “outside”: restaurants, shops and services have to be found in the surrounding area.

A 7.5-hectare district is built on a different logic: the developer writes a retail gallery, recreation and public spaces directly into the master plan, and the project becomes a destination in itself.

For an investor this has a direct monetary consequence: a tenant pays not only for square metres but for the environment around them — and here that environment belongs to the project itself, not to the neighbours.

The second layer of the concept is sustainability as a design decision rather than a marketing epithet: a pedestrian environment instead of a car-first one, greenery across the whole site, and water surfaces that lower the air temperature between buildings.
For Layan, positioned as the “quiet” alternative to the tourist clusters, this architecture is organic — the district doesn’t argue with the place, it amplifies it.
Location: the Layan area The project sits in Layan — a quiet, green area of west Phuket, about 700 metres from Layan Beach (roughly a 9-minute walk).
The beach is considered one of the cleanest and calmest on the island: it adjoins Sirinat National Park, with no loud beach clubs and no dense front-line development.
Bang Tao with the Laguna complex and the Boat Avenue retail cluster is nearby; the airport is about 20 minutes by car.
Layan is prized for two things that rarely come together: privacy today and growth potential as the area develops.
The north of the west coast is being built up later than the south, so genuinely few new projects exist near the beach — while demand for “quiet premium” from both buyers and tenants keeps growing.
For a deeper look at the area, see the Layan Beach guide and our review of Layan’s infrastructure .
🔗 Area comparison: Layan vs Bang Tao → · Surin vs Layan → 3.
Units and layouts The range runs from compact studios to penthouses with private pools.

Example of the entry unit from the sales launch: Parameter Studio B4-319 Area 36.18 m² (living+kitchen 25.87, bath 5.45, terrace 4.86) View Pool Launch price $224,776 ($235,650 with furniture) Ownership Leasehold The full line-up per the 01.09.2026 price list: Class Type Area Price from Premium Studio from 36.2 m² 7,833,125 THB ($235,995) Premium 1 bedroom from 51.9 m² $331,796 Premium 2 bedrooms from 100.5 m² $549,915 Premium 3 bedrooms from 152.7 m² $924,533 Luxury (ocean view) 1 bedroom from 102.1 m² $667,050 (no private pool) Luxury (ocean view) 2 bedrooms from 169.2 m² $1,225,967 (terrace pool) Luxury (ocean view) 3 bedrooms from 257.2 m² $1,806,665 Luxury (ocean view) 4 bedrooms from 393.1 m² $2,819,529 Luxury (ocean view) Penthouses, 4–5 bedrooms 528.2 / 656.0 m² $4,035,889 – $4,178,841 Studios work well for rental: a lower entry point and a higher return on invested capital — why that is so, we covered in studio vs one-bedroom on Phuket .

For renting you effectively need the furniture package (+$10,875 in the studio example): without it the unit won’t be accepted into the rental programme — how such packages work is in our furnishing package breakdown .
The ocean-view luxury line is a different product: large floor plans, private terrace pools, and a buyer choosing a residence for themselves rather than purely for yield.

Dusit management and branded residences The premium buildings and the on-site 5* hotel operate under Dusit International — a Thai hospitality operator with a nearly 80-year history and an international hotel network.
That places Layan Verde in the branded residences category, and for an owner this is not a brochure line but three practical consequences.
First, service standards : housekeeping, reception and the servicing of common areas and tenants run on the chain’s hotel procedures, not at the discretion of a local management company.
Second, a rental sales channel : the operator has its own guest base, loyalty programme and global booking systems — the unit earns occupancy beyond the open listing platforms.
Third, value protection : by global practice, branded residences sell and resell at a premium to non-branded peers in the same location — the brand acts as a quality guarantee for the next buyer.
The flip side is equally honest: hotel standards cost money, so operating fees in such projects run above the market average (see the fees section below), and unit usage rules follow the hotel model.
🔗 Every project of this class in the catalog: Phuket branded residences → 5.
Infrastructure Layan Verde’s eco-concept is built around lagoon pools , green zones and a pedestrian environment.

Among the declared infrastructure anchors: A community mall with a waterfall — a retail gallery inside the district: shops, cafés and services within walking distance of any building; An ocean club with sunset views — a club zone for residents and guests; Lagoon pools across the site — not one shared pool per building, but a system of water spaces the district plan is built around; A pedestrian environment and landscaping across the whole 7.5 hectares.
For the rental model this matters: a guest who doesn’t need to drive out for breakfast and dinner stays in the complex longer and returns more willingly — which lifts both occupancy and the rate.
The exact retail mix is confirmed against current project materials as construction progresses.

Prices, instalments, fees Line Value Price from $235,995 (01.09.2026 price list) Reservation 200,000 THB (~$6,011) Instalment 50% 50% + 5×10% every 6 months Instalment 35% 35% + 5×13% every 6 months 100% payment within 14 days Sinking fund 850 THB/m² one-time Leasehold registration 1.1% (every 30 years) Common area (CAM) 85 THB/m²/mo How to read this in practice.
The reservation locks the unit and the price — the standard first step of a Thai deal (what gets signed and when the deposit is refundable is in our reservation and deposit breakdown ).

Then a choice of two schemes: the 35% plan stretches payments and keeps more capital with you; the 50% plan reduces the number of payments; full payment within 14 days suits those who want to close at once.
Running costs are worth calculating before the purchase, not after.
For a ~36 m² studio the CAM fee comes to roughly 3,100 THB a month (about 37,000 THB a year), and the one-time sinking fund contribution to about 31,000 THB.
That is a normal level for a project with hotel infrastructure; how these fees work and what they pay for is in sinking fund and CAM fees .
🔗 Full deal estimate: Phuket taxes & fees → 7.
Price dynamics and the handover forecast Prices in Layan Verde move with construction — visibly so already: studios have risen from the launch $224,776 to $235,995 per the 01.09.2026 price list.
The mechanics are typical of quality off-plan : the developer raises the price list as readiness grows, and the bulk of the growth goes to early buyers.
Our forecast for capitalisation across the whole construction period is about +45% by the 2028 handover .

To be clear: this is a forecast, not a guarantee — it rests on the price dynamics inside the project, the shortage of new builds near Layan Beach, and the precedent of neighbouring Layan Green Park, where phase 1 grew roughly 100% from the sales launch to the completed complex ( case breakdown ).
The actual outcome depends on the market: see the island-wide picture in Phuket price trends 2026 .
🔗 Other under-construction projects to compare: New condos 2026–2028 → 8.

Yield and rental Income runs through a rental management programme : identical unit types are pooled into a rental pool , the pool’s revenue is cleared of operating costs, and the owner receives 60% of net profit — an owner net yield benchmark of ~8–10% a year.
Importantly, this is a distribution model, not a fixed rate: the actual figure depends on seasonal occupancy and the unit category.
At the construction stage, capital growth toward the 2028 handover is added to rental income — the main driver of total ROI on an early entry.
The mechanics work like this: instalments let you keep only part of your capital in the project, price growth accrues on the unit’s full value, and after handover the rental stream switches on.
The effective return on invested capital under this mechanic is higher than the headline figure — run your own scenario using the method in how to calculate ROI in Phuket .

🔗 How rental works: Rental management program → · Calculator Phase 1 of neighbouring Layan Green Park has operated since 2024 and carries a public guest score — the best available proxy for how this team manages a completed asset.
Ownership Apartments are available as freehold (within the foreign quota of 49% of the condominium’s area) or leasehold .

Leasehold is often the smarter entry: lower price, more payment options (no mandatory FET — the confirmation of foreign-currency inflow), fewer Thai-side formalities, and the right to convert to freehold later while quota remains.

A practical rule of thumb: if the unit is bought for yield and a possible resale within the project, leasehold solves the task more cheaply; if full “generational” ownership and inheritance without lease renewals matter, plan for freehold and check the remaining quota at booking — it gets used up as sales progress.
🔗 Breakdown: Freehold vs leasehold → · Foreigner ownership → 10.

What can be verified instead of reviews Layan Verde is under construction, so there are no resident or guest reviews yet — and that cuts both ways: any “I live here and love it” review you meet before 2028 is a red flag, not a signal.
What a buyer can actually check in 2026: The brand is legally protected.

The developer’s delivery record.
Phase 1 of neighbouring Layan Green Park — 248 units — was delivered in 2024 and sold out before completion; prices roughly doubled from launch.
That is the closest proxy for how this team executes, and it now runs as a hotel with a public guest score — see what the operating phase reveals .
Construction progress.
The site is 700 m from Layan Beach and open to visits; we send current progress photos and reports on request.
The paperwork.
EIA status, land title, lease/sale agreements — all checkable before any money moves.
What to verify and how is in due diligence on Phuket property .

Forgetting the furniture package in a rental budget.

In the Layan area on west Phuket, about 700 metres from Layan Beach — one of the quietest and cleanest on the island.

Handover is scheduled for 2028.
The project comprises 774 residences.
Buying at the construction stage gives instalments and capital-growth potential toward handover.
What rental yield does Layan Verde offer?
The benchmark is an owner net yield of ~8–10% via the rental pool (the owner receives 60% of the pool’s net profit).
The exact figure is calculated per unit.
Where can I find reviews of Layan Verde?
The project is under construction (handover 2028), so guest or resident reviews don’t exist yet — treat any “resident review” you meet online with suspicion.

261113516, held by VillaCarte Holding), construction progress on site visits, and the developer’s track record — phase 1 of neighbouring Layan Green Park (248 units) was delivered in 2024 and sold out before completion.

Freehold (within the 49% foreign quota) and leasehold.

The premium buildings and the on-site 5* hotel operate under Dusit International — a Thai hospitality operator with an international network.
For an owner that means hotel-grade service standards and a recognisable brand that supports rental rates.
What are the ongoing owner costs?
Three items are disclosed: a CAM fee (common-area maintenance) of 85 THB/m² per month, a one-time sinking fund of 850 THB/m², and for leasehold a registration fee of 1.1% every 30 years.
For a ~36 m² studio the CAM fee is roughly 3,100 THB per month.

Studios have risen from the launch price of $224,776 to $235,995 per the 01.09.2026 price list — growth tracks construction progress.

What and how far away is the nearest Beach from Terra Mare Beach Villas?

How can foreigners own houses at Terra Mare Beach Villas?
The building (the bricks and mortar) can be owned by a non-Thai national outright in their name in what is called the house registry, which secures ownership indefinitely of the structure.
In Thailand, non-Thai nationals cannot own land outright in their name.
Land can be controlled through either a Thai Company or a long-term registered lease.
The longest registered lease term by Thai law is 30 years, and most developers will offer 3 terms for a total of 90 years.
How does Leasehold work - is it safe?
A 30-year lease period is legally protected under Thai law and ownership cannot be disrupted.
It is common for developers to offer an additional two terms of 30 contractually obligating a total of 90 years.
Prior to purchasing a leasehold property, it is important to secure a copy of the lease agreement or get further clarity on these three points: - Who is the lessor?
(an individual or a Thai Company) Securing a lease from a Thai Company offers much more security than a private individual.
- Do I have voting rights as a Lessee?
(Some lease contracts do not allow lessee to have voting rights) - Is there a succession clause in the lease agreement that will allow inheritance of the lease?

Saobraćajno-tehnički uslovi — Sekretarijat opštine Bar, u sastavu istog dokumenta: jedan kolski ulaz i izlaz na javnu saobraćajnicu i obavezan projekat saobraćaja i signalizacije.
Saglasnost na idejno rješenje — rješenje Službe glavnog gradskog arhitekte opštine Bar br.
Investitor — DOO Novokub, projektant — DOO Univerzal-Rai.
Saglasna spratnost je Po+P+2; najviša etaža se odobrava u toku gradnje, u okviru onoga što urbanističko-tehnički uslovi dozvoljavaju.
Tehnički uslovi priključenja — DOO Vodovod i kanalizacija, Bar: vodosnabdijevanje i kanalizacija.
Seizmika — proračun konstrukcije na IX stepen MCS skale, što je izričit zahtjev urbanističko-tehničkih uslova za ovu lokaciju.
Kopije dokumenata objavljene su na naslovnoj strani sajta.
Svaki se provjerava po broju kod organa koji ga je izdao, a list nepokretnosti za parcelu 1265/2 KO Tomba svako može sam naručiti u Upravi za nekretnine.
Plaćanje i odloženo plaćanje Moguće je plaćanje na rate tokom gradnje.
Uslovi su individualni i zavise od stana i faze u kojoj ulazite u projekat.
Pišite nam — napravićemo plan plaćanja za konkretan stan.
Šta kupac iz Srbije stvarno plaća i mora da uradi?
Da.

Notarska tarifa je po skali: do 19.999,99 € - 180 €; 20.000-40.000 € - 250 €; 40.000-60.000 € - 350 €; 60.000-80.000 € - 420 €; 80.000-120.000 € - 480 €; iznad toga +13 € za svakih narednih 15.000 €, maksimalno 8.000 €, sve uvećano za PDV, plaća kupac.
banke ne primaju gotovinu od 10.000 € i više za promet nekretnina (Zakon o sprečavanju pranja novca) - plaćanje ide bankovnim putem.
Kupcu treba PIB u Crnoj Gori; kupovina je moguća i preko punomoćnika.
Registracija ugovora traje oko 15 dana, upis u katastar - još 2-4 nedelje.
Kako detaljno proveriti pravnu čistoću objekta pre kupovine - pogledajte poseban vodič .
Koliko košta stan u Zen Gardensu?
<!-- T004 --> Cijene počinju od 66.000 € i zavise od površine, sprata i pogleda.
Parking mjesto je uključeno.
Za poređenje: u drugom kvartalu 2026.
prosječna cijena kvadrata u Baru bila je 2.797 €, što je rast od 13,3 % na godišnjem nivou — vidjeti koliko košta stan u Crnoj Gori 2026.
Ko ne želi odmah da obezbedi celu sumu: strani državljani u Crnoj Gori mogu da koriste i stambeni kredit za strance .
Kada počinje i kada se završava gradnja?
Gradnja počinje 1.
Do izlaska na teren traje faza projektovanja i pribavljanja dozvola.
Ima li parkinga i ostava?
Podzemna garaža ima mjesto za svaki od 24 stana i još 9 mjesta za goste.
U podzemnom nivou su ostave (keleri) za sezonske stvari i sportsku opremu.
Tu su i prostorija za dječja kolica i bicikl stanica i punjači za električne trotinete i skutere.
Šta plaća kupac pri kupovini, i od kada sledi pravo na boravak?
Porez na prenos nepokretnosti: 3% do 150.000 €; 4.500 € + 5% do 500.000 €; 22.000 € + 6% iznad toga (prijava u roku od 15 dana, porez se plaća u roku od 15 dana od rešenja).

Overview About Azure Heights Azure Heights is a boutique development of 12 apartments in Ibragg, one of the quietest and most sought-after residential areas of Swieqi.
Set on the heights above St Julian’s, it pairs contemporary architecture with a calm, green neighbourhood, and it is designed, built and sold directly by LJ Projects, with no agency in between.
The homes range from a 61 m² one-bedroom maisonette to a 159 m² two-bedroom maisonette at ground level.
The top floor is made up of two 2-bedroom penthouses of 111 m² and 135 m², each with its own private rooftop pool and panoramic views over Swieqi (see the roof plans in the table above).

Every unit is planned around open-plan living, with large double-glazed apertures that bring natural light deep into the interiors, and finishes chosen to last: laser-cut high-grade tiles, travertine sills and gypsum soffits with ambient lighting.

Ibragg feels peaceful, yet daily life is on the doorstep: supermarkets, pharmacies, cafés and restaurants, schools, a sports club, a shopping mall and bus routes are all nearby, and the beach and the business and leisure hubs of St Julian’s and Sliema are a short drive away.
Completion is scheduled for December 2027 (Planning Authority permit PA/2539/25).
Lock-up garages can be added to your purchase, ask us about availability.

Posted in Also on our Radar Emaar Misr signs EGP 14 bn in construction contracts for Marassi Red Sea Plus: Banque Misr moves to shut down sukuk subsidiary after no revenue, tighter CBE guardrails by The Enterprise Company Egypt Edition 15 September 2026 15 September 2026 Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share on LinkedIn (Opens in new window) LinkedIn Share on Mail (Opens in new window) Mail Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on WhatsApp (Opens in new window) WhatsApp Share Open in new tab --> Copy Link Facebook --> X --> LinkedIn --> WhatsApp --> Read Full Issue Emaar Misr handed EGP 14 bn in construction contracts to Rowad Modern Engineering and Innovo Group to build residential units under the first phase of its Marassi Red Sea project , according to a press release (pdf) .
Rowad will build 675 villas and townhouses across roughly 150k sqm in the Infinity Beach zone, while Innovo will take on around 220 villas across roughly 100k sqm for Island Living.
The units in this first phase are set for handover in 2029.

What the first phase looks like: The two villa packages join an earlier EGP 5.7 bn contract (pdf) that Emaar already awarded to Arabian Construction Company for 32 residential buildings (750 units) around the project’s marina.
That brings the tally of signed contracts for the first phase to around EGP 20 bn so far.
The project behind the numbers: Marassi Red Sea is a 2.4k-feddan integrated resort on the Red Sea coast, about 30 minutes from Hurghada International Airport.
Emaar Misr and Saudi-owned Citystars Properties (via its Golden Coast affiliate) signed the EGP 900 bn development agreement in September 2025.
The masterplan (pdf) calls for 12 luxury hotels, three marinas, 500-plus retail and dining outlets, swimmable lagoons, and the Marassi Wonders entertainment zone.
Phase 1 sales have already topped EGP 80 bn , according to Chairman Mohamed Alabbar, and Phase 2 is now on the market.

Four years, zero revenue Banque Misr is moving to liquidate its Misr for Sukuk subsidiary after the company failed to generate any revenue since its incorporation in late 2022 , with the central bank’s July 2026 directive requiring banks to secure prior approval before participating in sukuk issuances compounding the challenges, Asharq Business reports, citing two unnamed sources.
The company is expected to put the liquidation proposal before its general assembly this month, then work through the regulatory steps.
About the company: Misr Sukuk was set up with EGP 10 mn in capital, with 80% owned by Banque Misr and the rest split evenly between Nasser Social Bank and the National Investment Bank.
The Financial Regulatory Authority greenlit the company in March 2023, licensing it to issue sukuk.

IN CONTEXT- Banks are facing tighter guardrails around sukuk since July, when the central bank told lenders they need its approval before taking part in any sukuk issuances — part of a broader push to rein in bank exposure to non-bank financiers.
Those restrictions made it even harder for Misr for Sukuk to operate, one of the sources said.

Impact capital incoming Germany-based impact investor Finance in Motion wants to add some USD 30-50 mn to its Egypt book by year-end , Regional Director Mohamed Morsy tells Al Borsa , taking the firm’s 2026 disbursements in the country to USD 50-70 mn.

The money will come through two vehicles it advises: Sanad , which provides capital to financial institutions for small-business on-lending, and the Green for Growth Fund , which finances clean energy and efficiency projects, Morsy says.
Three non-bank lenders are already under review — one in consumer finance, one in SME lending, and one in microfinance — after the firm backed Beltone Leasing and Factoring and Tasheel last year.

Finance in Motion has also been lending directly to corporates rather than through intermediaries — which have historically made up some 90% of its book — since 2024 , when Sanad put USD 4.5 mn into crop trader Capital Agro in its first direct transaction here.
A family car from the van maker General Misr — Chinese automaker Shineray’s exclusive agent in Egypt — plans to begin local assembly of the SWM G03F family car in 1Q 2027 , Al Mal reports.

Assembly will take place at Advanced Transportation Group’s (ATG) plants in the 10th of Ramadan Industrial Zone, where General Misr currently builds Shineray vans, with a dedicated 40k sqm factory planned for the same zone.
The move expands General Misr beyond the Shineray X30 van, X30 Cargo, and T-Series pickup — its current lineup — into the passenger car segment.
IN CONTEXT- General Misr said in November 2025 it would import the G03F and a second SWM model — the G05 — through mid-2026 before shifting one to local assembly in 2H 2026.
The timeline looks like it has slipped to 1Q 2027.
The company said it moved roughly 2k Shineray vans in 2025 and is targeting 3.5k units in 2026, with a USD 20 mn investment behind a planned capacity of 5k vehicles a year.
It’s also studying joining Egypt’s Automotive Industry Development Program (AIDP) (min.
10k units/year required) and plans to export to Africa.

Why it matters: This is Shineray’s first passenger car push in Egypt and will face intense competition from other Chinese manufacturers here — BYD, MG, Chery, Changan, and Geely — which already assemble locally and captured 37-38% of Egypt’s passenger car market in 2025 .
If General Misr prices the G03F competitively and hits its AIDP production targets, Egypt could become Shineray’s African export hub.
The Chinese parent is planning four African assembly plants.

Fawry goes clinical Fawry-DMS integration incoming: Fawry partnered with DMS , a software provider for healthcare, financial, and industrial companies, to integrate Fawry Business POS terminals directly into DMS’ medical management systems, according to a press release (pdf) .

Under the integration, a transaction entered at a hospital cashier’s screen sends the amount straight to Fawry, and once payment clears, the status updates automatically back in DMS’ system, cutting out manual re-entry between the two.
REMEMBER- Fawry was already in the healthcare game.
In May , Fawry Healthcare-TreMed became the market’s first third-party healthcare administrator, which is an operational middleman between patients, healthcare providers, and ins.
companies — managing claim processing, provider networks, and ins.
paperwork.

Common questions The key points before you enquire.
What do 1+1 and 3+1 mean?
The first number is the bedrooms, the one behind it is the living room with an open kitchen.
So a 1+1 has one bedroom and a living room, a 3+1 has three bedrooms and a living room.
That is how apartments are described in Turkey.
Which documents will I receive?
Everything we hold, and you are told what is still missing.
For Milan Towers we request the current floor plans and the current price list from the developer once it is clear which types are relevant for you.
Where an image is a visualisation, it says so.
What does an apartment cost?
The price depends on type, floor and orientation.
The entry level is 225,000 euros.
You get binding prices for the units that suit you together with the current documents.
Is the apartment furnished?
No furnishing package exists for Milan Towers.
What belongs to the fit-out is set out in the documents for the unit you choose.
Can I use the apartment myself?
It is your apartment.
You go there whenever you want, with no booking, no seasonal rates and without asking anyone.
If you want to let it during the time you are not there, you can.
But you never have to.
Can H24 let my apartment?
Yes.
Marketing, bookings, guests and billing run through our office in Germany, cleaning and maintenance on site.
This is our day job, we run our own hotels.
Taking part is not required.
Are the images photographs?
Partly.
The site photographs are real and labelled as such on the image.
The views of the finished towers are visualisations, and that is on the image too.
We do not blur the two.
Who sells the apartment?
H24 is not the seller.
The specific selling entity and all contract details are identified in the current documents for the selected unit.

Positioned for both slope access and village convenience, the project combines a rare ski-in, ski-out location with contemporary Japanese design, mountain views, and the operational credibility of the Miru Collection hospitality brand.

A Rare New Ski-in Ski-out Address in Central Hakuba Miru Residences Hakuba brings together vital qualities that are increasingly difficult to find in a single project: genuine ski-in, ski-out access, a central village setting, and a design concept rooted in the landscape of Hakuba itself.
Located beside the Happo-one lift area and near the Hakuba Olympic ski jump, the development is positioned for both owner enjoyment and guest convenience.
Residents can access the slopes directly from the hotel, while Hakuba Village’s restaurants, cafés and services are close at hand.
For buyers looking at Hakuba’s next wave of resort property, Miru Residences Hakuba stands out for its location, architectural identity, and hospitality-led approach.

Ski-in, ski-out access beside the Happo-one lift Central Hakuba location near restaurants, shops and village amenities Fully furnished residences with large picture windows Managed by Miru Collection, operator of boutique hotels and lodges Strong lifestyle and rental appeal in one of Japan’s leading alpine markets Only 3 hours from Tokyo by train and bus Prime Ski-in, Ski-out Location at Happo-one Miru Residences Hakuba sits directly beside the Happo-one lift area.
That means true slope-side convenience for owners and guests, while still being moments from Hakuba’s restaurants, cafés and village amenities.

Happo-one is one of Hakuba Valley’s most established and best-known ski areas, offering a 1,070m vertical drop, 11m annual snowfall, and 1998 Olympic terrain best suited for intermediate-to-advanced skiers.
It features excellent, steep grooming and long, wide runs.
The resort is known for spectacular Japanese Alps views, lively base villages, and some of the best powder snow in Japan.

It’s also frequently described as the valley’s largest and most central resort, which is a big part of why slope-side real estate here is so tightly held—and why improvements to base-area access matter.
With the new gondola planned for 2027 , the Happo-one base is set to become even more efficient for daily mountain access.
Ski-in, ski-out homes in the Hakuba Valley are exceptionally limited, particularly in central, walkable locations like this.
Photos (8) The Residences Design inspired by Hakuba The architecture is shaped by Hakuba’s ridgelines and forest textures, with a contemporary Japanese aesthetic that feels grounded in place.
Large picture windows are a defining feature, framing the landscape across the seasons.

Fully furnished, guest-ready interiors Fully furnished, fully appointed residences Large picture windows with mountain and forest outlooks Premium appliances, heating and air-conditioning Practical layouts suited to both owner use and guest stays Shared spaces designed for mountain living The building includes a welcoming lobby and lounge, reception, a dedicated ski room, and a grab-and-go refreshment area—supporting a more serviced alpine residence experience.
Value and rental appeal With prices starting from around 80m JPY, Miru Residences Hakuba offers a compelling entry point for a slope-side address in central Hakuba.

A varied unit mix creates attractive options for a wide range of buyers—from young couples looking for an easy, lock-up-and-leave base, through to families wanting more space and flexibility—while the location and fully managed model are designed to support strong guest demand throughout the year.

Unit types (from): Studios: 34 sqm 1-bedroom: 58 sqm 2-bedroom: 69 sqm 3-bedroom: 94 sqm Designed with rental flexibility in mind The 2- and 3-bedroom residences are dual key, allowing the space to be configured for different group sizes.
This added versatility should increase year-round occupancy by widening the range of stays the residences can accommodate, depending on demand at different times of the year.

What supports rental appeal Happo-one base-area location with true ski-in, ski-out access Central Hakuba convenience for dining, services and après Fully furnished, guest-ready specification Fully managed operations for hands-off ownership A unit mix suited to couples, friends and family groups year-round Photos (6) Why Hakuba Hakuba is one of Japan’s most recognised alpine destinations, known for reliable winter snow, dramatic scenery and a growing year-round tourism profile.
In the green season, it becomes a highland base for hiking, cycling and outdoor pursuits, widening its appeal beyond the ski months.

With easy access from Tokyo (around 3 hours by train and bus) and limited supply of prime, lift-adjacent property, interest from both lifestyle buyers and investors has accelerated in recent years—particularly for well-located, professionally managed residences.
The Team Miru Residences Hakuba is backed by a team with development, asset management and hospitality experience in Japan and internationally.
The project involves The SHC Group and Ecclesia Asset Management, alongside Miru Collection as the operating brand—bringing a hospitality-led approach to owner and guest experience.

SHC Group are behind the highly regarded Miru Kyoto and Miru Niseko and Ecclesia Asset Management brought projects like the Wander Tokyo (now the Four Points Flex Shibuya) and the Far East Village Honmachi and Namba.
Miru Collection operates boutique hospitality properties in destinations including Niseko, Kyoto and Amami, with additional expansion underway.
This operational background is a key part of the project’s fully managed positioning.

Architect: Kei Takeuchi Architect & Associates Miru Residences Hakuba is designed by Kei Takeuchi Architect & Associates, an architectural practice with experience delivering residential and mixed-use projects in Japan and overseas.

The studio’s relevant project references include Hillpeak Tokiwamatsu (Tokyo) and WITH HARAJUKU (Tokyo), as well as The Crest Condo (Singapore)—a track record that adds real depth and credibility to the team behind the design.

O Boavista Tower é um novo projeto residencial concebido para marcar a paisagem da Avenida da Boavista, conjugando arquitetura contemporânea, conforto, localização e uma ampla oferta de espaços comuns.
O empreendimento desenvolve-se em dois edifícios, destacando-se uma torre residencial com 21 pisos, e contará com um total de 249 frações.

Estão disponíveis diferentes soluções habitacionais: • T1 Smart • T2 Smart • T2 O projeto integra mais de 1.000 m² de espaços exteriores e mais de 500 m² dedicados a comodidades, proporcionando aos residentes espaços pensados para trabalhar, relaxar, conviver e cuidar do bem-estar.

PRINCIPAIS COMODIDADES PREVISTAS • Rooftop panorâmico • Terraços panorâmicos • Jardim comum • Ginásio • Coworking • Sala de convívio • Sala de podcast • Estacionamento privativo • Carregamento para veículos elétricos • Bicicletário Mais do que uma solução habitacional, o Boavista Tower foi concebido para proporcionar uma experiência residencial adaptada às exigências da vida contemporânea.
Os espaços de coworking previstos permitirão conciliar a atividade profissional com a comodidade de trabalhar perto de casa.
O ginásio, os jardins e as áreas de convívio oferecerão alternativas para o bem-estar e os momentos de lazer.
O rooftop e os terraços panorâmicos constituem elementos diferenciadores do projeto, proporcionando espaços comuns para desfrutar de momentos de descontração e da envolvente urbana.
A sala de podcast acrescentará uma comodidade pouco habitual num empreendimento residencial, especialmente interessante para profissionais ligados à comunicação e à criação de conteúdos.
Esta combinação de espaços reforça a versatilidade do Boavista Tower, tornando-o uma opção a considerar tanto para habitação própria como para investimento.

APARTAMENTOS TOTALMENTE EQUIPADOS As frações serão entregues com cozinha equipada com eletrodomésticos BOSCH ou equivalente, incluindo: • Forno com função Air Fry • Placa de indução • Micro-ondas • Exaustor • Máquina de lavar loiça integrável • Máquina de lavar e secar roupa • Combinado integrável Está também prevista bomba de calor elétrica para águas quentes sanitárias e instalação de sistema de ar condicionado.
Nos interiores destacam-se ainda o pavimento flutuante AC5, iluminação indireta em LED e caixilharia de alumínio com corte térmico, tipo Cortizo ou equivalente.
As instalações sanitárias incluem loiças suspensas Sanindusa ou equivalente, misturadoras BRUMA ou equivalente, móvel suspenso, espelho com sistema antiembaciamento e base de duche.

Quais as informações que recolhemos?
Solicitamos informações de identificação quando pede um serviço, responde a um inquérito, troca correspondência connosco ou participa em determinadas outras atividades.
Se não quiser fornecer as informações pessoais solicitadas, poderá não conseguir concluir a transação.
Da mesma forma, quando visita os nossos Websites, recolhemos informações conhecidas como “clickstreams” (endereço IP, nome do domínio, etc.).
Estas informações, combinadas com os dados que nos facultou, permitem-nos personalizar melhor as suas visitas.
Com que fim usamos as informações que recolhemos?
- Para lhe fornecer informações sobre atualizações de imóveis, novos imóveis, newsletters e e-mails.
- Para lhe disponibilizar outras informações que possam ser do seu interesse.
Como protegemos as suas informações pessoais?
Para garantir a segurança das suas informações pessoais, estabelecemos uma série de medidas de segurança e proteções.

As suas informações pessoais são guardadas em redes seguras, não obstante estas medidas, quando faculta informações pessoais na Internet existe sempre um risco de que estas possam ser intercetadas e usadas por terceiros fora do nosso controlo.
Fazemos todos os esforços para proteger as suas informações pessoais e a sua privacidade, no entanto não podemos garantir a segurança das informações que disponibilize através da Internet.
Quem tem acesso a essas informações pessoais e até que ponto?
Além da nossa empresa e para os efeitos acima descritos, não vendemos, trocamos ou transferimos a terceiros as suas informações pessoais, sob forma alguma.
Contudo, as suas informações pessoais podem ser dadas a conhecer a empresas por nós subcontratadas para a realização de determinados serviços.
Podem igualmente ser usadas para fornecer assistência técnica.
Em quaisquer dos casos, exigimos que tais empresas subcontratadas mantenham as informações pessoais dos nossos clientes seguras e confidenciais.
Exigimos também que estes fornecedores usem as informações pessoais apenas em nome da Conquisturbana, Lda AMI: 24898.
Em qualquer altura, poderá optar por não permitir a partilha das suas informações pessoais com terceiros.
Tal pedido pode ser efectuado através da nossa página Internet na secção de contactos ou através do envio de um e-mail.
Links / Cookies Por forma a melhorar os serviços oferecidos, poderemos incluir links para Websites de terceiros.
A Conquisturbana, Lda AMI: 24898 não se responsabiliza pelas práticas de privacidade de tais Websites.
Recomendamos que leia as respetivas declarações de privacidade, pois poderão ser diferentes da nossa.
Os Websites da Conquisturbana, Lda AMI: 24898 poderão utilizar a tecnologia amplamente conhecida na indústria como “cookies”.
Um cookie é um ficheiro de texto único que um Website envia para o software do seu navegador (browser).
Se não desejar que instalemos cookies no seu navegador (browser) poderá definir o mesmo para rejeitar cookies.
A rejeição de cookies poderá afetar a sua capacidade de utilizar alguns dos serviços no nosso website.
A Conquisturbana, Lda AMI: 24898 também utiliza cookies para rastrear as visitas aos nossos Websites.
As informações recolhidas desta forma ajudam-nos a otimizar o conteúdo dos Websites, a navegação nos mesmos e o seu desempenho.

Alterações à política de privacidade No futuro, poderemos optar por modificar ou alterar a política de privacidade aqui descrita, quer devido a alterações na legislação, quer por forma a abranger novos desenvolvimentos da Internet.
Por este motivo, reservamo-nos o direito de efetuar quaisquer alterações e recomendamos que visite o nosso Website regularmente para destas alterações tomar conhecimento.
Quem administra as informações pessoais?
Tanto os nossos Websites como as informações recolhidas são administradas e controladas pela Conquisturbana, Lda AMI: 24898.

A Conquisturbana, Lda AMI: 24898 tem os seus servidores localizados em Portugal Continental, oferecendo garantias suficientes relativamente à proteção das suas informações pessoais sendo as mesmas administradas em conformidade com a legislação atual relativa à proteção das informações pessoais, assim como esta política de privacidade.

At Aro Residences, nature, urban living and the Costa Brava come together in a residential development designed to make everyday life more enjoyable, with comfortable living spaces and outdoor areas that extend your home.
Enjoy: Communal swimming pool.
Landscaped communal areas.
Children’s play area.
Ground-floor apartments with private gardens and penthouses with spacious terraces.
The development offers 2- and 3-bedroom homes, with a range of layouts, including properties with large terraces and ground-floor apartments with private gardens.

The project incorporates solutions designed to improve energy efficiency and wellbeing, including aerothermal heating, LED lighting in communal areas, high-performance windows and doors, thermal and acoustic insulation, water-efficient sanitary fittings, and provision for electric vehicle charging.
