What is actually being built at 300 Biscayne The Waldorf Astoria Hotel & Residences Miami is a 100-story, 1,049-foot tower at 300 Biscayne Boulevard in Downtown Miami (Florida YIMBY, 27 August 2026).

Florida YIMBY calls it Florida’s first supertall and, in June 2024, described it as the tallest residential building south of New York City; the developer’s website says it will be the tallest hotel and residential tower south of Manhattan.
The programme is 387 private condominium residences and 205 hotel guestrooms and suites according to Florida YIMBY (23 June 2024, 25 February 2026 and 27 August 2026).
The developer’s own website says 360 branded luxury residences (read 24 September 2026), and Florida Trend (7 August 2026) also reports 360 condos alongside 205 hotel rooms and suites.
I have not found a source that says why the counts differ or which is current, so confirm the count in the offering documents you are given.
The design is nine offset glass cubes .
Florida YIMBY (23 June 2024 and 27 August 2026) and Florida Trend (7 August 2026) each count nine, and Florida Trend says the first three cubes are the hotel and the top six are the condominium.

Florida YIMBY’s 25 February 2026 update instead referred to “the sixth of the tower’s ten stacked cubic volumes” ; its 27 August 2026 update, the latest I found, describes eight of nine cubes as structurally legible.
I have not found a source that explains the difference.

By the credits reported, the tower is designed by Sieger Suarez Architects in collaboration with Carlos Ott , with interiors by BAMO ; the developers are Property Markets Group and Greybrook Realty Partners , with Mohari Hospitality, S2 Development and Hilton ; and the general contractor is John Moriarty & Associates (Florida YIMBY, 27 August 2026).

The developer’s website disclaimer (read 24 September 2026) says the Residences are not owned, developed or sold by Hilton, and that the Waldorf Astoria name is used under a limited, non-exclusive licence from Hilton that may be terminated or may expire without renewal.
The tower is on Biscayne Boulevard.
Florida Trend (7 August 2026) describes the site as a parcel opposite Bayfront Park with an unobstructed view of Biscayne Bay and Miami Beach.
Downtown Miami.
The Waldorf Astoria site sits on Biscayne Boulevard opposite Bayfront Park.

Where construction stands The concrete superstructure passed the 50th floor in December 2025 (Miami New Times, 12 August 2026) and the 60th floor by 25 February 2026 , when Florida YIMBY reported crews averaging approximately one floor every ten days.
Florida Trend, in a feature published 7 August 2026, described the highest floor built in May 2026 as the 72nd and said a new story was poured about once a week.
In its statement to Miami New Times (12 August 2026), PMG said the tower was “now surpassing 870 feet” .
Latest report: level 85 of 100.

On 27 August 2026 Florida YIMBY reported that the superstructure had reached level 85, citing a post dated 23 August 2026, with concrete work begun on the ninth and final cube and curtain wall installation progressed through the seventh cube.
It also reports a new site banner advertising that the tower will top off “this winter”, and about 25 additional levels in roughly six months since its February report.
Capform is delivering the concrete scope under general contractor John Moriarty & Associates.

In June 2024 the development secured a $668,000,000 construction loan from Bank OZK and Related Fund Management , which Florida YIMBY (23 June 2024) reported as the largest ever for a residential condominium development in Florida.
PMG told Miami New Times (12 August 2026) that the project is “well over 90% sold” , with remaining inventory limited to Sky Collection residences.

PMG’s managing partner told Florida Trend (feature of 7 August 2026) that, as of May 2026, sales were “just shy of a billion” dollars with 26 units remaining, and that buyers on average put down a 40% deposit; Florida Trend reports condo prices from $3.5 million to $50 million.
These are developer statements: a sell-through figure describes contracts signed and deposits taken, not closings, and I have not found an independent count.

The assemblage’s recorded sale history (county record, 24 September 2026): a 1 April 2004 deed at $16,500,000 and a 5 May 2005 deed at $31,750,000 , both flagged qualified and both recorded as deeds including more than one parcel, appear on all five Block 83 folios I pulled; a 1 November 1982 deed at $2,500,000 , also qualified and multi-parcel, appears on the lot 16 folio and on folio 01-0108-030-1040.
Then, on 7 November 2014 , a deed at $80,000,000 .
That 2014 deed carries the county classification “Trustees in bankruptcy, executors or guardians” and is flagged unqualified .
It is a single county classification code covering several situations — a bankruptcy trustee, an executor of an estate, a guardian — and it does not say which one applied.
Miami New Times (12 August 2026) reports that PMG acquired the site for $80 million in 2014 through a court-ordered sale following years of receivership litigation, rather than a bankruptcy sale.
What the county record itself establishes is the code, the date and the amount.
What I would verify before signing Pre-construction diligence at this level is short, specific and mostly about documents rather than renderings.
The delivery date in your own contract.
Not the marketing date, not the date on any page including this one.
Find the outside date, what happens if it passes, and what notice the developer owes you.
Given the range of dates in the table above, this is the single highest-value thing to read.
The deposit schedule and where the money sits.
PMG’s managing partner told Florida Trend (7 August 2026) that buyers on average put down a 40% deposit.
Confirm your own schedule, and confirm in the contract and offering circular how much of your deposit is held in escrow and how much the developer may use for construction.
What “well over 90% sold” is measuring.
Ask whether that is reservations, executed contracts or closings, and ask for it in writing.
It is a reasonable question and the answer tells you something either way.
The hotel-residential relationship.
This is a Waldorf Astoria hotel and a condominium sharing one tower, and the documents that split shared costs between them are worth reading before you buy rather than after.
The Real Deal (5 August 2026) describes disputes between unit owners and commercial-space owners at a number of South Florida condo-hotels.
Read the declaration’s allocation of common expenses and any shared-facilities agreement, and ask specifically how hotel-side costs can reach residential owners.
A note on the developer, stated as record rather than as a view.

The Real Deal reported on 5 August 2026 that affiliates of PMG and the condominium association at a different PMG building — the Elser Hotel & Residences at 398 NE 5th Street, a 49-story, 646-unit condo-hotel that PMG completed in 2022 — had sued each other in July and August 2026: the association on 6 July (assessments and the governing documents) and 24 July (breach of contract), and PMG affiliates on 31 July and 2 August.

The association alleges that a PMG affiliate breached a November 2025 settlement over parking-garage revenue and operator approval; the PMG affiliate alleges, among other things, that the association is withholding roughly $773,000 in hotel management fees and billing quarterly assessments at the 2025 rate.

The association’s board president told The Real Deal that the $773,000 figure reflects collected receivables and that the PMG affiliate owes the association money, and a statement on behalf of the PMG affiliate said it strongly disputes the association’s claims about the parking operator.
These are allegations in complaints, not findings.

The article does not involve the Waldorf Astoria project ; I include it because it is on the public record, concerns the same developer and concerns the hotel-versus-association cost structure a buyer here should be reading about.
Who this building suits.
A buyer who wants a branded, serviced residence in a landmark tower, who is comfortable with a 2028 horizon, and who is buying to hold.
Who it suits badly: anyone whose plan needs the keys before 2028, anyone underwriting a resale before completion, and anyone who has not read the shared-facilities documents.

And if you are already holding a contract here and considering an assignment, every buyer can see the same completion-date history you can, so I would price the file against that rather than against the original 2025 marketing.

Can I sell before or at delivery?
It depends on your purchase agreement.

Before closing, selling usually means assigning your contract to a new buyer, which developers often allow only with their written consent and sometimes for a fee, so read the assignment clause first.
After closing it is an ordinary resale, priced against what similar homes in the building and nearby have actually closed for.

Centum Real Estate launches affordable housing project in Kasarani, units priced from Sh1.9mn – Capital FM Skip to content Africa News Politics NATIONAL Counties Business Economy Investments in Africa Markets Technology Lifestyle The Good Life Cafe Dating Living The Lowdown WhatsON Sports World Cup 2026 Football Basketball Athletics English Premier League Kenyan Premier League Rugby Golf Sustainability Op-Eds World Search Dark mode Live Search articles Search Africa News Politics NATIONAL Counties Business Economy Investments in Africa Markets Technology Lifestyle The Good Life Cafe Dating Living The Lowdown WhatsON Sports World Cup 2026 Football Basketball Athletics English Premier League Kenyan Premier League Rugby Golf Sustainability Op-Eds World × Live radio ▶ ⏸ Play 98.4 Capital FM The Jam June & Martin Volume control × Centum Real Estate launches affordable housing project in Kasarani, units priced from Sh1.9mn By: "> --> By: MARGARET NJUGUNAH | 24th Aug 2020 | 3 min read Listen COURTESY NAIROBI, Kenya, Aug 24 – Centum Real Estate has announced the launch of a new 268-unit affordable housing development in the Kasarani area at a cost of Sh7 billion.

In a statement, the company says the development, branded 265 Elmer One Apartment, seeks to provide quality affordable apartments that offer competitive rental rates and capital returns to residential real estate investors, that are also ideal for owner-occupier buyers.
265 Elmer One Apartments will offer first in market design product concepts comprising a mix of studio, 1 bedroom,1-bedroom loft and 2 bedrooms priced from Sh1.9 million.

“The tastefully designed houses are ideal and affordable for first time home buyers as well as those who want to invest in real estate without necessarily going through the hassle of getting involved in land buying and construction,” said the Centum Real Estate Managing Director Samuel Kariuki.

265 Elmer One Apartments are an architectural pioneer, with the first 1-bedroom loft design in the region and will provide the perfect blend of affordability and luxury, paving the way for accommodating modern architecture in affordable housing.
The apartments will also be fitted with communal lounges, a mini tennis court and a mini soccer pitch at the apartment complex rooftop.

You might also like Kingdom Bank opens 30th branch in Nairobi CBD UoN urban planning curriculum changed little in 44 years, World Bank says CBK warns banks facing capital shortfalls According to the housing census carried out by the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (KNBS) last year, Kasarani is the second most populated constituency in Nairobi with approximately 708,000 residents.
The high population density denotes a high demand for rental units, which assures investors of a recurring rental income with yields averaging 7.5% per annum.
The development is therefore an excellent opportunity for investors looking to diversify their investment portfolio or venture into real estate.

Centum has made significant considerations to ensure 265 Elmer One meets green building standards, including 20 percent savings on energy and 40 percent savings on water and energy embodied in materials by installing low flow water tap and shower fixtures that reduce up to 3x water usage, dual flash toilet systems that save up to 67 percent of water; 100 percent recycling and re-use of water generated on-site; and 15 percent of the site is set aside for landscaping.
265 Elmer One Apartments is the newest addition to Centum Real Estate’s portfolio of developments and is the Group’s most affordable development in Nairobi.
Recently, Centum Real Estate launched a 365-unit affordable mid-market housing scheme in the Ruaraka area.
“All our real estate developments are delivered to highest standards, on schedule and on budget; that is why many investors are choosing to put their cash in our projects,” said Mr Kariuki.
Centum Real Estate is the region’s leading developer of mixed-use urban nodes in the region, with large mixed-use developments in Nairobi, Kilifi and Entebbe in Uganda.
Centum’s track record assures its investors of quality, value for money, timely handover of projects and a return on their investment.

For everything else there is the official presentation.
In brief The View is Boa Vista’s new Apart-Hotel: 65 suites on the beach at Praia Cabral, in Sal Rei, designed by the architect Giò Gozzi, with 98% of the suites facing the ocean.
Suites start at €90,000, works start in November 2026 and handover is expected at the end of 2028.
Each suite is registered in the buyer’s name, and the buyer can use it for 4 weeks a year.

4 FAQs at the end of the guide In this guide The project Prices and buying Timescales and building works The format What to consider before deciding The first step Frequently asked questions Talk to us Published 4 October 2026 · updated 5 October 2026 · by Invest in Cape Verde On this page we have gathered the most frequently asked questions about The View , grouped by topic.
The answers are based solely on official project data.
For the financial and contractual terms, the official presentation remains the reference, and should be read carefully.
The project What is The View?
It is an Apart-Hotel : a hotel divided into suites, each with its own owner, run by hospitality professionals.
If the format is new to you, start with the guide What is an Apart-Hotel .
Where is it?
On the beach at Praia Cabral , in Sal Rei , the main town on the island of Boa Vista, in Cape Verde.
You can get to know the area better on the page dedicated to Praia Cabral .
How many suites are there?
The project comprises 65 suites .
98% of the suites have an ocean view .
Who designed it?
The architect Giò Gozzi .
The starting idea was simple: to give as many suites as possible a view of the ocean.
That is why The View was conceived as an amphitheatre on the sea .
Who is behind the project?
The group headed by Boavista2000.com and Daniele Rampini, present on Boa Vista for more than 25 years, with more than 350 properties built and sold.
The group’s first Apart-Hotel is the White Hotel , which is now operating.
Its story is told in the guide White Hotel: the story of the project .
Prices and buying How much does a suite cost?
Suites at The View are available from €90,000 .
Up-to-date prices and availability are given in the official presentation.
What exactly am I buying?
A suite, registered in your name .
Not a share in a fund, nor a shared right of use.
The difference is explained in the guide registered ownership or a share .
Can I buy if I live abroad?
Yes.
Many clients follow the purchase from their home country, with the support of the group on the spot.
The legal and tax aspects, both in your country and in Cape Verde, must be checked with a professional.
Timescales and building works When do the works start and finish?
Works start in November 2026 .
Handover is expected at the end of 2028 .
How can I follow progress?
On the page The building site live we publish updates and photos from the site.
You can also come and see it in person during an exploratory trip.
Is buying before handover risky?
Every off-plan purchase calls for attention to timescales, payments and safeguards.
We have written a dedicated guide: buying an off-plan property .
The format Who manages the suite when I am not there?
The hotel.
Bookings, guests, cleaning and maintenance are entrusted to hospitality professionals.
You do not have to deal with day-to-day management.
The management contract runs for 10 years .
Can I go on holiday in my suite?
Yes: personal use of 4 weeks a year is included.
We explain how it works in practice in the guide on personal use of the suite .
What are the financial terms?
They are set out in the official presentation and in the contract.
Read them calmly, point by point, and have them checked by your adviser.
To see whether the format suits you, compare it with a traditional apartment on the page Apartment or Apart-Hotel?
What to consider before deciding The View is designed for those who want a property on Boa Vista without taking on a second job .
It does, however, have one clear limitation: it offers less freedom of use than a traditional apartment.
If you want to spend many months a year on the island, an apartment may be more suitable.
The first step The simplest way to start is to receive the official presentation and talk it over with us.
Request it from the contact page or book a video call: we answer personally.
Frequently asked questions Can I see the building site in person?
We organise exploratory trips to Boa Vista to visit The View’s building site, the White Hotel, which is already operating, and the Praia Cabral area.
Write to us to arrange the dates.
Are all the suites the same?
The project comprises 65 suites and 98% have an ocean view.
Types, positions and up-to-date availability are given in the official presentation: request it for the details.
Can I sell my suite at The View?
The suite is registered in your name, so it remains a property that you can sell or leave to your heirs.
The resale arrangements set out in the contract should be read carefully.
Find out more in the guide selling a property in Cape Verde .
How do I receive the official presentation?
You can request it from the contact page, via WhatsApp or by email.
We will send it to you and remain available to answer your questions.
Would you like to talk it through with a person?
Book a video call or message us on WhatsApp: we will answer your questions about Boa Vista and The View.

Observatory's Next Chapter: Orion Arrives at the Heart of Cape Town's Urban Revival - Everything Property Business Day HomeFront Magazine Your Neighbourhood Magazine News Lifestyle Retirement Commercial Residential Auctions Proptech Property Finance Office Retail Industrial International Sustainable developments Luxury Profiles Everything Property Develop SA Property Auctions Commercial Property Finance Industrial Investment Retirement Residential News Insight International Lifestyle Décor DIY Luxury Proptech Garden & Outdoor Advice Insurance Contact Us Advertise Developments Observatory’s Next Chapter: Orion Arrives at the Heart of Cape Town’s Urban Revival By Jane Posted on 22/06/2026 The Orion Apartments development is scheduled to break ground in September 2026, with occupation anticipated in March 2028.

Share Tweet Share Share Email Comments Twitter Facebook LinkedIn Pinterest Cape Town’s property story is often told through its headline suburbs: the Atlantic Seaboard, the City Bowl and the Southern Suburbs.
Yet some of the city’s most interesting residential growth is taking place beyond these established markets, in neighbourhoods where history, culture, education and enterprise intersect.
Observatory is one of those places.

WORDS: NEWSROOM :: PHOTOS: NEWSDESK Long known for its eclectic character, creative energy and diverse community, the suburb has steadily evolved into one of Cape Town’s most vibrant mixed-use precincts.
Its appeal lies in a combination that is increasingly difficult to find in major cities: walkability, connectivity and authenticity.
From morning coffee runs and independent eateries to gyms, grocery stores, co-working spaces and nightlife, much of daily life in Observatory happens within a few blocks.

The suburb’s location also places residents within easy reach of some of the city’s most significant institutions, including the University of Cape Town (UCT), the Cape Peninsula University of Technology (CPUT), Groote Schuur Hospital and the Cape Town CBD.
A contemporary residential offering Against this backdrop, a new residential development is preparing to add another layer to Observatory’s ongoing regeneration story.
Orion, located at 339 Main Road, Observatory, is set to launch sales online on Wednesday 22 July 2026 at 1pm .
Developed by Leisure Group and designed by Cape Town-based Bernicchi Architects , the project brings a contemporary residential offering to one of the city’s most established urban neighbourhoods.
*The development is scheduled to break ground in September 2026, with occupation anticipated in March 2028.

Orion Introduces a New-build Option While Observatory’s popularity has grown steadily over the past decade, the residential market has often been characterised by older housing stock and smaller-scale apartment offerings.
Orion introduces a new-build option aimed at residents seeking modern conveniences while remaining connected to the character of the suburb itself.

The development will comprise a mix of studio, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, catering to a broad range of buyers, from first-time homeowners and young professionals to healthcare workers, academics, entrepreneurs and small families.
What distinguishes the project is its emphasis on lifestyle-focused amenities more commonly associated with hospitality developments.
Residents will have access to a rooftop swimming pool with views across the city, a residents gym and communal spaces designed to encourage connection and flexibility in how people live and work.
Secure access throughout the building reflects growing demand for lock-up-and-go living, particularly among urban professionals.
The inclusion of pet-friendly ground-floor garden apartments also responds to a changing residential market.
Increasingly, buyers are seeking homes that accommodate every aspect of their lives, including their pets, without sacrificing convenience or location.

Enhancing Observatory’s streetscape Architecture has played a central role in Observatory’s evolution over the years, and Orion’s design seeks to contribute positively to the streetscape while embracing contemporary urban living.
Bernicchi Architects, known for a portfolio of Cape Town projects, has designed a building intended to complement the area’s mixed-use character while creating a modern residential environment.
The development’s location on Main Road places future residents at the centre of one of Cape Town’s most connected neighbourhoods.
Public transport routes, educational institutions, healthcare facilities and employment hubs are all within close reach, reducing reliance on long commutes and supporting a more walkable lifestyle.
This emphasis on proximity is increasingly becoming a defining factor in residential decision-making.
For many buyers, quality of life is measured not only by the home itself but by the ability to access work, leisure and everyday necessities within minutes.
The result is a neighbourhood where students, medical professionals, creatives, business owners and long-term residents share the same urban fabric.
That diversity has become one of Observatory’s defining strengths, helping sustain a local economy built around independent businesses and community-focused spaces.

Orion Unit Types Studios Priced from R1,27 million Sized from 26 – 31m2 including balconies See here One Bedroom Apartments Priced from R1,75 million Sized from 31 – 80m2 including balconies See here Two Bedroom Apartments Priced from R2,12 million Sized from 47 – 70m2 including balconies See here An Online-only Sales Launch The launch of Orion also reflects changing consumer behaviour in the residential sector.
Rather than a traditional showroom-based release, apartments will be offered through an online-only sales launch scheduled for 1pm on Wednesday, 22 July 2026.
Digital launches have become increasingly common in new developments, allowing buyers to access information, compare unit types and secure purchases from anywhere.
For a generation accustomed to conducting much of life online, the approach reflects a broader shift in how property transactions are initiated.

A 62-story oceanfront tower at 18401 Collins Avenue , Sunny Isles Beach, on a site of about 2.4 acres (the county folio lists 103,548 square feet and Florida YIMBY reported 2.37 acres on 4 March 2024; The Real Deal put the property at 3.6 acres on 5 November 2025, and I have not found a source that reconciles the two).

It was formerly a five-story Wyndham-branded hotel property that a Dezer affiliate bought for $6.8 million in 1996 (The Real Deal, 5 November 2025; the county record lists an August 1996 sale at $6,780,000).
216 residences from 5,256 to 6,333 square feet , three to five bedrooms.
Every one has a private pool on the balcony and an in-unit garage.
Bentley Residences remaining inventory starts at $5.8 million (PROFILEmiami, 11 June 2026) with completion targeted for 2028, a timeline covered in what Bentley Residences costs to own .
Porsche Design Tower owners can park a car on any of the tower’s 57 floors, featured in Miami condos built for car enthusiasts .

Aerial along the Sunny Isles Beach oceanfront strip with the barrier island and bay behind Dezer Development (Gil Dezer) is the developer, Sieger Suarez Architects the architect, and Coastal Construction the general contractor.
Douglas Elliman Development Marketing was hired in August 2023 to partner with Dezer’s in-house sales team, Dezer Platinum Realty (The Real Deal, 14 August 2023).
Bentley Motors is more than a logo here.
Bentley’s own design department collaborated on the project and the brand identity runs through both interior and exterior.
The most visible expression is the facade: diamond-quilt-patterned glass panels drawn from Bentley’s seat stitching , covering roughly half the exterior.

“The modern and progressive brand identity of Bentley Residences is at work in both the tower’s interior and exterior spaces, rooted in authenticity, sustainability and innovation.” Adrian Hallmark, Chairman and CEO, Bentley Motors — April 2021 Amenities run past 20,000 square feet — spa, cinema, whiskey bar, cigar lounge, beach club — and the residents-only restaurant is “Proper English by Todd English,” the chef’s first private residential dining venture (Florida YIMBY, 4 February 2026).
The Real Deal had reported a private restaurant headed by English as part of the plan on 14 August 2023.
The Dezervator, Explained Properly This is the reason the building exists, so it is worth getting right rather than repeating the brochure line.
Aerial of the Sunny Isles Beach shoreline, Intracoastal and mainland beyond Four Dezervators serve the tower, travelling at 800 feet per minute .

Per Bentley’s own technical description, the system uses a hydraulic mechanism that “pinches a car by its tyres to pull it on top of a robotic shuttle system, which in turn transports a car up or down to the correct story.” Vehicles carry RFID stickers ; the system recognises the car and routes it to the right residence without the driver stepping out or pressing anything.
An LED system guides you to the correct lift on arrival.
The lower shaft is glass-enclosed, so the ride is a view rather than a box.
“Every unit features the patented Dezervator system which takes you and your car up to your apartment where your car sits right in your garage a few steps from your front door.
No other building in the world offers that amenity.” Gil Dezer, President, Dezer Development — January 2024 Garage capacity depends on exposure.
Ocean-facing units get four cars; Intracoastal-facing units get three.
The penthouse has a glass-enclosed in-unit garage with EV charging for up to seven.
Every garage has in-unit EV charging.
This was a direct response to Porsche Design Tower, where units had two spaces and buyers said they wanted more.
Two honest caveats.
The system is described as “patented” in every source, but no patent number, filing date or assignee has ever been published — treat it as developer-asserted.
And nothing has been published about load capacity, redundancy and failover, fire-code treatment, or how the shaft is protected in a hurricane.
Those are reasonable questions for a system your car and your access depend on.
Ask them.
Where Construction Actually Stands Ground broke 26 February 2024.

The mat foundation pour completed in November 2025 and, according to the developer’s press release as reported by Florida YIMBY on 19 November 2025, set a record: 36 continuous hours, 20,000 cubic yards of concrete, 2,100 truckloads, 2,400 tons of reinforcing steel, 10 concrete pumps — the largest residential construction pour in Florida and the second-largest foundation pour in the United States.
The superstructure passed Level 7 as of 11 June 2026 , moving at roughly one floor every five to six working days (PROFILEmiami, 11 June 2026).
Florida YIMBY reported on 6 August 2026 that it had advanced to approximately 13 stories by late July.
That is about six floors in roughly eight weeks — my arithmetic on the two reports, one floor every six to seven working days, a little slower than the pace the developer cited in June.

“Going vertical is a meaningful milestone for Bentley Residences Miami and a testament to the strength of our vision and execution.” Gil Dezer, President, Dezer Development — June 2026 Do the arithmetic on the delivery date, because it matters.
At about 13 of 62 stories in late July 2026, about 49 floors of structure remain.

At the developer’s cited pace of one floor every five to six working days that is roughly 245 to 295 working days of structure alone; at the six to seven working days per floor that June to July implies, roughly 295 to 345 — in either case before facade, mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fit-out.
A 2028 delivery is achievable, but only at the optimistic end.
That is my arithmetic on the published pace, not a forecast anyone has issued.

I searched the trade press and the developer’s and Bentley Motors’ own sites on 24 September 2026 and found no newer construction report, so I do not have a floor count for 24 September 2026.

Height.
749 feet was used consistently from 2021.
Then in November 2025 one outlet switched to 716 feet and has used it since — while another published 749 feet in the same fortnight.
Nobody has explained the 33-foot difference.

Bentley Motors’ own website says 61 , and Bentley’s own newsroom places the penthouse on the 61st story.

Michael Wolk Design was named at groundbreaking in March 2024.

Settlement, and this is the serious one.

A University of Miami study reported in December 2024 (The Real Deal, 17 December 2024) measured nearly three dozen buildings from Miami Beach to Sunny Isles Beach between 2016 and 2023 and found them settling 2 to 8 centimetres , with the most significant effects in Sunny Isles Beach.
Buildings named include Dezer’s own Porsche Design Tower , the Estates at Acqualina and Four Seasons at the Surf Club.
The study’s senior author told The Real Deal it was not a cause for alarm and that the buildings are not going to collapse.
That measurement period ended before Bentley broke ground in 2024, so Bentley Residences is not among the buildings it measured .
Bentley comes into the December 2025 coverage instead.

The Real Deal (5 December 2025), summarising a Miami Herald investigation, named it as a newer tower under construction, said experts find it difficult to determine how much newer towers will settle, and wrote that “no one is monitoring how towers settle and shift after they are completed.” The Herald (5 December 2025) also reported that the latest geotechnical report for Bentley Residences says its engineers expect settlement from the construction to affect the neighbouring Turnberry Ocean Club Residences and Sahara properties, and estimated the Turnberry could settle by about three inches; Dezer Development declined to be interviewed or answer written questions.
Ask what monitoring, if any, is committed here.

In February 2026 Sunny Isles approved another 62-story tower at 19051 Collins Avenue — co-developed by Related Group, Dezer and BH Group — over vocal resident opposition citing structural integrity, emergency access and post-Surfside safety concerns.
Those developers agreed to monitor vibration and subsidence during construction and for a year afterward .
I have not found a report of a comparable commitment for Bentley Residences.
Expect adjacent construction across your delivery window.
There is precedent for neighbour damage claims involving this exact team.

Same developer, same contractor, same architect.

$630 million from Madison Realty Capital, announced when the developer said the project was more than 50% presold.
Rate, term and extension options are not public.
That is normal for this market — but understand that the sales pace and the debt are linked.

Can I sell before or at delivery?
It depends on your purchase agreement.

Before closing, selling usually means assigning your contract to a new buyer, which developers often allow only with their written consent and sometimes for a fee, so read the assignment clause first.

How does the car elevator at Bentley Residences work?
Four “Dezervators” travel at 800 feet per minute.
A hydraulic system pinches the car by its tyres and pulls it onto a robotic shuttle, which carries the vehicle to the resident’s floor.
Cars carry RFID stickers so the system routes them automatically — the driver never gets out or presses a button.
Ocean-facing units have four-car garages, Intracoastal-facing units three, all with EV charging.

At about 13 of 62 floors in late July 2026, a 2028 delivery is achievable but requires the pace to hold.
Bentley Motors’ own page, read 24 September 2026, still says 2027.
How much does a residence at Bentley Residences cost?
Remaining inventory starts at $5.8 million as of 11 June 2026 (PROFILEmiami), the same entry price reported in November 2025, up from $3.9 million at the January 2022 launch.
The two penthouses were reported asking $37.5 million each in November 2025; one outlet reported both sold.
No price per square foot has ever been published by a credible source.
How many floors does Bentley Residences have?
The honest answer is that sources disagree.
The 2026 reports (Florida YIMBY, 4 June and 6 August) say 62; the figure has also been published as 60, 61 and 63, and Bentley Motors’ own website says 61.
Height is published as both 749 feet and 716 feet.
Confirm the number in your contract rather than from marketing material.
How much of Bentley Residences has sold?
More than 50% presold as of 5 November 2025, according to the developer’s release (The Real Deal).
It was over 40% in March 2024, so roughly ten percentage points of absorption over twenty months.
I have not found a newer sales figure.
Are Sunny Isles towers sinking, and does it affect Bentley Residences?

A University of Miami study reported in December 2024 found nearly three dozen high-rises from Miami Beach to Sunny Isles Beach settling 2 to 8 centimetres between 2016 and 2023, with the most significant effects in Sunny Isles Beach — including Dezer’s own Porsche Design Tower.
Bentley Residences was not among the buildings measured; the study period ended before it broke ground.

The Miami Herald reported on 5 December 2025 that the latest geotechnical report for Bentley expects settlement from its construction to affect the neighbouring Turnberry Ocean Club Residences and Sahara properties, and The Real Deal wrote the same day that no one is monitoring how towers settle after they are completed, which is a fair question to put to any developer on this strip.

BUYING AND RENTING How should you compare buying with renting?
Compare actual homes that meet the same needs over your expected time in the area.
A purchase price and an advertised rent alone do not establish which option costs less.
Use current quotes and separate monthly cash flow, upfront cash, and the amount you might recover when moving.
Purchase worksheet Start with the down payment, lender and closing charges, and any immediate repairs.
Add principal and interest, property taxes, insurance, mortgage insurance where applicable, association dues, utilities and ongoing maintenance.
Identify expenses paid outside escrow so they are included in your household budget.
For a later sale, model the remaining loan balance and selling expenses.
Appreciation is uncertain; compare unchanged-price and lower-price cases as well as any growth assumption.
Principal repayment builds an ownership interest, but that does not guarantee a profit or make every cash payment recoverable.
Adjust the payment assumptions → Rental worksheet Use an actual lease offer and confirm the term, deposit, renewal provisions, parking, pet charges, utilities and renter's insurance.
Record which maintenance services are included and any costs or restrictions associated with an early move.
An advertised starting rent may not include every required charge.
Keep the comparison consistent: use the same time period, household needs and moving assumptions.
Include the cash that remains available when a down payment is not used, without assuming a guaranteed investment return.
Your need for flexibility and responsibility for repairs also matter alongside the financial figures.
Use scenarios rather than a promised break-even date There is no verified community-wide holding period or five-year equity gain shown here.
Ask your lender to explain financing assumptions and have a tax professional assess any claimed tax benefit for your circumstances.
Keep a copy of the quotes and dates so you can update the comparison before making an offer.
CFPB: financial considerations when buying a home PROPERTY-SPECIFIC ASSOCIATION COSTS Which HOA charges apply to this address?
A community name does not establish a property's current dues or all the associations that govern it.
Obtain the applicable resale package, budget and governing documents for the exact address.
Confirm the effective date and payment frequency of each fee with the association or its manager.
Recurring charges Identify master and sub-association dues separately.
Check whether utilities, exterior maintenance, insurance, amenities or club access are included, optional or billed separately.
A listing's monthly figure may omit a quarterly or annual charge, and an advertised amenity does not establish membership rights.
Closing and special charges Ask about transfer, document, capital-contribution and other transaction fees, as well as approved or proposed assessments.
Confirm who pays each item under the contract.
Review available reserve and budget information; historical dues are not a guarantee of future charges.
Rules and access Verify the actual rules for leasing, pets, parking, property changes and amenity access.
Age restrictions and gate staffing require their own current documentation.
Do not assume neighboring subdivisions or similarly named communities have identical rules, services or fees.
Use the confirmed recurring amount in the calculator and keep one-time charges in a separate closing budget.
Unknown dues remain unverified; they are not evidence that no association or fee exists.

Adjacent to the emerging Aire Park and just moments from the city’s commercial core, the development forms part of one of the UK’s most ambitious regeneration stories—where new residential, commercial, and public spaces are redefining city-centre living.

Exceptional Communal Living & Resident Amenities Designed with lifestyle in mind, Aire Gardens centres around a striking open-air atrium with a retractable roof—creating a bright, architecturally distinctive communal space that encourages interaction and year-round usability.

Residents benefit from a fully equipped gym, stylish lounge, co-working areas, private dining space, games room, and dedicated social zones—delivering a premium, community-focused living experience tailored to modern urban professionals.

A Thriving City with Strong Fundamentals Leeds has firmly established itself as one of the UK’s leading regional cities, with a population approaching 800,000 and a £64.6bn economy driven by finance, digital industries, and professional services.
As the largest financial and legal centre outside London, it continues to attract major employers and a highly skilled workforce, supporting long-term economic resilience and growth.
Student Retention Driving Rental Demand With over 70,000 students across three major universities, Leeds benefits from a consistent pipeline of renters.

Crucially, around 40% of graduates remain in the city after completing their studies—transitioning into professional employment and creating sustained demand for high-quality, well-located accommodation like Aire Gardens.

Undersupply & Long-Term Investment in Mind A chronic undersupply of new homes, combined with continued population growth and inward migration, has created a strong imbalance between supply and demand.
This supports high occupancy rates, resilient rental yields, and long-term capital growth.
Positioned at the centre of the South Bank’s ongoing transformation, Aire Gardens offers investors a compelling blend of lifestyle appeal, strong tenant retention, and future growth potential.

It is alleged that: Unauthorised Reproduction: Developer contracts and project materials were copied or reproduced without proper authority.
Diverted Bank Details: Bank account details were altered so that purchaser funds were directed to accounts controlled by third parties, including offshore accounts in Hong Kong.

Substantial Purchaser Impact: Up to approximately 30 purchasers, and possibly more, may have paid substantial sums to third parties rather than to PT Bali Real Estate Investments, PT Marina Bay Investments, or an authorised nominated account of the legitimate developer.
Fraudulent Signatures: Signatures appearing on certain disputed contracts were copied, inserted, or otherwise used without proper authority.
Unapproved Payment Instructions: Disputed contracts contained payment instructions that had neither been issued nor approved by the legitimate developer.
*These are serious allegations referred to the relevant Indonesian and Australian authorities for investigation.
Anyone affected should obtain independent legal advice and submit all contracts, bank-transfers, and correspondence to the appropriate authorities.
Disputed Signatures Questions have arisen regarding contracts purportedly bearing the signature of former director Christine Natale .
It is alleged that Ms.
Natale did not personally sign or authorise certain disputed contracts and that her signature was copied and inserted into documents by third parties.
Statements attributed to Ms.
Natale have changed over time, and allegations have been raised that she was subsequently subjected to threats, pressure, blackmail, or financial inducements.
Advisory: Those allegations are disputed and subject to proper investigation and legal proceedings.
Purchasers should not rely solely upon a signature appearing on a document.
The contract, authority of the signatory, payment destination, and receipt of funds must all be independently verified.
Who is Entitled to Receive a Villa?

The legitimate developer can only recognise and perform contracts that are verified as authentic and under which agreed purchase funds were received directly by the developer or an account formally authorised by it.
The mere use of names such as “Marina Bay City,” “PT Bali Real Estate Investments” or “PT Marina Bay Investments” on a document does not establish that the developer received the purchaser’s funds.

Purchasers holding disputed contracts must establish: ✓ Who supplied the contract ✓ Who signed or purported to sign it ✓ Signatory's authority to bind developer ✓ Bank account that received funds ✓ Ownership/Control of that account ✓ Developer corporate & accounting records verification Background Checks and Public Records Purchasers are encouraged to conduct independent due diligence regarding every company, salesperson, introducer, and principal involved in the transaction.
Relevant publicly available material may include Australian court and regulatory records, reporting concerning Eco Boss , and the ABC investigation into GIM Trading .
Any conclusions should be based on verified records, not merely promotional statements or accusations published by an interested party.
Disclaimer: The conduct of the individuals and entities involved remains subject to investigation, disputed factual claims, and legal proceedings.
Nothing in this notice should be interpreted as declaring any person guilty of an offence that has not been finally determined by a court.

Warning to Purchasers Before entering into any contract or transferring funds relating to Nesara Bay City, purchasers should: Confirm Directly: Confirm directly with LUX Property Group that the contract is authentic.
Verify Authority: Verify the legal identity and corporate authority of the contracting entity.
Official Banking Channels: Confirm all bank details strictly through official LUX Property Group communication channels.
Refuse Alterations: Refuse any request to send funds to a substituted account without formal written verification.
Offshore Scrutiny: Be particularly cautious about payments directed to offshore or third-party accounts (e.g.
Hong Kong).
Official Receipts: Insist on obtaining an official receipt directly from the authorised developer.
Legal Counsel: Seek independent legal advice whenever any document, signature, or payment instruction is in doubt.
Documentation Review & Verification LUX Property Group is reviewing the circumstances of purchasers who may have been affected by unauthorised contracts or diverted payments.
Affected purchasers are urged to submit their complete contractual, transfer, and payment documentation for verification.
Please exercise extreme caution.
Confirm you are dealing directly with the legitimate developer before executing any agreement or transferring funds.

Discover Amarina Villas, an exclusive residential estate in the heart of Grand Baie.
Ideally located in the most vibrant area of northern Mauritius, Amarina Villas offer a truly unique living environment.
With pristine beaches, restaurants, shopping centres, international schools, and sports clubs just minutes away, everything is within easy reach.

✔ 5 minutes from stunning beaches ✔ 2 minutes from Super U (or 8 minutes on foot) ✔ 3 minutes from La Croisette, the north’s premier shopping centre Set slightly back from Chemin 20 Pieds, the estate ensures peace and tranquillity while maintaining quick access to all nearby amenities.
Amarina Villas stand out for their architectural design tailored to the Mauritian climate.
Comprising 23 villas, mostly single-storey, the residence is designed to provide year-round comfort.
Each home is strategically positioned to minimise wind exposure and maximise natural ventilation.
Generous volumes and 3-metre-high bay windows flood the interiors with natural light and create a seamless flow between indoor and outdoor spaces.
The villas come in three- or four-bedroom en suite layouts, featuring a spacious living room that opens onto a fully equipped open-plan kitchen.
Each room has been thoughtfully designed to optimise space while creating an elegant, welcoming atmosphere.
A large covered terrace (varangue) extends the living area, perfect for enjoying tropical life.
All bedrooms are fitted with air conditioning and ceiling fans.
Outside, each villa includes a beautifully landscaped garden and a private pool — your personal sanctuary.
A utility/laundry room completes the layout for added daily comfort.
Beyond the elegance of its villas, Amarina Villas offers a lifestyle focused on privacy and well-being.
Landscaped gardens create a peaceful atmosphere, while a fully equipped gym allows residents to take care of their health and fitness.
The estate is secured 24/7 and includes common area maintenance services as well as a dedicated concierge to meet the needs of homeowners.
Amarina Villas represent a unique investment opportunity in Grand Baie, the residential and economic hub of the island’s north.
Its strategic location, combined with high demand for quality real estate, ensures strong potential for property value growth.
Under the PDS scheme, the project also enables foreign buyers to obtain a residence permit for themselves and their family — further enhancing its appeal.
Offering both an exceptional lifestyle and strong investment potential, Amarina Villas is your opportunity to embrace elegant and peaceful living in one of the most sought-after areas of Mauritius.

FAQ Before you request details Can non-Seychellois buyers acquire freehold ownership?
Freehold ownership is available through the applicable legal procedure, subject to Government Sanction for a qualifying buyer and selected property.
Can you help with a Residence Permit?
Yes.
We personally discuss eligibility before a transaction and help purchasers prepare documents.
The project team reports that its clients have obtained permits; individual decisions rest with the Seychelles authorities.
You may appoint your own lawyer.
Can I rent the villa?
Owners may choose to let their villa; this is not prohibited within the estate.
Applicable licences and taxes depend on the intended rental use; no return is guaranteed.
Are taxes included in the price?
No.
Government taxes, duties, registration charges and other applicable statutory costs are payable separately by the purchaser and are not included in the advertised villa price.
Empathia Village assists with Government Sanction as part of transaction support; the Seychelles authority decides the application.
If approval cannot be obtained despite the buyer meeting the agreed conditions, the plot reservation amount is refunded under the reservation agreement.
How many plots are planned?
Approximately 30 private plots.
The final number may change if purchasers combine adjoining plots.
Can I appoint my own advisers?
Buyers can appoint an independent Seychelles lawyer, tax adviser and technical specialist to review the documentation before proceeding.

Password recovery Recover your password your email Search RED by Terra Caribbean RED by Terra Caribbean RED by Terra Caribbean The Real Estate Database Search _ Residential Luxury Commercial Regional Research Archives Podcasts About Us Contact Us RED by Terra Caribbean The Real Estate Database Search _ Residential Luxury Commercial Regional Research Archives Podcasts About Us Contact Us Home Luxury Designing for the Caribbean: Inside the Architecture of VISTARA Residences Luxury Residential Designing for the Caribbean: Inside the Architecture of VISTARA Residences By RED by Terra Caribbean - May 27, 2026 1518 0 Facebook Twitter Linkedin Email There is a particular kind of quiet that only the Caribbean ridge-top can offer, the kind where the wind moves through the trees, the sea glitters in the distance, and the world below simply falls away.
This, is the first thing you notice about VISTARA .
Perched on an elevated ridge within Calijanda Estate, Westmoreland, St.
James, this boutique enclave of just 18 standalone villas is one of the most thoughtfully designed residential developments to arrive on Barbados’s Platinum Coast.
And the more you understand how it was designed, the more that quiet starts to feel intentional.

Built for the West Coast Experience VISTARA overlooks the entire west coast of Barbados, the same coastline that earns its reputation for calm turquoise water, world-class sunsets, and the relaxed elegance that draws discerning buyers from around the world.

The site itself is set back from the main road, insulated from noise by a natural gully to the north, and positioned on a natural slope that allows every single villa to command its own uninterrupted view out to sea.
“Every single villa is going to have its own special view out to sea,” says the project’s lead architect, Roy, in a recent interview with Terra Caribbean.

That wasn’t accidental, it was the result of a site strategy that used the hillside topography deliberately, with winding internal roads navigating the slope and each villa oriented to maximise sightlines, natural light, and privacy from its neighbours.
This is Caribbean architecture working with the land, not against it.
The Philosophy: Indoor–Outdoor, Without Compromise At the heart of every design decision at VISTARA is one principle: seamless indoor-outdoor living.
The villas are built around open-plan layouts with expansive terraces that flow naturally from the main living areas; the boundary between inside and outside is meant to dissolve entirely.
The primary vehicle for that dissolution is glass.
Floor-to-ceiling glazing runs across the main living elevations, and oversized sliding doors open the interior completely to the patio and pool deck.
But this isn’t ordinary glass.

VISTARA uses Solar-E Glass ; the same advanced glazing technology deployed across the developer’s previous projects, Allure and Aspire, which filters infrared light, reduces heat gain, and allows residents to keep interiors cool even as afternoon sunsets pour through full-height windows.
“That gives an amazing filter for the indoor,” Roy explains.

In a tropical climate where the sun is both the greatest asset and the most demanding force to manage, that kind of glazing technology is the difference between architecture that performs and architecture that simply looks good.
Hurricane-Impact Resistant, By Design The Solar-E Glass system does double duty.
Beyond its thermal performance, the glazing is engineered to hurricane-impact resistant standards, a non-negotiable requirement for any serious luxury villa in Barbados .

The same commitment carried through previous Imagine Developments projects ensures VISTARA buyers are investing in a structure built for the realities of the Caribbean climate without sacrificing the open, light-filled aesthetic they came here for.
This is architecture with a quiet confidence: it looks effortless because the engineering carrying it is robust.
The Four Villa Types VISTARA offers four distinct villa collections, each designed to respond to a specific relationship with the landscape; its views, gradients, and natural features.

Lush — Oriented toward the development’s most verdant sections, these villas lean into the tropical foliage and garden setting, creating a sense of immersion in nature while maintaining clear sea views.
Serenity — Positioned for privacy and calm, the Serenity villas are set further from internal circulation routes, maximising seclusion and creating a retreat-like atmosphere.

Edge — The most dramatic of the four, Edge villas sit at the ridge perimeter, with exposures that deliver the most expansive, unobstructed views of the Caribbean Sea — built for those who want to feel the full sweep of the horizon from their living room.

Oasis — Designed around the private pool as the centrepiece, Oasis villas frame the infinity-edge pool as both a functional amenity and a visual anchor, with interiors and terraces planned around that experience.
All four types are available in 3 and 4-bedroom configurations, ranging from approximately 3,250 to 6,263 sq ft of interior floor area, on plots between 7,513 and 16,662 sq ft.
Private Infinity Pools and the Art of the Terrace Every villa at VISTARA includes its own private infinity-edge pool; not a shared amenity, not an optional upgrade.

The pools are integrated into the terrace design so that the water line appears to meet the horizon, reinforcing that signature Caribbean visual that has become synonymous with West Coast Platinum Coast real estate .

Roy describes the broader landscape as an equal priority to the homes themselves: “A lot of attention is going into not only the homes, but the whole environment and the surroundings, the landscaping.” The winding internal roads, the planting along the slope, the way each terrace sits within its plot, all of it is conceived as a single, cohesive experience rather than 18 individual houses sharing a postcode.

Where Design Meets Location VISTARA sits within minutes of Holetown’s restaurants, boutique hotels, and marinas, and borders the Royal Westmoreland golf community, placing it at the intersection of natural beauty and Barbados’s most refined lifestyle infrastructure.
Off-plan sales launched in December 2025, with villa pricing starting from USD $2,120,000 for a 4-bedroom residence.

Developed by IMAGINE Developments , the Barbadian developer behind The Residences at Coverley, Aspire, and the upcoming Gibbs Beach ultra-luxury condos; VISTARA carries a track record that buyers at this level of the market expect.

For those searching for luxury villas in Barbados where the architecture is as considered as the location, VISTARA represents a rare convergence: a boutique scale, a world-class ridge-top site, and a design philosophy built entirely around the Caribbean experience.

With an exceptional site secured, funding in place from a local development bank, and construction already underway, sales for these waterfront residences are set to launch in the first quarter of 2026.

Inspired by Belize’s flourishing ecosystems, modern sustainable design principles, and locally sourced materials, the team behind The Elements has created a collection of energy-efficient homes featuring beautiful interiors and serene views along the stunning Placencia Lagoon.
With more than 20 years of experience in Placencia, Latitude 20 has played a significant role in shaping Southern Belize.
Their portfolio includes notable properties such as Turtle Inn and Blancaneaux Lodge, both owned by Francis Ford Coppola, as well as Robert’s Grove and developments within Naia Resort and Spa.
Nestled along Belize’s turquoise coastline, Placencia is a hidden gem that blends the charm of a small fishing village with pristine beaches and lush mangroves.
Its crystal-clear waters and thriving coral reefs make it a haven for snorkelers, divers, fishermen, and nature lovers alike.
Beyond its natural beauty, Placencia is known for its warm, welcoming community.
Visitors can stroll along the famously narrow main street, lined with vibrant shops, cafés, and local eateries.

A short journey north leads to Maya Beach, known for its tranquil ambiance and upscale beachfront resorts, while further along the coast lies Hopkins, a cultural hub celebrated for its rich Garifuna heritage and lively community events.
The Elements offers a collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom waterfront residences overlooking the lagoon.
Whether you’re considering relocation, retirement, or a vacation home, ownership options are flexible.
Buyers can establish permanent residency in Belize, use the property as a private getaway, or participate in a voluntary rental program that helps offset costs and generate income.
Each home is thoughtfully designed to capture the Caribbean breeze and includes air conditioning, high-end kitchens and bathrooms, and king-sized bedrooms.

Residents can enjoy amenities such as: · A private pier and palapa with kayaks for exploring the mangroves · A pickleball court · A large pool and jacuzzi with panoramic lagoon and mountain views · 24-hour security The two-bedroom “Brisa” residence (1550 sq ft) Brisa (breeze) is the two-bedroom residence in the Elements collection.
At 1550 sq ft, it consists of two bedrooms with king-size beds, with built-in wardrobes and two spacious ensuite bathrooms with a walk-in shower, vanity, and toilet.

The living space is open-plan and has a comfortable lounge area with a smart TV, a spacious dining area, and a modern gourmet kitchen with a fridge-freezer, cooking range, and under counter washer-dryer.

Equipped with an outdoor grill and comfortable sitting areas, owners can enjoy magnificent private views over the Placencia lagoon The Placencia Lagoon is the largest harbor in the western Caribbean, offering calm waters ideal for boating and water sports.
Whether cruising at sunset or exploring the surrounding ecosystem, the lagoon provides a uniquely peaceful lifestyle.
Construction is already in progress, backed by Latitude 20’s strong track record in development, planning, and supervision.
Pricing begins at $250,000 USD for one-bedroom units, with penthouses available up to $689,000 USD.
HOA fees are currently set at $0.40 per square foot (subject to change).
Ownership at The Elements provides flexibility and control, allowing homeowners to enjoy their residence year-round or participate in the managed rental program for additional income.
Whether you’re seeking a permanent move or a luxury vacation retreat, The Elements offers an opportunity to become part of a distinctive Caribbean community.

Underfloor heating, air conditioning infrastructure, smart home system, lacquered kitchen cabinets, a 4-piece premium built-in appliance set, lacquered interior doors, master bathroom, cloakroom and motorised smart shutters are all standard.
Bedside lighting, a pre-wired TV console and central satellite TV are also included.
05 Common Areas What are the building's common-area features?
Coded building entry, a quiet energy-efficient elevator, a full-building backup generator, 24/7 IP CCTV and an open-air garden-level pool.
Common areas are designed in line with the seafront atmosphere through restrained materials and landscape.

Use the contact form to share your name, phone, email and the unit you are interested in.
Our sales team will reply within 24 hours and schedule a convenient time for a Konyaaltı seafront showroom visit.
07 Foreign Buyers Can foreign nationals buy at Le Marin?
Yes.
Antalya is one of the top cities in Türkiye for property purchases by foreign nationals, and units at Le Marin Konyaaltı can be sold to foreign buyers.
Our sales team provides support in English, Russian, German and Arabic, and accompanies you through the official steps such as tax number, valuation report and title deed (tapu) transfer.
08 Prices How much do apartments at Le Marin Konyaaltı cost?
Current prices vary by unit type (2+1 or 3+1 duplex), floor level and orientation.
Due to the 350 m seafront location and the limited number of units, the price list is updated regularly.
For current prices and campaign terms, request an appointment through the contact form or message us on WhatsApp.
09 Payment What payment plan options are available?
Besides cash payment, instalment options spread across the construction period are offered.
The payment plan is tailored to the chosen unit type, the handover schedule and the down-payment ratio; a personalised payment table is prepared during your showroom visit.
10 Investment Is Le Marin Konyaaltı a good investment?
The Konyaaltı seafront is one of the areas with the highest residential and long-term rental demand in Antalya.

The 350 m distance to the beach, the small number of units, mixed use with retail spaces and the 2027 handover schedule make the project attractive for investors targeting appreciation and rental yield.

Ocean Hills is not a getaway.
It is a conscious choice of lifestyle.

Request Info LIVING BETWEEN THE OCEAN AND THE MOUNTAIN Ocean Hills is born in the south of Tenerife, one of the most privileged locations in Europe, where mild weather is a constant 365 days a year and natural light is part of everyday life.
A unique setting that brings together sea and mountains, idyllic beaches, volcanic landscapes and open spaces for an active, healthy lifestyle.
Here you can swim in the ocean at sunrise, cycle along mountain trails, run by the sea, or simply enjoy the silence and the views from home.
All this without sacrificing outstanding connectivity, with fast access to the airport and direct links to the main European cities.
Ocean Hills is a residential project of 18 villas conceived for those who value quality of life, efficiency and sustainability.
Homes designed to be lived in, with contemporary architecture, bright spaces, privacy, and a constant connection with the outdoors.
FEEL LIFE, ALL YEAR ROUND Los Cristianos, South Tenerife Los Cristianos is one of the most complete and highly regarded locations in the south of Tenerife.
An enclave that combines the authenticity of a town that is vibrant all year round with the quality of services, infrastructure, and connections that international residents seek.

Unlike other, more tourist-focused areas, Los Cristianos offers real everyday life: wide, well-kept beaches, a seafront promenade, shops, restaurants, sports centres, a hospital, schools, and a calm, safe atmosphere.
All on a comfortable, human scale, designed to be enjoyed without haste.
Living in Los Cristianos is not just passing through.

Request info STRATEGIC LOCATION Everything within 15 minutes Just a few minutes from Tenerife South Airport, with direct connections to major European cities and excellent links to the rest of the island.
From here, access to golf courses, natural areas, mountain trails and renowned beaches is immediate.
Los Cristianos is also a privileged destination for those who value an active, healthy lifestyle.
Sea and mountains come together in everyday life, allowing you to enjoy outdoor sports all year round in one of the best climates in Europe.
View location The villas offer built areas ranging from 250 m² to 312 m², set on private plots starting at 370 m², all of them featuring a private pool.
The development is complemented by a landscaped communal area of approximately 600 m², with exclusive access and designed as a peaceful space for relaxation.
Kitchen with a spacious area and natural light.
Bright living area with visual connection to the outdoors.
Outdoor swimming pool for private use.
Light-filled bedroom designed for maximum comfort.

SPACES DESIGNED TO BE LIVED IN The Ocean Hills project is made up of 18 villas arranged in three distinct areas: A, B and C, allowing for an orderly layout of the complex and a clear separation of spaces.
Areas A and B are composed of M1-type villas, while in area C you will find M2-type villas, which offer a slightly larger floor area.
This configuration is based on criteria of location, orientation and relationship with the surroundings, maintaining a consistent architectural identity throughout the project.

Unlike other, more tourist-oriented areas, Los Cristianos offers real everyday life: wide, well-maintained beaches, a seafront promenade, shops, restaurants, sports facilities, a hospital, schools and a calm, safe atmosphere.
Everything is on a comfortable scale, designed to be enjoyed without haste.
The M1 villas offer floor areas ranging from 247 m² to 260 m², while the M2 villas range from 276 m² to 306 m².
These areas are complemented by private gardens and outdoor spaces, whose size varies depending on the plot.
The development has been designed to provide privacy, optimal orientation, and open views, creating a peaceful residential setting in which all homes are integrated in a harmonious way.

GARAGE | POOL | TERRACE | GARDEN All the homes have an A energy rating, ensuring high efficiency, thermal comfort, and lower energy consumption, in line with a more conscious and sustainable way of living.
MAXIMUM COMFORT Each home is arranged across four levels, creating a comfortable and well-balanced living experience where every space has a clearly defined purpose.
All villas feature three bedrooms, offering a harmonious and versatile layout, ideal both as a primary residence and as a second home.
Some layouts include a lift, adding an extra level of comfort and accessibility without compromising on design.

Request Info The design of Ocean Hills bears the signature of the Puerta 35 Arquitectura studio, founded by architect Iván Guisado, whose career combines international experience in London with a deep connection to the Canary Islands.
With a contemporary vision that is rigorous and sensitive to its surroundings, the studio has developed multiple high‑quality residential projects in Tenerife.
Its architecture stands out for creating functional, serene, and light‑filled homes, conceived to enjoy every corner with ease and elegance.
Spaces that invite rest, family life, outdoor living, and that sense of balance so characteristic of the climate and energy of South Tenerife.
The result is a contemporary project, warm and meticulously crafted in every detail.
An architecture with its own identity, tailored to you and to the place where you want to be.

The project is ideal for families, investors and anyone who wants a superior living or vacation space in the heart of Istria.
Its uniqueness lies in the combination of urban elegance, an exceptional location and luxurious equipment.
The building is located in the vibrant core of Umag, just a few minutes' walk from the promenade, restaurants, cafes, shops and cultural facilities.
The proximity of the sea, amenities and the historical center makes this location ideal for living without compromise.
Umag is excellently connected by traffic with the rest of Croatia and abroad - within a three-hour drive there are airports in Pula, Trieste, Ljubljana and Zagreb.
Green Tower has nine above-ground and one underground floor.
The areas range from 67 to 223 m².
On floors 3 to 6, there are six apartments, while on higher floors there are larger and duplex apartments, a total of 38.
Restaurants, cafes and reception are planned on the ground floor, and a garage in the basement.
An elevator, garage and outdoor parking spaces are available to the tenants.
The building is equipped with heat pumps, smart home systems, security doors and surveillance, and high energy efficiency ensures long-term savings and comfort.

sale Apartments Poreč sale Houses sale Kaštela Frequently Asked Questions What are the advantages of buying a new construction property?
Buying a new construction property offers numerous benefits: energy efficiency, modern construction standards, contemporary architecture, and lower maintenance costs.
Such properties often come with new installations, contractor warranties, and the possibility of personalizing the interior before moving in.
New constructions are particularly attractive to those who want long-term value and a peaceful life without additional investments immediately after purchase.
Is there a warranty on new construction properties?

Yes, according to the Construction Act, investors are required to provide a warranty for hidden defects for a minimum of 2 years, while for certain parts of the building (construction, waterproofing, etc.) it can be longer.
When buying from a reputable investor, you can get additional warranty conditions.
Our agency works exclusively with verified projects and ensures warranty transparency.
Can I buy a new construction property that is still under construction?

Yes, it is possible to buy an apartment or a house while the project is still under construction, which is called "purchase based on a preliminary contract." This option often allows for a more favorable price and the ability to choose interior materials (tiles, parquet, wall colors).
In this case, payments are made in phases, and the agency monitors the construction progress and ensures that all contract conditions are met.
How does buying a new construction differ from buying an old property?
With new construction, you buy the property directly from the investor, which means that in most cases you do not pay real estate transfer tax (3%), because VAT is already included in the price.
Also, the documentation is modern, technically correct and there is no need for adaptation.
On the other hand, with older properties, additional investments, legality checks and more attention are often needed when buying.
What does the price of a new construction include?
The price depends on the project, location and equipment.
In most cases, all construction work, connections, parquet, ceramics, sanitary ware and basic lighting are included.
A garage space, storage room or interior design according to the buyer's wishes are often paid extra.
Our agents can provide you with a complete cost estimate and suggestions for personalization within the project.
Can new constructions be purchased with a housing loan?
Yes, most banks in Croatia are happy to finance the purchase of new buildings, especially if they are projects with proper documentation and a use permit.
If the project is under construction, payments are made in phases under the supervision of the bank.
Our team can connect you with loan advisors and help you prepare the necessary documentation.
When can I move into an apartment purchased in a new building?
You can move in as soon as the project receives a use permit and you fulfill all financial obligations (payment of the price, signing the contract).
If the project is in the final phase, moving in is possible within a few weeks.
In the earlier stages, the agent will inform you about the expected completion date and payment dynamics.
What is a use permit and why is it important?
A use permit is an official document that confirms that the building was built in accordance with the building permit and can be safely used.
Without a use permit, it is not possible to legally move in or register ownership in the land register.
When buying through our agency, we always ensure that the project has or will have a use permit by the time of delivery.
What is the role of the agency when buying a new construction?

The Regent agency provides you with: advice on project selection, insight into the cost estimate and technical specifications, assistance in negotiations and reservations, legal check of documentation, communication with the investor, bank and notary.
With us, you buy more safely and informed - without unpleasant surprises.
Are there projects available with a "turnkey" purchase option?
Yes, our offer includes projects with a "turnkey" option, where the property is fully finished and ready to move in, including a bathroom, kitchen, floors, lighting and, if desired, furniture.
This option saves time and additional costs, and is particularly popular with buyers from abroad.
What should I pay attention to when buying a new construction?
Buying a new building has many advantages, but it is important to ensure that the property meets all the conditions for a safe and quality investment.
The key factor is the reliability of the investor and contractor - their past reputation can give you an insight into the quality of construction and adherence to deadlines.

In order to ensure a carefree purchase process, our expert team checks all relevant documentation, including the building and use permit, to make sure that the property is legally built and ready for occupancy.
We also take care of the quality of materials and finishing works and provide you with professional advice to make the right decision.

With us, you do not have to go through this process alone - we offer expert support in all phases of the purchase, from negotiations with the investor to checking the contract and organizing a technical inspection of the property.
What are the hidden costs when buying a new construction?
In addition to the purchase price itself, when buying a new building, additional costs may arise that are important to consider.
One of them is the cost of furnishing the apartment, as new buildings often come without built-in furniture or a kitchen.
Some investors offer parking spaces or garages for an additional fee, which can also be an additional cost.

It is advisable to study the sales contract in detail and consult with the agency that represents you to make sure that all costs are clearly defined and that there are no unpleasant surprises after the purchase.

About this project Muriya Project general facts Jebel Sifah – Raya is a serene residential community set along Oman’s spectacular northern coastline, where the dramatic Al Hajar Mountains meet the calm blue waters of the Gulf.
Located just 35 minutes from Muscat city centre, the development offers a peaceful retreat that blends contemporary living with the beauty of nature.

Designed as a destination for relaxation and everyday comfort, Raya creates an atmosphere of openness, sunshine, and tranquility, making it an ideal choice for families and individuals seeking a refined coastal lifestyle.

The project features a distinctive collection of villas tailored to different lifestyles, including the Majlis Villas, inspired by contemporary Arabian design, and the Wellness Villas, created to promote calm and holistic living.
Surrounded by golf course views, landscaped walking trails, and lush open spaces, the community encourages a balanced way of life with a strong connection to the outdoors.
Residents can enjoy private gardens, panoramic mountain scenery, and a thoughtfully planned environment that supports both relaxation and social interaction in a naturally beautiful setting.
Each villa is finished with high-quality contemporary materials that complement the project’s elegant architectural character.

The residences include fully equipped kitchens and are delivered unfurnished, offering homeowners the freedom to personalize their interiors while enjoying a modern and comfortable living space in one of Oman’s most scenic residential destinations.
Location description and benefits Jebel Sifah is a picturesque coastal destination located just 45 minutes from Muscat, Oman’s vibrant capital.
Nestled between the rugged Al Hajar Mountains and the serene waters of the Arabian Sea, this idyllic locale offers breathtaking natural beauty and a tranquil environment.
Its unspoiled beaches and stunning landscapes create an oasis of relaxation, perfect for those seeking a peaceful coastal retreat.
As a premium residential and lifestyle destination, Jebel Sifah boasts a harmonious blend of modern living and traditional charm.
The area features elegant residential developments, a state-of-the-art marina, and an array of fine dining and leisure options.
Its thoughtful design and luxurious amenities ensure a sophisticated lifestyle amidst nature's beauty, making it a sought-after location for homeowners and investors alike.
Jebel Sifah’s appeal extends beyond luxury living to an active lifestyle focused on wellness and recreation.
