FAQ This FAQ answers the key questions about Tasvan Lombok, including the 80-year leasehold structure, payment process, construction, rental management, resale, and property transfer, helping investors understand the project before making a decision.
What is the ownership structure of the villa?
Tasvan Lombok is offered under an 80-year leasehold structure , arranged as 30 + 30 + 20 years , with no additional lease extension cost within this 80-year period.
Do I need to set up a company in Indonesia?
No.
The leasehold structure is designed to be administratively simpler, meaning investors do not need to establish a company solely to hold the villa under this structure.
Are my payments protected during construction?

The project follows a staged payment structure, with payments after the initial contract transferred through the notary escrow account according to the agreed payment schedule and construction progress.
The applicable protection mechanisms are governed by the contractual documents and payment terms.
How long will construction take?
The estimated construction period is approximately 20 to 24 months , with payments progressively aligned with the project timeline and construction progress.
Can I rent the villa on Airbnb or Booking.com?
Yes.
The villa is designed to support short-term rental through platforms such as Airbnb and Booking.com , subject to applicable licensing, management requirements, and local regulations.
Can Tasvan manage the villa for me?

Tasvan offers full rental management for a 15% management fee , including reservations, guest check-in and check-out, dynamic pricing, property listings, performance reporting, and maintenance coordination.
Can I resell my villa before construction is completed?
Yes, resale may be possible before construction is completed, subject to the conditions stated in the agreement and approval from the developer.
Can I transfer the villa to my children or heirs?
Transfer to children or heirs can be arranged, subject to the applicable legal structure, inheritance planning, and Indonesian regulations.
Can I choose my preferred villa unit?
Investors may select their preferred villa based on current availability.
Early selection is recommended, as unit allocation follows the reservation process and remaining inventory.
What happens after the 80-year leasehold period?
The current structure provides a total leasehold period of 80 years .
Any arrangement beyond that period would depend on the land status, legal structure, applicable regulations, and terms available at that time.

Request details & download brochure FIX Residences is a collection of 95 private residences designed by Foster + Partners at the heart of FIX Thessaloniki, DIMAND’s regeneration of the historic FIX brewery at the city’s western gateway.
Greece Sotheby’s International Realty is the exclusive sales agent for the residences, offered with guide prices from €420,000.
For more than a century, the FIX brewery defined Thessaloniki’s industrial skyline.
Today it enters a new chapter as one of the city’s most significant landmark destinations.

Shaped by a masterplan from Foster + Partners, FIX Thessaloniki places an industrial legacy in dialogue with contemporary architecture, creating a new expression of urban living in Greece’s second largest city.

FIX Residences at a Glance Location: 26th October Street, western gateway of Thessaloniki, between the port and the historic city centre Developer: DIMAND Architecture: Foster + Partners – masterplan and new buildings design Residences: 95 homes over nine storeys, with one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments and five penthouses, two of them duplexes Apartment sizes: Approximately 63 to 339 sq.m.

Guide prices: From €420,000 to €4.22 million Completion: Scheduled for the end of 2029 Sustainability: Bioclimatic design, targeting LEED Gold certification Services: Dedicated entrance, private residents’ lounge, concierge, 24-hour security, private storage, and underground parking Technology: KNX and DALI automation, high-speed fibre and satellite infrastructure Exclusive sales: Greece Sotheby’s International Realty A New Urban Destination at Thessaloniki’s Western Gateway Set between the port and the historic city centre on 26th October Street, the approximately 25,000 sq.m.
development reimagines Thessaloniki’s western gateway.
Residences, culture, hospitality, wellness and gastronomy blend within a single address, framed by landscaped area of 15,000 sq.m.

The listed buildings and original elements of the former brewery, among them the 1959 bottling facility by Takis Zenetos, are carefully preserved and woven into the new architecture, honouring a site central to the city’s industrial and urban history.
FIX connects directly to the historic centre and the waterfront, and Thessaloniki International Airport “Makedonia” lies 17 km away.
Culture at its Heart Culture lies at the epicentre of FIX Thessaloniki.

The development will host MOMus – Museum of Modern Art, home to the internationally acclaimed Costakis Collection of Russian avant-garde art, alongside the permanent home of the Thessaloniki State Symphony Orchestra and the State Conservatory of Thessaloniki.
This way, art, music and creativity become part of the district’s everyday rhythm, just steps from home.
Hospitality and Wellbeing Hilton Thessaloniki will bring five-star hospitality to the complex across two buildings, one of them a listed building of the original brewery.

Beyond its rooms and suites, the hotel will offer a contemporary spa and hammam, restaurants and bars, and a rooftop pool with views over the city and the sea, bringing an elevated standard of hospitality and wellbeing to the life of the neighbourhood.
The Residences: Architecture by Foster + Partners At the centre of the development, FIX Residences brings a new residential address to Thessaloniki.

Designed by Foster + Partners and targeting LEED Gold certification, the nine-storey building comprises 95 private residences, defined by an architectural language that draws on the character of the historic FIX complex.

Sculpted brick façades, vaulted forms and industrial-style windows offer a contemporary interpretation of the site’s heritage, while bioclimatic design principles and considered interiors place comfort, efficiency and quality at the forefront of everyday living.
Services, Amenities and Technology A dedicated entrance and private residents’ lounge set the tone on arrival, complemented by concierge services.

Every residence is allocated a private storage unit and underground parking, with electrical capacity for electric-vehicle charging, while KNX and DALI technology provide intelligent control of lighting and climate, including remote management.
High-speed fibre, satellite infrastructure and fire-detection systems complete a residential environment designed around the expectations of contemporary life.
Residents also enjoy the wider FIX quarter: landscaped gardens, pocket parks, and pedestrian areas, with the hotel’s spa and wellness facilities steps away.

Residences for Sale The development comprises 95 residences across floors one to nine, offering the following range of apartment types and sizes: One-bedroom residences of 63 to 93 sq.m., with guide prices from €420,000 (one parking lot included) Two-bedroom residences of 102 to 154 sq.m., with guide prices from €815,000 (one parking lot included) Three-bedroom residences of 130 to 196 sq.m., with guide prices from €1,230,000 (two parking lots included) Penthouses of 165 sq.m.

to 339 sq.m., including two duplexes spanning the seventh and eighth and the eighth and ninth floors respectively, all with private terraces and guide prices from €2,030,000 to €4,220,000 (three parking lots included) Investment Perspective: Golden Visa and Non-Dom FIX Residences combines a landmark heritage address, Foster + Partners architecture and new-build living in Thessaloniki, where comparable product remains limited.
Selected residences may qualify for the Greek Golden Visa programme , while buyers transferring their tax residence to Greece may also consider the Greek Non-Dom programme .
Eligibility is assessed individually, and independent legal and tax advice is recommended.

FIX Residences stands within FIX Thessaloniki, the regeneration of the historic FIX brewery on 26th October Street at the western gateway of Thessaloniki, between the port and the historic city centre.
Thessaloniki International Airport “Makedonia” is 17 km away.
Who is the developer and who designed FIX Residences?
DIMAND, the listed Greek real estate developer, is developing FIX Thessaloniki.
Foster + Partners designed both the masterplan and the FIX Residences building.
How many residences does FIX Residences include?
The building comprises 95 private residences over nine storeys, from one-bedroom apartments of 63 sq.m.
to a 339 sq.m.
duplex penthouse.
What are the prices at FIX Residences Thessaloniki?
Guide prices in the current release range from €430,000 for a one-bedroom residence to €4,220,000 for Penthouse 801.

When will FIX Residences be completed?
Completion is scheduled for the end of 2029.
Does FIX Residences qualify for the Greek Golden Visa?

What amenities and services are included?

PREGUNTAS FRECUENTES ✅ Preguntas sobre la constructora ¿Cuáles son los proyectos actuales que está desarrollando la constructora?

Actualmente posee Hotel Boutique Oceana Esplendor, ⁠Rivera Bay, The reef, Poseidonia Residences, Jardines de Bellas Artes, entre otros ✅ Preguntas sobre el proceso y forma de pago ¿Con cuánto puedo reservar un apartamento en Punta Cana?
Puedes reservar tu apartamento en City Place Punta Cana con solo USD 3,000.
Esta reserva asegura tu unidad mientras formalizas el proceso de compra.
¿Cuál es la forma de pago y los porcentajes durante la construcción?
El plan de pago estándar es 20 % al firmar contrato, 40 % durante la construcción y 40 % contra entrega.
También hay opciones con descuentos por pronto pago.
¿Qué opciones de financiación ofrece la constructora para comprar en Punta Cana?
City Place permite financiar tu propiedad directamente con el desarrollador durante la construcción, y también puedes optar por financiamiento bancario al momento de la entrega.
✅ Preguntas sobre el proyecto ¿Cuándo inicia el proyecto en Punta Cana?
El proyecto City Place se desarrolla por fases.
La primera etapa ya se encuentra en ejecución y contempla 6 edificios iniciales.
¿Cuál es la fecha estimada de entrega de las unidades?
Las entregas están programadas para octubre de 2026 y mayo de 2027, según el avance de cada edificio.
¿Las unidades se entregan amobladas?
El mobiliario no está incluido, pero sí se ofrece un paquete opcional de muebles, ideal para quienes buscan rentar o habitar de inmediato.
¿Incluyen línea blanca al momento de la entrega?
Sí.
Los apartamentos se entregan con estufa vitrocerámica, horno, campana extractora, calentador de agua y aires acondicionados en habitaciones.
¿Las unidades incluyen aire acondicionado?
Todas las unidades incluyen aires acondicionados tipo split.
Estudio: 1 unidad de 18K BTU 1 habitación: 1 unidad de 12K BTU 2 habitaciones: 2 unidades de 12K BTU ¿El proyecto cuenta con administración hotelera y cuál es su costo?
Actualmente no cuenta con un programa de administración hotelera, pero por su ubicación y amenidades, es ideal para alquileres vacacionales gestionados por terceros.
¿Incluye parqueadero cada unidad?
Cada apartamento cuenta con parqueo asignado, y además se dispone de parqueaderos para visitantes dentro del complejo.
¿Cuál es el costo mensual de la administración del proyecto?
El valor estimado de mantenimiento es: USD 150 para estudios y apartamentos de 1 habitación USD 200 para apartamentos de 2 habitaciones ¿Cuántos niveles tiene el proyecto en Punta Cana?
Los edificios tienen varios niveles residenciales más un rooftop, donde se encuentra la piscina y el área social.
Cada edificio también cuenta con lobby, ascensor y parqueo techado.
¿Qué distancia tiene el proyecto hasta la playa?
City Place se encuentra a 10 minutos en vehículo de Playa Bávaro, una de las playas más reconocidas del Caribe dominicano.
¿Cuántas unidades tiene el proyecto?
El proyecto completo tendrá 1,209 apartamentos distribuidos en 19 edificios, con la primera fase compuesta por 386 unidades.
¿Qué amenidades ofrece el proyecto?

City Place cuenta con amenidades premium como: Piscina en rooftop Área social en azotea Lobby concierge Parque para mascotas Zona infantil Cafetería, panadería, lavandería, boutique, bar y estudio de yoga Plataforma musical y senderos ecológicos Central Park con fuentes interactivas y ciclovía ¿Qué amenidades tiene la comunidad alrededor del proyecto?
Está rodeado de centros empresariales, centros médicos, plazas comerciales, restaurantes, supermercados y a solo 2 minutos del Downtown Punta Cana, el núcleo urbano más activo de la zona.
¿Existe algún convenio para ingresar a un club de playa cercano?
Todos los propietarios reciben un año gratuito de membresía al Serenade Beach Club, con opción de renovación.
¿Cuál es el costo de administración de la comunidad?
Después del primer año gratuito, la membresía al Serenade Beach Club tiene un costo de USD 1,500 anuales.

read T By Timoci Vula Listen to this article: --> Suva’s Central Business District with an artistic impression of Tabua Tower.

Picture: SUPPLIED A 19-level mixed-use commercial landmark is under construction in Suva’s central business district that is set to become a cornerstone of the capital city’s next-generation urban growth.

The Tabua Tower project by Frontier Investments Ltd combined premium commercial space, corporate hotel, residential apartments and retail offerings designed to meet demand from modern businesses and forward-thinking investors.

At the core of the development are six strata office floors, each offering approximately 900sqm of open plan; and the layouts are said to be ideal for headquarters, consultancies, law firms and owner-occupiers seeking titled ownership in a landmark building.
Architect and project promoter Vijay Sharma said this was a rare opportunity to secure commercial floor space in the Suva CBD.
“We’re introducing strata-titled office ownership in a premium tower, something the Suva market has not seen before and it’s exactly what today’s professionals and firms are seeking,” Mr Sharma said.
He said Tabua Tower would incorporate energy-efficient lighting, passive ventilation, water-saving fixtures and a façade system engineered for thermal performance.
“Our vision is not just about aesthetics.

It’s about building something that’s sustainable, smart, and future-ready – a development that represents the next chapter of Fiji’s commercial evolution.” Tabua Tower, which will be positioned on Forster Street, will include secure basement and podium parking, 24/7 security, statement lobby with retail spaces.
Frontier Investments Ltd had also called for expressions of interest for a limited release of the strata-titled floors and exclusive investment opportunities.
Beyond owning an office floor, investors can also acquire equity shares in Frontier Investments, allowing participation in the broader financial returns of the project.
This structure, he said would be appealing to diaspora investors, regional business groups and institutional partners.
Construction is now underway with project completion expected in the first quarter of 2028.

, March 5, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- For waterfront buyers who think in cycles rather than seasons, March represents a defined moment.
Time spent in Florida during the winter months brings clarity around lifestyle priorities, daily routines, and the long-term investment decisions that follow from both.

Within the lifecycle of a pre-construction community, it also marks a point when early selection remains available, before construction planning advances and later-phase pricing frameworks come into view.
Continue Reading Credit: Marina Pointe At Marina Pointe, that moment has arrived for Luna, the second residential tower within Tampa Bay's Westshore Marina District.

Luna offers a limited collection of new-construction waterfront residences ranging from approximately 1,100 to more than 3,500 square feet, including one-, two-, and three-bedroom layouts as well as a small number of larger-format residences.
Pre-construction pricing currently begins at approximately $1 million, positioning Luna favorably relative to completed waterfront condominiums across Southeast U.S.
and comparable new-construction offerings in markets such as Miami, Palm Beach, Naples, and Sarasota, where new waterfront condominiums often command materially higher entry points.
"Waterfront buyers are thoughtful by nature," said Dominic Pickering, Executive Director of Marina Pointe.
"They are not chasing trends.
They are thinking about how they want to live five, ten, even twenty years from now.

Buyers who act early within a strong community benefit the most, in both lifestyle and long-term value." What Early Buyers at Marina Pointe's First Tower Understood Marina Pointe has already moved through one full cycle.

When buyers committed to the community's first residential tower during its pre-construction phase, the marina was not yet active, the district was still emerging, and the broader vision required a degree of foresight.
Those buyers were not reacting to a finished product, they were evaluating fundamentals: location, marina access, the private peninsula setting, and long-term waterfront scarcity.
Their commitments were also structured with a measured financial approach.
Buyers entered during pre-construction with a minimal initial deposit, followed by a staggered payment schedule tied to construction milestones.
This allowed purchasers to secure waterfront positioning early while maintaining liquidity as the community and surrounding district evolved.
From pre-construction contract through completion and resale, select residences experienced significant appreciation.
One early buyer purchased a 15th-floor residence for $1,580,922 and resold it approximately three years later for $2,450,000.
A 16th-floor residence originally purchased for $1,267,436 resold in 2025 for $1,800,000.
Recorded sales prices are available through public records.
For other early buyers, those gains remain unrealized by choice.
They continue to enjoy their residences today, paired with a waterfront Florida lifestyle they were able to experience while the marina, promenades, and surrounding district matured around them.
Luna: A Similar Moment in the Cycle — Within a Far More Observable Environment Unlike Marina Pointe's first tower, Luna launches into a community already alive.
The private marina is fully operational.
Waterfront promenades are active.
Marina Landings Town Center is open and serving residents daily.
The peninsula setting, access points, and residential character of the community are clearly defined and functioning as intended.
What remains early is the opportunity within Luna itself.
The Westshore Marina District is one of Tampa Bay's most intentionally planned waterfront environments defined by marina access, controlled density, and long-term residential orientation.

Buyers entering Luna are not underwriting an untested neighborhood; they are securing a position within a waterfront district that is already active, increasingly established, and continuing to evolve with intention.

For buyers evaluating value not just in absolute terms but in relation to replacement cost, location, and long-term scarcity, this stage of the Luna release offers a compelling early-cycle point of entry.

A March Consideration for Buyers Who Move with Perspective In recognition of this early-cycle moment, a limited March consideration valued at $10,000 is being extended to buyers who formalize their purchase during this window.
This is an acknowledgment of decisiveness at a point in the development cycle where early commitments continue to shape long-term outcomes.
Private appointments are now being scheduled at the Marina Pointe sales gallery.

An on-site visit provides the opportunity to experience the waterfront environment firsthand, review the historical performance of Marina Pointe's first residential tower, and understand how Luna is positioned within the broader evolution of the Westshore Marina District.
To schedule a private appointment or learn more, visit MarinaPointe.com or contact the Luna at Marina Pointe sales team at 813.683.8944 .

Nee, buitenlanders kunnen geen grond bezitten op Bali.
Hak Milik (vrije eigendom) is alleen voor Indonesische burgers.
Buitenlandse kopers gebruiken meestal erfpacht of Hak Pakai (gebruiksrecht) voor residentiële doeleinden.
Bij ZAYARI raden we het volgende aan erfpacht in combinatie met Hak Pakai omdat het betaalbaarder is, rechtszekerheid biedt en je alle rechten geeft die je nodig hebt zonder onnodige complexiteit.

Samenvatting: Vrije grond = alleen Indonesiërs Erfpacht + Hak Pakai = aanbevolen, veilig & kosteneffectief PT PMA (bedrijf) is niet perse nodig tenzij je het bedrijf zelf wilt runnen Welke due diligence wordt er gedaan op het land?

We controleren eigendomstitels, bestemmingsplannen en vergunningen voordat we land leasen We voeren due diligence uit om de rechten van de landeigenaar te bevestigen, bestemmingsplannen voor toeristisch/residentieel gebruik te controleren en bouw-/exploitatievergunningen te verifiëren.
Dit voorkomt verrassingen en zorgt voor naleving.
We raden klanten altijd aan om ook hun eigen due diligence uit te voeren.
Samenvatting: Titel controleren (eigendom, lasten) Controleer bestemming (toerisme/residentieel) Vergunningen bevestigen (bouw/operationeel) Kan leasehold worden verlengd of vernieuwd?
Ja, indien onderhandeld en notarieel bekrachtigd.
Een lease overeenkomst wordt niet automatisch verlengd.
Verlengingen moeten worden geregeld met de landeigenaar en worden vastgelegd door een notaris.
Bij ZAYARI onderhandelen we waar mogelijk vooraf over duidelijke verlengingsvoorwaarden, zodat je rechten voorspelbaar zijn.
Samenvatting: Geen automatische verlenging Uitbreidingen per contract + notaris ZAYARI voert de onderhandelingen voor jou Kan ik mijn leasecontract tijdens de looptijd doorverkopen of overdragen?
Ja, als het contract overdracht toestaat.
Een lease overeenkomst kan worden verkocht of overgedragen aan een nieuwe koper voor de resterende looptijd, zolang de overeenkomst dit toestaat.
Wij zorgen ervoor dat je leaseovereenkomst overdraagbaar is, zodat je flexibiliteit behoudt.

Samenvatting: Overdracht mogelijk met toestemming landeigenaar + notaris Koper neemt resterende jaren over ZAYARI zorgt ervoor dat leases overdraagbaar zijn Kan ik een villa financieren met een hypotheek of bieden jullie betalingsregelingen?
Lokale hypotheken voor buitenlanders zijn zeldzaam; in plaats daarvan bieden we gestructureerde betalingsplannen aan.
Indonesische banken verstrekken over het algemeen geen leningen aan buitenlandse particulieren.
Bij ZAYARI volgen kopers een gefaseerd betalingsplan gekoppeld aan mijlpalen in de bouw, waardoor het voorspelbaar en veilig is.

Het is ook mogelijk om een financiëring te krijgen wanneer er overwaarde is op vastgoed in Nederland Samenvatting: Hypotheken voor buitenlanders = zeer beperkt Fase betalingen = standaard aanpak Gekoppeld aan bouwmijlpalen, niet alleen vooraf Wat voor rendement kan ik realistisch gezien verwachten?
Rendementen zijn afhankelijk van bezetting, dagprijzen en kosten.
12-20% netto is wat ons betreft realistisch.
Bali villa’s kunnen goed presteren als ze professioneel worden beheerd.
Met een goede bezettingsgraad en marktconforme prijzen zien veel investeerders nettorendementen van 12-20%.
Wij rekenen voor onze projecten met 14% om schattingen aan de conservatieve kant te laten zien.
Wie beheert mijn villa als ik er niet ben?
Wij werken samen met House of Reservations , een erkende touroperator met jarenlange ervaring.
Zij zorgen voor alles, van marketing tot gastenservice, schoonmaak, personeel en naleving van de belastingwetgeving.
Op deze manier wordt je villa volledig beheerd, zelfs als je in het buitenland woont.
Natuurlijk ben je vrij om elk managementbedrijf te kiezen (of geen), maar we raden dit ten zeerste aan om een hoge ROI te bereiken.
Samenvatting: Professionele gediplomeerde operator Full-service beheer (van boekingen tot schoonmaak) Hands-off voor investeerders Moet ik fysiek in Bali aanwezig om te kunnen investeren?
Nee, alles kan op afstand worden geregeld.
Ook al raden we een bezoek aan en willen we je graag ontmoeten: Met een volmacht en digitale ondertekening hoef je niet op Bali te zijn.
We sturen updates via foto’s en video zodat je altijd op de hoogte bent.

Mida Venture Villas Bali pakub?
Aitame Eesti investoritel nagu Sina teenida 10-16% aastast renditootlust, investeerides kiiresti kasvavasse Bali kinnisvaraturgu – ilma liigse ajakulu, määramatu stressi ja suurte riskideta.
Meie hoolitseme kõige eest: alates ettevõtte loomisest Balil kuni luksusvilla ehituse, halduse ja vajadusel edasimüügini.
Sina lihtsalt investeerid ja naudid muretut tootlust.
Kas ma vajan viisat, et Balil kinnisvara osta?
Ei vaja.
Kinnisvarasse investeerimiseks ei ole viisat tarvis.
Kui soovid aga kohapeale tulla, villasid oma silmaga näha ja meie meeskonnaga kohtuda, aitame sind meeleldi viisa vormistamisel.
Ühekordne viisa maksab 38 eurot ja kehtib 30 päeva.
Miks peaksin investeerima Bali kinnisvarasse?
Bali on üks maailma kiiremini arenevaid sihtkohti, kus turismi kasv ja rahvusvaheline kogukond loovad pideva nõudluse luksuslike üüripindade järele.
See tähendab stabiilset täituvust, tugevat renditulu ja kinnisvara väärtuse pidevat kasvu.
Näiteks: - Kinnisvara hinnad on Balil kasvanud keskmiselt 7% aastas viimase viie aasta jooksul – paljudes piirkondades isegi rohkem.
- Kinnisvaratehingute arv kasvas 2024.
aastal 30%, peegeldades investorite usaldust turu vastu.
- Renditulu ulatus 2024.
aastal üle 1,4 miljardi dollari, mis on 25% kasv võrreldes eelmise aastaga.
Bali kinnisvara aitab mitmekesistada sinu investeerimisportfelli turul, mis pakub korraga tugevat passiivset tootlust ja kapitali kasvupotentsiaali.
Mis on Offplan ja mis on Onplan kinnisvara soetamine?
Balil saab kinnisvara soetada kahel viisil: Offplan ehk alles valmiv arendus või Onplan ehk juba valmis luksusvilla.
Offplan – suurem tootluse potentsiaal, kõrgem riskitase ‍ ‍ Offplan tähendab investeerimist kinnisvarasse enne selle valmimist.
See annab võimaluse kujundada villa vastavalt oma soovidele ning osta see oluliselt soodsama hinnaga.
Kuna valminud kinnisvara väärtus on selgelt kõrgem, võib Offplan arendus pakkuda kuni 40% aastast tootlust .
Samas tuleb arvestada, et renditulu saab teenima hakata alles pärast valmimist ning ehitusperioodiga võivad kaasneda teatud riskid ja ootamatused.
Onplan – valmis kinnisvara, stabiilne ja kohe toimiv ‍ ‍ Onplan tähendab valmis villa ostmist.
Sa näed täpselt kinnisvara seisukorda, kasutatud materjale ja saad kohe hakata teenima renditulu.
Kuigi hinnakasv ei pruugi olla nii kiire kui Offplan puhul, on see siiski märkimisväärne – viimase nelja aasta jooksul on Balil kinnisvara väärtus tõusnud keskmiselt 9,4% aastas .
Mõlemad variandid on tugevad investeerimisvõimalused – küsimus on, millist tüüpi investor just sina oled.
Kui otsid suuremat tootlust ja oled valmis võtma rohkem riski, sobib sulle Offplan.
Kui hindad prognoositavust ja soovid kohe tulu teenima hakata, on parim valik Onplan.
Millised kulud on seotud Bali kinnisvara ostmisega?
Lisaks kinnisvara hinnale tuleb arvestada ka juriidiliste kulude, maksude, notari tasude ja hoolduskuludega.
Meie tiim annab sulle enne ostu täpse ja läbipaistva ülevaate kõikidest kaasnevatest kuludest , et sa ei peaks kartma peidetud tasusid ega ebameeldivaid üllatusi.
Meie eesmärk on muuta kogu ostuprotsess selgeks, lihtsaks ja stressivabaks , pakkudes sulle kindlust igas etapis.
Milliste maksudega pean ma Balile investeerides arvestama?

Bali kinnisvarainvesteeringutega kaasnevad järgmised maksud: - 10% tulumaks igakuise renditulu pealt - 10% tulumaks kinnisvara müügi korral (arvestatakse müügihinnast) - Maamaks , ligikaudu 15 € aastas - 10% tulumaks dividendide väljavõtmisel , kui tulu võetakse välja ettevõttest omaniku kontole Kõik maksud on selged ja hallatavad.
Meie meeskond aitab sul need õigesti deklareerida ja tasuda, et kogu investeerimisprotsess kulgeks sujuvalt ja muretult.
Kas välismaalased saavad legaalselt omada kinnisvara Balil?
Jah, välismaalastel on võimalik Balil kinnisvarasse investeerida täiesti seaduslikult, kasutades selleks spetsiaalseid juriidilisi struktuure.
Levinumad võimalused on pikaajaline rendileping (leasehold) või PMA-ettevõtte (välisomanduses äriühingu) kaudu kinnisvara soetamine .
Meie meeskond juhendab sind kogu juriidilise protsessi vältel, hoolitseb dokumentide korrektsuse eest ja tagab, et sinu investeering vastab täielikult Indoneesia seadustele.
Kuidas Balil ettevõtet registreerida?
Ettevõtte loomine Balil võib kohalikus bürokraatias orienteerumata olla keeruline, kuid meie meeskond teeb selle sinu eest algusest lõpuni ära.
Sina lihtsalt: - Saadad meile kehtiva passi koopia - Täidad lühikese ankeedi isikuandmetega - Valid ettevõttele nime Kõik ülejäänu (dokumendid, load ja kooskõlastused) korraldame meie.
Sina lihtsalt jälgid mängu kõrvalt.
Protsess kestab keskmiselt kuni 4 nädalat, pärast mida on ettevõte ametlikult loodud ja valmis investeeringute tegemiseks ning kinnisvara haldamiseks.
Kui kaua rendileping kehtib?
Tavaliselt sõlmitakse maa rendileping Balil 25–30 aastaks , sõltuvalt asukohast ja maaomanikuga sõlmitud kokkuleppest.
Kõik lepingud allkirjastatakse notariaalselt , tagades juriidilise selguse ja turvalisuse.
Pärast esmase rendiperioodi lõppu on sul, kui investoril, esmaõigus lepingut pikendada kuni 30 aastaks.
Kuidas ma haldan kinnisvara, kui ma ei viibi Balil?
Meie täishaldusteenus teeb kinnisvara haldamise võimalikuks ka distantsilt.
Hoolitseme kõige eest – alates suhtlusest külaliste ja broneeringute haldamisega kuni koristuse, hoolduse ja aruandluseni.
Olenemata sellest, kas elad Eestis, Euroopas või mujal maailmas, tagab meie professionaalne tiim villa korrashoiu ning optimaalse täituvuse.
Renditulu on sinu jaoks täielikult passiivne – sina saad keskenduda oma elule, meie hoolitseme ülejäänu eest.
Mis saab siis, kui tahan hiljem oma kinnisvara müüa?
Kui otsustad tulevikus oma kinnisvara müüa, aitame sul kogu protsessi sujuvalt ja professionaalselt läbi viia.
Hoolitseme kõige eest – alates kuulutuse koostamisest ja turundusest kuni kliendisuhtluse, dokumentide ja müügitehingu lõpuleviimiseni.
Meie maakleritasu on 5% tehingu summast ning selle eest saad täieliku müügihalduse algusest lõpuni.
Sina ei pea ise millegi pärast muretsema – teeme ka väljumisstrateegia sinu eest lihtsaks ja läbipaistvaks.
Mis vahe on leasehold ja freehold omandivormil Balil?
Balil eksisteerib 2 peamist omandivormi.
Mõlema puhul saab omandiõiguse 100% ulatuses endale ka välismaalane (erinevalt mõnest teisest Aasia riigist).
Leasehold - Rendiõigus Välismaalasena Indoneesias maad omada ei saa ning parim lahendus on maa rentida Indoneesia kodanikult tavaliselt 30 aastaks, koos võimalusega pikendada veel 30.
Leasehold on kõige levinum, kuluefektiivsem ja turvalisem viis Indoneesias maad omada.
Freehold - Ehitusõigus Freehold on kasutatav mõiste kõnekeeles aga otsetõlkes on tegu õigusega ehitada.
See tähendab, et tegelikult on ka siin tegu maa rentimisega aga maa rendib välja mitte Indoneesia kodanik vaid riik.
Freehold'i puhul on võimalik maad rentida 30 aastaks, õigusega pikendada 20.
Seejärel peab uuendama lepingut ning sama stsenaarium saab korduda uuesti.

Ubicado a aproximadamente 80 kilómetros del aeropuerto de Palma de Mallorca , se puede llegar en coche en poco más de una hora.
Capdepera ofrece una variedad de actividades para todos los gustos.
Uno de los principales atractivos es el imponente y fortificado Castillo de Capdepera , una fortaleza del siglo XIV que ofrece vistas panorámicas espectaculares de la costa y el campo circundante.
Pasear por sus calles adoquinadas es como viajar en el tiempo, con numerosos rincones encantadores y vistas impresionantes.
El castillo es el corazón histórico del pueblo y un punto de referencia que no puedes dejar de visitar.
Los amantes de la playa encontrarán su paraíso en las cercanías.
Las playas de Cala Ratjada , como Cala Agulla y Son Moll , están a solo unos minutos en coche y son perfectas para disfrutar del sol y el mar cristalino.
Estas playas ofrecen instalaciones completas y opciones para practicar deportes acuáticos.
El mercado semanal de Capdepera, que se celebra los miércoles, es una visita obligada.
Aquí, los residentes y visitantes pueden encontrar productos frescos locales, artesanías y una variedad de artículos tradicionales, proporcionando una auténtica experiencia mallorquina.
Para los entusiastas de la naturaleza, Capdepera y sus alrededores ofrecen numerosas opciones de excursiones.
El Parque Natural de la Península de Llevant, a poca distancia, es ideal para el senderismo y la observación de la fauna y flora autóctona.
Además, las cuevas de Artà, ubicadas cerca, son una fascinante aventura subterránea que no te puedes perder.
Los aficionados al golf encontrarán en el Capdepera Golf un lugar excepcional para practicar su deporte favorito.
Este campo de golf de 18 hoyos, rodeado de colinas y valles, ofrece un entorno tranquilo y pintoresco, ideal tanto para jugadores experimentados como para principiantes.
Su diseño desafiante y sus impresionantes vistas lo convierten en una experiencia inolvidable para todos los amantes del golf.
Capdepera es un destino que combina historia, naturaleza y mar, ofreciendo una experiencia completa del encanto mediterráneo.
Vivir en Capdepera es disfrutar de un estilo de vida relajado y auténtico, rodeado de la belleza natural y la rica cultura de Mallorca.

It’s minutes from George Town, with connectivity to medical hubs, international schools, and retail districts.

Context Dispatch Environment Education, Health & Science Exclusive Construction Home Property Property Federal Land set to deliver second Seasons Tower as BGC demand soars By Context.ph November 28, 2024 Facebook X Pinterest WhatsApp Linkedin ReddIt Email Print Telegram LINE Viber Copy URL Federal Land Inc., the property development arm of the Ty family, is set to hand over the second tower of its Seasons Residences in Bonifacio Global City (BGC) to homeowners, as demand for its units continues to surge.
The company reported a “rapid uptake” of units in the first three towers, fueling expectations of success of its pre-selling campaign for the fourth tower, dubbed Fuyu .
The Fuyu tower, seen completed by the end of 2027, offers spacious two- and three-bedroom units.
Federal Land said the larger configurations, ranging from 60 to 177 square meters, are particularly appealing to growing families and professionals in need of extra space.

“Among its range of unit configurations, the two- and three-bedroom units stand out for their spacious layouts and exceptional views overlooking the vibrant Bonifacio Global City,” Federal Land said in a statement.
The units are designed to meet the demands of a diverse buyer base, from families to professionals.
The Seasons Residences project is a joint development between Federal Land, Japan’s Nomura Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., and Isetan Mitsukoshi Holdings Ltd.
The four-tower development is designed to bring a touch of Japanese culture to a Filipino setting.

Nikken Sekkei, the renowned Japanese architectural firm, was tapped to create the masterplan and design, focusing on a “convenient, ecological, stylish, and safe lifestyle.” Seasons Residences is located within Federal Land’s Grand Central Park township.

With demand for premium living spaces in BGC showing no signs of slowing down, Federal Land is confident the Fuyu Tower will meet the growing needs of its clients, continuing the success of its Seasons Residences development.

Developer's Profile FAQs About Vero & Versa Residences Talk to an Expert Who is the developer?

Vero & Versa is developed by Adriatic Marinas, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Investment Corporation of Dubai (ICD) — the principal sovereign wealth arm of the Government of Dubai with AED 1.47 trillion in assets.
All previous residential phases at Porto Montenegro have sold out.
Where are Vero & Versa located?

Both buildings are situated at the heart of Porto Montenegro, Tivat, Montenegro — 10 minutes from Tivat International Airport, 20 minutes from Old Town Kotor, and 1 hour 15 minutes from Dubrovnik Airport.
What types of properties are available?
Vero offers 155 residences: studios from 484 sq.ft, 1-bedroom from 570 sq.ft, 2-bedroom from 925 sq.ft, and 3-bedroom penthouses from 2,260 sq.ft.
Versa offers 47 apartments: studios, 1- and 2-bedroom homes.
What is the starting price?
Prices start from €390K for a studio at Vero and from €416K at Versa.
What is the payment plan?

A staged plan with a reservation deposit from €10K (deducted from your first instalment), 10% on Pre-SPA, 30% on SPA signing (less previous payments), 25% during construction across 2 milestones, and 20% on handover in Q4 2028.
When will Vero & Versa be completed?
Handover is scheduled for Q4 2028.
What amenities are available?

Residents access podium and rooftop pools, state-of-the-art gyms, ground-floor clinic, 16 retail and dining units, curated boutiques, art cafés, open-air cinema, cultural programming, direct marina access, and 24/7 concierge and security.
Yacht Club membership is included.
Can foreigners buy property at Vero & Versa?
Yes.
Montenegro allows full freehold ownership for foreign nationals with no restrictions.
Can I obtain residency by purchasing at Vero & Versa?
Property ownership in Montenegro entitles buyers to apply for a Montenegrin residence permit.
Is Vero & Versa a good investment?
Porto Montenegro is the Adriatic's only ICD-backed luxury waterfront destination, with coastal property prices up 20–25% in 2024 and new supply down 36% in 2025.
Rental yields range from 4.4% to 7.1%, with professional management available through MResidences.
Montenegro is the EU's most advanced accession candidate, with membership targeted for 2028–2030.

BEACH LIVING There’s a different side to Mexico’s Riviera Nayarit, where the path less traveled leads to an extraordinary oceanfront residential community attuned to nature, relaxed coastal living, and a sense of adventure that families and friends can treasure forever.
These are the very lands that captured the hearts of the Aztecs known as the Tecoxquines (pronounced Te-Kos-Kin-Es) more than 2,000 years ago.
It was here where warm ocean currents from the south met cooler ocean currents from the north, filling the air with a symphony of birdlife.
The Tecoxquines named this sacred realm Litibú— song of the birds —reflecting its natural beauty and riches.
Along these shores comes a new haven of luxury homes for sale, whose every nuance is still inspired by the wonders of our natural world.

This is Litibú Bay Club, a tropical retreat of distinctive beachfront living presenting 171 private residences for sale in a mix of styles with a host of club amenities for families and couples alike, all within a private gated community.
The Allure of Litibú Life Just north of Punta Mita and slightly south of Sayulita, Litibú is renowned for virginal beaches, astonishing jungle views and Mexican authenticity.
EXPLORE Real Estate Organic yet luxurious Mexico real estate; the distinctive private homes and villas of Litibú Bay Club permit nature to take center stage.
HOMES GALLERY A Wealth of Amenities With a Beach Club, Sports & Adventure Club and outdoor pursuits of nearly every kind, there’s something for every member of one’s family at Litibú Bay Club.
AMENITIES Location is Everything Luxury awaits inside our gated community, and outside Litibú Bay Club’s neighboring towns are brimming with authenticity and charm.

EXPLORE A Team of Proven Visionaries Bringing Litibú Bay Club to life is a compilation of seasoned talent in Mexico real estate development and investment, land planning, architecture, landscape design and real estate branding and marketing.

NEWS AND EVENTS Home Lands Breaks Ground on Canterbury Crest Resort Apartments 23-03-2026 4 MINS READ Home Lands Breaks Ground on Canterbury Crest Resort Apartments Market leader Home Lands has officially begun development of Canterbury Crest Resort Apartments following the ceremonial groundbreaking and foundation stone laying.
This occasion marks the launch of one of four brand-new resort apartment developments by Home Lands in Greater Colombo.
Canterbury Crest is the last stage of development at Canterbury Golf City - Piliyandala Kahaththuduwa, the largest residential development project in Sri Lanka comprising 1,200 units already.

Due to the strong market demand generated by Canterbury Golf City, Home Lands made the strategic decision to introduce this final phase of resort apartments complementing Sri Lanka’s largest residential development.
The ceremony, held on March 19th, was graced by Mr.
Nalin Herath, Chairman of Home Lands Group of Companies, together with the Management.
Construction officially began following the foundation stone laying by the Chairman, marking the start of this prestigious residential development.
Canterbury Golf City is Sri Lanka’s 1st Victorian Style Golf Resort Apartments and Residencies Complex, a defining milestone in Home Lands’ journey.

With the addition of Canterbury Crest, Home Lands continues to meet the rising demand for residential living inside this prestigious development, building on the success of other projects within Canterbury Golf City such as Canterbury Golf Resort Apartments, Canterbury Garden Resort Apartments, Canterbury Lexus, Canterbury Golf Villas and Canterbury Golf Residencies.

The project is symbolic of Home Lands’ ability to combine scale, design excellence, and lifestyle innovation, establishing a benchmark that became a blueprint for the company’s subsequent developments.
The development showcases modern Victorian-style architecture comprising 96 apartments, each unit features a private balcony with impressive views, enhancing everyday living.
Rising five floors, each tower is thoughtfully designed to offer comfort, convenience, and refined living.

Offering a selection of two- and three-bedroom apartments, Canterbury Crest is complemented by a range of exclusive resident amenities, including a swimming pool, dedicated pickleball court, and a fully equipped outdoor gym.
Strategically located just 20 minutes from Colombo and minutes from the Southern Expressway, the development ensures seamless connectivity within a rapidly growing corridor.
Commenting on the launch, Mr.

Nalin Herath, Chairman of Home Lands Group of Companies, stated: “Home Lands has once again responded to the strong demand for resort-style living within Canterbury Golf City – the first of its kind in Sri Lanka.
Since its inception, Canterbury Golf City has proven to be a highly sought-after development for both homeowners and investors.

With Canterbury Crest, we are proud to deliver the final phase of this development, seamlessly blending prestige with comfortable living.” Home Lands, Sri Lanka’s number one, most trusted and most innovative developer, has been shaping the nation’s real estate landscape with a legacy built on trust, innovation, and excellence.
Home Lands is the pioneer of resort-style residential developments in Sri Lanka and continues to redefine modern living, setting new benchmarks in quality, design, and lifestyle.

As a fully integrated group of 14 companies, including its own construction arm, Heyraa Construction, holding the highest CS2 grading from CIDA, Home Lands delivers end-to-end solutions across real estate, construction, property management, and lifestyle creation, ensuring uncompromised quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction.
With a growing global presence and offices in Australia, Dubai, and London, Home Lands serves both local and international clients, delivering landmark residential projects across the country.

Home Lands has earned multiple accolades, including the Best Developer – Sri Lanka award at the PropertyGuru Asia Property Awards for three consecutive years, and in 2025 was honoured with Superbrands status, becoming the only real estate Superbrand in Sri Lanka.

With more than 3,500 units delivered alongside 500 more units ready to deliver within the next 6 months and over 2,200 units under construction, Home Lands continues to redefine lifestyles through trust, innovation and excellence.

Botanica Hythe is the first condominium project from the famous & well-established developer behind Botanica Luxury Villas.
The interior design uses high-end materials with meticulous attention to detail, creating an atmosphere that blends luxury and tranquility in every corner.
The environment is seamlessly integrated with nature, providing a peaceful and luxurious experience that promotes relaxation every day.
Located near Choeng Thale Beach in Thalang District, Phuket, this new condo offers a quiet location while still being close to key attractions in Phuket.
The design prioritizes large spaces connecting with nature, giving residents a retreat from the hustle and bustle of the city while enjoying a resort-style lifestyle all year round.
The total land area of the development spans 285,017 square meters, providing ample common space that ensures privacy and serenity for all residents.

The thoughtfully designed spaces allow residents to enjoy a comfortable life amidst a serene and lush environment.
The Central Garden and Swimming Pool are the heart of the project, with a garden full of diverse plants and trees, creating a perfect spot for leisurely walks or relaxation.
The large swimming pool, located next to the garden, provides a refreshing space for both exercise and unwinding.
The Children's Zone is designed as a safe and enjoyable area where young residents can explore and connect with nature in a secure environment.
The Fitness Center , set amidst the greenery, offers modern equipment and beautiful views of nature, promoting both physical and mental well-being.
The nature-inspired amenities at Botanica Hythe are thoughtfully designed to provide a perfect balance between the convenience of modern living and the beauty of the surrounding natural world.
Assets Around Botanica Hythe Botanica Hythe is located near the beach and offers various services such as Beach Service, which is available for visitors during their vacation.
For beach lovers, you can visit Bangtao Beach , Layan Beach or Naithon Beach, both of which offer a peaceful and natural atmosphere.
In addition, Surin Beach is another popular spot, all of which are beautiful and perfect for a relaxing holiday.
If you're looking for water activities and experiences, Blue Tree Lagoon and Laguna Golf are great options to consider.
For golf enthusiasts who enjoy challenging courses, Blue Canyon Golf provides excellent services.
Moreover, Phuket Port connects you to various islands, and Lotus's and Old Phuket Town are charming spots for shopping and sightseeing.

Traveling to other important locations such as Central Phuket, which features both high-end brand stores and entertainment, or visiting Thalang Hospital and Robinson Lifestyle for healthcare and shopping services, is also easy.
Lastly, traveling to Phuket International Airport and Bangkok Hospital is convenient for those needing to travel out of Phuket or for medical services in the area.

214 Căn Hộ One Central Saigon Đủ Điều Kiện Bán Ra Thị Trường - One Central Saigon Bỏ qua nội dung Trang chủ Chủ đầu tư Vị trí Tiện ích Tiến độ Tin tức Liên hệ Tìm kiếm: BẠN CÓ THỂ THÍCH: Dự án Sự kiện Tin tức Tiến độ Trang chủ / Tin tức / Dự án / 214 Căn Hộ One Central Saigon Đủ Điều Kiện Bán Ra Thị Trường 214 Căn Hộ One Central Saigon Đủ Điều Kiện Bán Ra Thị Trường Thị trường bất động sản khu vực lõi trung tâm TP.HCM từ lâu đã rơi vào trạng thái “khát” nguồn cung mới, đặc biệt là ở phân khúc căn hộ siêu sang.
Những nhà đầu tư tinh hoa và giới thượng lưu luôn mỏi mắt tìm kiếm một không gian sống xứng tầm, nơi hội tụ trọn vẹn các yếu tố về vị trí độc tôn, tính biểu tượng và giá trị di sản.
Sự khan hiếm này vô hình trung đã đẩy mức giá các dự án hiện hữu lên đỉnh điểm, trong khi quỹ đất nội đô gần như đã cạn kiệt.

Giải cơn khát đó, thông tin 214 căn hộ thuộc dự án One Central Saigon chính thức được Sở Xây dựng TP.HCM xác nhận đủ điều kiện mở bán nhà ở hình thành trong tương lai đã tạo nên một “cơn địa chấn” thực sự.
Đây không chỉ là một cột mốc pháp lý quan trọng mà còn là cơ hội sở hữu bộ sưu tập tài sản đắt giá bậc nhất Việt Nam dành cho những chủ nhân kiệt xuất.

Bước Ngoặt Pháp Lý Quan Trọng Của Dự Án Tứ Giác Bến Thành Việc một dự án quy mô tỷ đô tại vùng lõi trung tâm nhận được “cái gật đầu” từ cơ quan chức năng là một minh chứng rõ nét cho năng lực triển khai và tính minh bạch về mặt pháp lý.

Quyết định phê duyệt từ Sở Xây dựng TP.HCM Theo danh sách 37 dự án nhà ở hình thành trong tương lai đủ điều kiện kinh doanh vừa được Sở Xây dựng TP.HCM công bố, khu phức hợp văn phòng – thương mại – dịch vụ – căn hộ – khách sạn tại khu vực tứ giác Bến Thành đã chính thức góp mặt.
Cụ thể, 214 căn hộ siêu sang tại đây đã hoàn thiện toàn bộ các thủ tục khắt khe nhất để có thể ký hợp đồng mua bán với khách hàng.
Giữa bối cảnh thị trường đang trong giai đoạn thanh lọc mạnh mẽ, việc vượt qua các vòng kiểm duyệt pháp lý khắt khe giúp dự án này khẳng định vị thế dẫn dắt.
Đây là cơ sở vững chắc để người mua và giới đầu tư hoàn toàn an tâm khi xuống tiền tại một trong những công trình biểu tượng của quốc gia.
Sự bảo lãnh tài chính vững chắc từ Techcombank Một trong những yếu tố then chốt tạo nên niềm tin tuyệt đối cho khách hàng chính là sự đồng hành của Ngân hàng Kỹ thương Việt Nam (Techcombank).
Toàn bộ 214 căn hộ đều được ngân hàng này bảo lãnh nghĩa vụ tài chính.
Động thái này không chỉ đảm bảo quyền lợi tối đa cho người mua nhà mà còn thể hiện tiềm lực tài chính khổng lồ của chủ đầu tư.
Khi một định chế tài chính hàng đầu đứng ra cam kết tiến độ và dòng tiền, rủi ro trong giao dịch bất động sản hình thành trong tương lai gần như được triệt tiêu hoàn toàn.
Giải Mã Sức Hút Độc Tôn Từ Vị Trí One Central Saigon Trong bất động sản, vị trí là thước đo quyền lực nhất để định giá một tài sản.
Sở hữu Vị trí One Central Saigon mang tính độc quyền, dự án này vươn mình như một viên kim cương sáng giá nhất giữa lòng Sài Gòn phồn hoa.

Tọa độ vàng với 4 mặt tiền thương mại Nằm chễm chệ trên khu đất rộng 8.600 m2, dự án nắm giữ 4 mặt tiền đường huyết mạch bậc nhất Quận 1 bao gồm: Phạm Ngũ Lão, Calmette, Lê Thị Hồng Gấm và Phó Đức Chính.
Đây là quỹ đất “kim cương” hiếm hoi còn sót lại đối diện trực diện Chợ Bến Thành – biểu tượng văn hóa và giao thương lịch sử của TP.HCM.
Không chỉ dừng lại ở mặt giao thông bề nổi, dự án còn kết nối trực tiếp với nhà ga ngầm Bến Thành của tuyến Metro số 1 (Bến Thành – Suối Tiên).

Trong tương lai gần, khi hệ thống đường sắt đô thị đi vào vận hành, khu vực này sẽ trở thành một “Transit Hub” (trạm trung chuyển) khổng lồ, mang lại lưu lượng khách khổng lồ cho khối đế thương mại và nâng tầm giá trị vô giá cho các căn hộ phía trên.
Tầm nhìn Panorama bao quát toàn cảnh siêu đô thị Từ vị trí lõi trung tâm, các chủ nhân tương lai sẽ được tận hưởng đặc quyền tầm nhìn 360 độ không giới hạn.

Dù hướng mắt về dải xanh ngút ngàn của Công viên 23/9, nét rêu phong cổ kính của Chợ Bến Thành, hay sự phồn hoa rực rỡ của sông Sài Gòn và bán đảo Thủ Thiêm, mỗi khung cửa sổ tại đây đều là một bức tranh nghệ thuật đắt giá.
Đây là trải nghiệm sống đặc quyền chỉ dành cho 214 chủ nhân danh giá nhất.

Phối cảnh tổng thể dự án 214 căn hộ One Central Saigon đủ điều kiện bán ra thị trường Hành Trình Lột Xác Và Bệ Phóng Từ Những Ông Lớn Hơn một thập niên hình thành và phát triển, công trình tại tứ giác Bến Thành đã trải qua nhiều thăng trầm để đạt được hình hài hoàn mỹ như hiện tại.

Lịch sử chuyển mình của biểu tượng mới Được khởi công từ năm 2013 dưới tên gọi The Spirit of Saigon do tập đoàn Bitexco phát triển, dự án đã phải tạm dừng một thời gian dài sau khi hoàn thiện phần hầm vì những biến động tài chính và quá trình tái cơ cấu phức tạp.
Trong suốt hơn 10 năm, công trình này đã nhiều lần thay đổi tên thương mại từ The One, Pearl, cho đến danh xưng hiện tại.
Tuy nhiên, pháp nhân chủ đầu tư là Công ty TNHH Saigon Glory vẫn luôn được duy trì xuyên suốt từ năm 2019, tạo nền tảng pháp lý xuyên suốt không bị đứt gãy.
Lịch sử của One Central trải qua nhiều nốt thăng trầm, nhưng chính sự chắt lọc qua thời gian đã biến nơi đây thành một viên ngọc quý được mài giũa cẩn thận, chờ ngày tỏa sáng rực rỡ nhất.
Tương lai rực sáng cùng hệ sinh thái Masterise Bước ngoặt lớn nhất đến khi dự án chính thức được tiếp quản và triển khai bởi một nhà phát triển bất động sản hàng quốc tế.
Sự tham gia của One Central Saigon Masterise đã thổi một luồng sinh khí mới, tái khởi động toàn bộ guồng máy thi công.

Với kinh nghiệm dày dặn trong việc kiến tạo các dự án bất động sản hàng hiệu (Branded Residences) đình đám tại Việt Nam, đơn vị phát triển mới cam kết mang đến những tiêu chuẩn quản lý, vận hành và thiết kế vươn tầm thế giới, biến dự án thành tổ hợp không gian sống và làm việc đẳng cấp nhất khu vực Đông Nam Á.
Kiến Trúc Tháp Đôi Và Hệ Sinh Thái Tiện Ích Đỉnh Cao Sự xuất hiện của One Central Saigon không chỉ giải quyết bài toán nguồn cung mà còn tái định nghĩa lại chuẩn mực sống siêu sang tại Việt Nam.
Quy mô đồ sộ: Công trình bao gồm 2 tòa tháp nguy nga với chiều cao 55 và 48 tầng.
Khi hoàn thiện, đây sẽ là tổ hợp tháp đôi cao nhất Việt Nam, sừng sững như một cánh cổng vươn lên bầu trời khu trung tâm.
Phân bổ không gian tối ưu: Tổ hợp này không chỉ có 214 căn hộ hạng sang mà còn tích hợp 231 phòng khách sạn siêu sang, khối văn phòng hạng A+ và trung tâm thương mại cao cấp nhiều tầng.

Thiết kế mang tính biểu tượng: Lấy cảm hứng từ hình ảnh hai con rồng vươn lên ngậm ngọc, kiến trúc của tháp đôi vừa mang đậm dấu ấn phong thủy Á Đông, vừa toát lên nét hiện đại, góc cạnh của những đô thị hàng đầu thế giới như New York hay Dubai.

Tiện ích nội khu chuẩn 6 sao: Cư dân sẽ được trải nghiệm hệ thống tiện ích khép kín bao gồm hồ bơi vô cực ngắm nhìn toàn cảnh thành phố, khu spa trị liệu cao cấp, phòng xì gà, hầm rượu vang, sảnh đón khách sang trọng cùng dịch vụ concierge 24/7 phục vụ mọi nhu cầu cá nhân hóa.

Tiêu chí Điểm nổi bật của dự án Quy mô đất 8.600 m2 Số lượng tháp 2 tháp đôi (55 tầng và 48 tầng) Sản phẩm cốt lõi 214 căn hộ siêu sang, 231 phòng khách sạn Pháp lý hiện tại Đủ điều kiện bán nhà ở hình thành trong tương lai Bảo lãnh tài chính Ngân hàng Techcombank Tác Động Của Dự Án Đến Nguồn Cung Bất Động Sản TP.HCM Theo nhận định từ các chuyên gia phân tích thị trường, nguồn cung bất động sản mới trong năm nay chủ yếu dồn về khu Đông, các tỉnh giáp ranh như Bình Dương (với các dự án quy mô như Tokyu Bình Dương, Sycamore) hoặc khu vực ngoại vi như Cần Giờ, Long Trường.
Các khu vực trung tâm lõi gần như vắng bóng hoàn toàn các dự án mới do quỹ đất hẹp và quy trình cấp phép nghiêm ngặt.
Do đó, sự góp mặt của hơn hai trăm căn hộ tại tứ giác Bến Thành trong danh sách đủ điều kiện bán là một điểm sáng chói lọi.
Đây là một trong số những dự án cực kỳ hiếm hoi tại lõi trung tâm Quận 1 được mở khóa pháp lý.

Giá bán chính thức hiện chưa được công bố, nhưng theo các dữ liệu tham chiếu từ thị trường và đánh giá từ giới chuyên gia môi giới bất động sản hạng sang, mức giá tại đây chắc chắn sẽ thiết lập một mặt bằng mới, thuộc nhóm cao nhất tại TP.HCM (kỷ lục hiện hành đang dao động gần ngưỡng 700 triệu đồng/m2).

Sự gia tăng giá trị không chỉ đến từ chi phí xây dựng hay lạm phát, mà đến từ “giá trị vô hình” của một bất động sản mang tính di sản, không thể sao chép và không có dự án thay thế trong tương lai gần.

Kết Luận Việc 214 căn hộ tại khu tứ giác Bến Thành chính thức đủ điều kiện mở bán không đơn thuần là một tin tức thị trường, mà là một sự kiện mang tính lịch sử đối với bức tranh quy hoạch đô thị TP.HCM.
Sở hữu một căn hộ tại đây không chỉ là nắm giữ một khối tài sản khổng lồ, mà còn là bản tuyên ngôn về đẳng cấp, vị thế và tầm nhìn vượt thời đại của giới thượng lưu.
Khi quỹ đất trung tâm đã trở thành dĩ vãng, cơ hội để bước chân vào cộng đồng tinh hoa này đang dần khép lại.
Đừng bỏ lỡ cơ hội ghi tên mình vào danh sách những chủ nhân kiệt xuất của biểu tượng kiến trúc vĩ đại nhất Sài Gòn.
Hãy liên hệ ngay với đội ngũ tư vấn chuyên sâu để nhận thông tin mật độ mở bán, bảng giá dự kiến và chính sách ưu đãi đặc quyền sớm nhất ngay hôm nay!

Thomson Reserve Project FAQ How many units are there at Thomson Reserve, and what sizes?
1,268 units across six towers, from a 2-Bedroom of 55 sqm (592 sq ft) to a 5-Bedroom Suite with private lift of 168 sqm (1,808 sq ft).

There are eleven size bands in the developer's unit mix, covering 2-Bedroom, 2-Bedroom Premium, 2-Bedroom Premium + Study, 3-Bedroom, 3-Bedroom Premium, 3-Bedroom Premium + Study, 4-Bedroom, 4-Bedroom Premium with private lift, 4-Bedroom Premium + Study with private lift and the 5-Bedroom Suite.
When is Thomson Reserve expected to be completed?
The expected date of Notice of Vacant Possession is 28 February 2031, and the expected date of legal completion is 28 February 2034.
The tenure is 99 years commencing from 14 July 2026.
How many carpark lots does Thomson Reserve have?
1,021 residential carpark lots, including 31 EV lots and 7 accessible lots.
The EV lots split 16 at Basement 1 and 15 at Level 1, and all use AC chargers.
There are also 317 bicycle lots.
The carpark has a minimum 2.4m clearance, and 2.2m at the parking lots themselves.
What is the ceiling height at Thomson Reserve?
2.85m floor to ceiling in the living, dining, master bedroom, bedrooms and study, 2.40m in the kitchen and yard, 2.80m in the household shelter, and 2.90m at the balcony.
The 4-Bedroom Premium + Study and the 5-Bedroom Suite have a 2.70m balcony ceiling, as do units with an acoustic ceiling, which is installed at Block 5 stacks 19 to 22.
What kitchen appliances come with a Thomson Reserve unit?
The Classic Collection is fitted throughout with Smeg.

The Luxury Collection is fitted with Miele for the hood, hobs, ovens, dishwasher, washer and dryer, Smeg for the 60cm and 70cm fridge freezers, and Liebherr for the 90cm fridge freezer and the undercounter wine chiller.
The 4-Bedroom Premium, 4-Bedroom Premium + Study and 5-Bedroom Suite also get a combi steam oven, a built-in dishwasher and a wine chiller.
Does Thomson Reserve have smart home features?
Yes.
Every apartment has a Smart Home Management System comprising a digital lockset, smart air-conditioner control for all fan coil units, and a smart home hub.
Proximity card access is provided to the designated lift lobbies of all blocks, the pedestrian side gates and designated common areas.
How many swimming pools are there, and how big are they?
There are two 50m lap pools: the Infinity Lap Pool of about 690 sqm, roughly 8 lanes, and the Canopy Lap Pool of about 700 sqm, roughly 5 lanes.
The Island Pool is about 1,730 sqm, and read together with the Infinity Lap Pool the water runs about 130m in length.
There is also a 1,025 sqm Leisure Pool and a 260 sqm Kids Pool at 0.5m deep.
All the adult pools are 1.2m deep.
How many function rooms does Thomson Reserve have?
Five function rooms plus the Grand Function Room.
The Grand Function Room is 97 sqm with an 8.4m ceiling and comes with an induction hob and hood, oven, microwave, fridge and wine chiller.
Function Rooms 1 to 5 range from 38 to 43 sqm with 3.5m ceilings, and all but Function Room 3 have an induction hob, hood, combi microwave oven and fridge.
How is waste handled at Thomson Reserve?
A Pneumatic Waste Conveyance System, with one general waste hopper and one recyclable refuse hopper per floor.
The bin centre is at Basement 1.
How many entrances does Thomson Reserve have?
Two.
There is a guardhouse at the Bright Hill Drive entrance and a guard post at the Sin Ming Avenue entrance.

앞서 공급한 아파트 999가구에 이은 후속 물량으로, 서울 동북권의 교통망과 기존 생활 인프라를 갖춘 주거형 오피스텔이다.
16일 포스코이앤씨에 따르면 더샵 퍼스트월드 서울 오피스텔은 서울 중랑구 상봉동 83-1번지 일원 상봉9재정비촉진구역에 지하 8층~지상 49층, 1개 동, 총 308실 규모로 들어선다.
모든 호실은 전용면적 84㎡로 구성된다.
앞서 분양한 아파트 999가구는 일반분양을 시작한 지 3개월 만에 계약을 마쳤다.
이번 오피스텔 공급까지 더해지면 아파트와 오피스텔을 합쳐 총 1307가구·실 규모의 주거복합단지가 형성된다.
교통 여건은 단지의 주요 특징이다.
상봉역과 망우역을 걸어서 이용할 수 있으며 지하철 7호선과 경춘선, 경의중앙선, KTX 등을 이용할 수 있다.
향후 상봉역에 수도권광역급행철도(GTX)-B 노선이 개통되면 광역교통 접근성이 더욱 개선될 전망이다.
북부간선도로와 동부간선도로 등 주요 도로망도 인접해 있다.
주변에는 코스트코와 홈플러스, CGV 등 쇼핑·문화시설을 비롯해 서울북부병원 등 의료시설이 자리 잡고 있다.
중랑천과 봉화산, 망우산 등 녹지공간도 가까운 편이다.
단지 내부에는 판매·문화시설과 근린생활시설이 함께 들어설 예정이다.
시행사인 신아주는 상업시설에 '트랜짓(Transit)'이라는 브랜드를 적용하고 입점 업체 구성과 운영을 차별화할 계획이다.
오피스텔 내부는 주거 편의성을 고려해 설계했다.
타입에 따라 4베이 판상형 또는 이면개방형 구조를 적용하고 팬트리와 드레스룸 등 수납공간을 마련한다.
일부 타입에는 거실과 주방에서 외부 조망이 가능한 LDK(거실·식사공간·주방) 구조를 도입한다.
시스템 에어컨과 빌트인 김치냉장고 등도 무상 제공 품목에 포함된다.
오피스텔은 아파트와 달리 적용되는 주택 관련 규제가 일부 다르다는 점도 특징이다.
다만 실제 대출 가능 여부와 한도는 금융기관의 심사 기준 및 개인별 조건 등에 따라 달라질 수 있다.
포스코이앤씨 관계자는 "더샵 퍼스트월드 서울 오피스텔은 앞서 공급한 아파트를 통해 입지와 상품성을 확인한 단지"라며 "상봉역 일대 교통 여건과 생활 편의시설을 갖춘 서울 신축 주거시설인 만큼 실수요자들의 관심이 이어질 것으로 기대한다"고 말했다.

19:13:43 | By Kim Kyung-mi kmkim@sedaily.com | Summary | Save A A A Builders will offer 56,533 new apartments for presale across South Korea in November, up nearly 90% from a year earlier.

More than half of the supply is concentrated in the Seoul metropolitan area, and the lineup includes large redevelopment complexes and projects on public land subject to the price cap on new homes, drawing attention from people buying a home to live in.
According to Real Estate 114, a total of 56,533 apartments will go on presale nationwide next month, up 89.1% from 29,895 units in November last year.
The Seoul metropolitan area accounts for 32,017 units, or 56.6% of the total.
Gyeonggi Province alone is preparing to take applications for 20,278 units, its largest volume this year.
Seoul and Incheon are set to supply 7,240 units and 4,499 units respectively, up 146% and 226% from the same month last year.
In Seoul, major redevelopment and rebuilding projects in central districts are drawing the most interest.
DH Banpo 124, a rebuilding of the Banpo Jugong No.
1 complex in Banpo-dong, Seocho-gu, will issue its application notice on Nov.
27 and begin the subscription process.
Of the complex's 5,007 units, 1,832 units ranging from 59 to 130 square meters will be sold to general applicants.
Gyeonghuigung Effite, a redevelopment of the Donuimun No.
2 district in Jongno-gu, will offer 135 of its 228 units in sizes of 39, 59 and 84 square meters.
Harrington Place Mullae in Mullae-dong 3-ga, Yeongdeungpo-gu, will offer all 218 of its 84-square-meter units to general applicants.

POSCO E&C will supply 999 apartments and 308 officetel units — studio units used as either homes or offices — at The Sharp First World Seoul, a large complex built on the former Sangbong bus terminal site.
In Gyeonggi Province and Incheon, projects on public land with relatively low presale prices are the main draw.
Keryong Construction will offer Elif Siheung The Prime in Block B-5 of the Siheung Geomo public housing district in Siheung, Gyeonggi Province.
Of the 338 units, all sized at 84 square meters, 304 will go to general applicants.

In Uijeongbu, Uijeongbu Station Pellestower Yangwoo Naeanae — a roughly 1,500-unit project comprising 1,252 apartments, 48 officetel units and 168 office units — is awaiting applications, as is Geomdan Centreville Grand Foret, with 843 units in Oryu-dong, Incheon.
Outside the capital region, 24,516 units will be supplied, about 270% more than the 6,647 units offered in November last year.

North Gyeongsang Province leads with 5,723 units, followed by Sejong with 3,547, Daejeon with 3,404, South Jeolla Province and Gwangju Metropolitan City combined with 3,300, Busan with 2,615 and South Chungcheong Province with 2,034.
Landmark-scale complexes are drawing attention in provincial markets.
Sejong Smart City L Soojain, a 2,191-unit project consisting entirely of 84-square-meter units, is ready for presale in Blocks L6, L7, L8 and L11 of the 5-2 living zone in Hapgang-dong, Sejong.
In Gumi, North Gyeongsang Province, Gumi Park One Dessian, a 2,548-unit complex in the Doryang-dong area, is preparing to offer 1,355 units ranging from 84 to 110 square meters to general applicants.
An industry official said buyers will be selective.

"With lending curbs still in place and presale prices continuing to rise, demand will clearly concentrate on promising complexes that either benefit from the price cap or offer access to core urban infrastructure," the official said.

Project - Marina Dorćol × CONSTRUCTION OF THE FIRST PHASE HAS BEGUN --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> --> Project Location Apartments Interiors Virtual Tour Gallery Architecture Lifestyle & Amenities Sales Pavilion Contact News ENG SRB Marina Dorćol As more and more people want to live in the heart of the city, we believe that developers looking to satisfy that demand have a responsibility to enrich the neighbourhoods in which they build—especially when they are fortunate enough to be entrusted with such an exceptional location.

This responsibility informed the entire design of Marina Dorćol, which utilises spacious yet unobtrusive curved buildings—including an elegant, serpentine centrepiece—generously adorned with rich vegetation to preserve the beauty of the skyline while giving residents expansive views over the river or parks.
Benefits of living in Marina Dorćol 2 to 3 apartments per floor Marina Dorćol will be the residential complex with the lowest construction coefficient in the city center.
Most of the buildings will only have 2 to 3 apartments per floor.

High ceilings Apartments in Marina Dorćol will feature ceiling heights of 2.9 meters, providing enhanced spaciousness, increased natural light, and a level of comfort that is rarely found in contemporary residential developments.
Oversized parking spaces Most parking spaces in Marina Dorćol will exceed standard dimensions (2.9 m × 5.5 m), accommodating even the largest SUV models.
In addition, visitor and guest parking will be provided within the complex, which is a rare and significant advantage in a central urban location.
Greenery More than 30,000 m² of green areas will be planted in Marina Dorćol.

The development will connect seamlessly to the Linear Park, while the site of the former “Snaga i svetlost” power plant—set to be restored and repurposed as a cultural and arts center—will be complemented by a landscaped park in its immediate surroundings.

Attention to detail Excellent acoustic insulation, centralized hot water preparation without individual boilers in the apartments, a four-pipe HVAC system enabling year-round individual temperature control, as well as heating via geothermal heat pumps represent carefully selected technical solutions that contribute to the premium construction quality and high level of living comfort in Marina Dorćol.
Storage and bike racks We understand how important additional space is in contemporary living.
That is why each apartment includes a private storage unit within the building—already included in the purchase price—as well as a dedicated bicycle storage area.
Heat recovery ventilation (HRV) system Each apartment in Marina Dorćol will utilize the latest HRV ventilation system, designed to improve indoor air quality while conserving energy.
Ground floor retail All retail stores will be leased, allowing us to provide facility management and maintain control over the tenant mix, their working hours and delivery schedules.
Take a look into the neighborhood launch 3D tour Architecture Every element of Marina Dorćol has been carefully thought through.
Marina Dorćol was designed by Stanislav Fiala and Jelena Kuzmanović of the „Kuzmanović + Fiala“ architectural bureau.
Their architecture is characterised by innovative use of materials such as wood, corten, steel and natural stone, a constant play of light and seamless immersion of objects into their surroundings.
In Belgrade, the bureau and SEBRE have so far completed the “Residence Puškinova” project – a unique, 10 apartment residential object located in Senjak.
Marina Dorćol brings a new approach to the concept of living and the development of the city.
Stylistically it sets itself apart from the dominant aesthetic of the recent large-scale residential and commercial developments in Serbia’s capital.

March 2026 Invego announces major new development in Riga with first phase investment of 38 million Euros Estonian real estate developer Invego has today announced Nordale , a large-scale multi-stage new development where 38 million euros will be invested in the first phase to develop 159 new homes and business premises.

Nordale is one of the most ambitious recent years new residential initiatives spanning across several hectares in Bikernieki forest area in Mežciems, including the historic Riga Film Studio district that will transform into a new urban district.
Kristjan-Thor Vähi, CEO of Invego, says: “We’ll create the most liveable city by bringing Riga the very best practices and qualities from the most liveable cities in the world.

Location offers a unique potential to create an environment where Nordale brings together architecture, nature and community will be a completely new chapter of Latvian residential development.” Each phase will have its own architectural identity created by different teams of architects, contributing to a diverse and vibrant community.
The project’s concept emphasizes functional, future-ready homes with large balconies and terraces, green inner courtyards, and layouts that maximize natural light.
Nordale is conceived as a district where the calm of the forest meets contemporary Nordic-inspired architecture.
The area is surrounded by pine forests and natural sand dunes, creating a rare balance between urban accessibility and a nature-oriented lifestyle.
The concept includes a central promenade with cafés, shops and services, also connecting the area with nearby Akropole Alfa centre.
By incorporating ‘no-car’ zones between buildings, the district offers a safe and adaptable urban space.
The layout prioritizes pedestrians and cyclists to ensure seamless connectivity throughout the neighborhood.
Nordale’s location in Bikernieki forest, Mežciems offers convenient access to everyday services and leisure opportunities.
Nearby are Akropole Alfa shopping centre, MyFitness sports club, an ice arena, tennis courts and Jugla Lake, as well as a wide selection of schools and kindergartens.
The city centre always remains easily reachable.
The total volume of the first phase of Nordale is 19,500 square meters, comprising 159 apartments and 10% commercial space.
The architectural concept has been developed by SIA “Zenico Projekts”.
The first stage includes two- to five-room apartments of different sizes with prices starting from 99 900 euros.

Volta SKAI Cornerstone Laid in Põhja-Tallinn | Endover est rus eng est eng rus Home Developments Business Blog Premium Club About About Team Careers Contact Us Instagram Facebook Youtube est rus eng est eng rus Home Developments Business Blog Premium Club About About Team Careers Contact Us Instagram Facebook Youtube SHARE: Volta SKAI Cornerstone Laid in Põhja-Tallinn April 8th 2026 #construction #Endover #North-Tallinn #Press release #VOLTA BLOG #Volta SKAI Back Henri Ärmus, Head of Metropoli Ehitus; Rasmus Tamme, Architect at ARS Projekt; and Roul Tutt, CEO of Endover.
On Tuesday, 7 April, the cornerstone of Põhja-Tallinn’s first high-rise – Volta SKAI – was laid in the Volta Quarter in Tallinn.
According to plans, the first of the two 12-storey towers is expected to be completed in the first half of next year.
At the panel discussion that followed the ceremony, experts debated why construction does not stop in times of crisis – and why hesitation is the greatest risk of all.
Volta SKAI is located in the Volta Quarter with its 125-year history and consists of two 12-storey towers with a total area of 18,600 m².
In total, more than 100 apartments and commercial units ranging from 35 to 195 m² will be built, with prices starting from €249,900, prices per square metre starting from €4,730/m².
The living spaces feature ceilings up to 3.8 metres high and floor-to-ceiling windows.
The project’s architecture was designed by ARS Projekt, with Endover acting as the developer.
“The cornerstone of Volta SKAI is a significant milestone – for us, for the development of Põhja-Tallinn as a whole, and for the rebirth of this historic industrial area.
Construction is on track, and the project is holding to both its timeline and budget.
In these challenging times, this high-rise stands as a symbol of optimism and confidence – for us, for our investors, and for those who are building their home here.
Change and progress – in the urban environment and in the economy alike – do not arise from nothing.
They are born through bold decisions.
People move to where life is better.
They choose their environment.
A place with life.
A place with a story,” said Endover CEO Roul Tutt .
Endover's CEO Roul Tutt.
Olga Alamaa, Jana Palm and Argo Metsaru from LHV Group.
Sille Sillaste, Head of Client Relations for Volta SKAI.
The experts who took part in the panel discussion agreed that, despite global uncertainty, the key indicators of Estonia’s real estate market remain strong.
“The purchasing process has become longer – people weigh things up, measure, observe.
This shows the market has matured,” said Tutt.
“The biggest risk is failing to make a decision at all.
The time spent in fear and inaction cannot be recovered,” he added.
“ This high-rise stands as a symbol of optimism and confidence – for us, for our investors, and for those who are building their home here.
Roul Tutt , CEO of Endover SEB Bank macro analyst Mihkel Nestor noted that financial markets’ reaction to global tensions has been calmer than expected.

“Oil futures point to prices falling below $80 per barrel as early as October – this shows that markets are assessing the situation in a far more measured way than the headlines might suggest,” he explained.
Chairman of the Management Board of LHV Varahaldus Vahur Vallistu stressed that uncertainty is, for an investor, more of a reason to adapt than to stop.
“In the current situation, no one can predict exactly where markets will go – the best an investor can do is remain flexible,” he said.
Vallistu added that the potential of Põhja-Tallinn as an area remains significant and interest in it is growing.
Architect and Member of the Riigikogu Yoko Alender also emphasised that in times of crisis, it is especially important to build not just buildings, but places.
“In a crisis, no new building should be built in a way that fails to create a better place, a better living environment – something that brings us together or sets us in motion.
Otherwise, it is simply a colossal waste,” she said.
The panel discussion explored how global uncertainty is shaping economic and urban development.
In the centre, Mihkel Nestor, Macro Analyst at SEB.
The experts agreed that despite global uncertainty, the key fundamentals of Estonia’s real estate market remain strong.
Kristel Laud, Marketing Manager at Endover, and Yoko Alender, architect and Member of the Estonian Parliament.
The Volta SKAI project was developed in partnership with architecture firm ARS Projekt, whose portfolio also includes other Tallinn high-rises – in the Maakri Quarter and Rocca Towers.

The building’s architectural character is defined by extensive glazed surfaces and curved corner balconies, whose panoramic views will be preserved well into the future thanks to the property’s unique location.
In Volta SKAI apartments, ceiling heights and full-format glazing have been designed so that daylight flows freely through the spaces.
The building offers smart access systems, spacious lifts connecting the apartments, parking and the lobby, as well as a multi-level car park.
Volta SKAI has attracted investors from Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania through a €30 million bond programme; the bonds are traded on the Nasdaq Tallinn First North alternative market.
The next construction milestone will be the topping-out ceremony in autumn 2026.
Volta SKAI is located in the historic Volta Quarter, which has a 125-year history.
About the Volta Quarter The Volta Quarter is part of the Volta–Krulli–Noblessner area, which for the third consecutive year has been Tallinn’s most sought-after new residential and business district.
According to Citify, Volta is the capital’s most preferred new development both by number of units sold and by sales volume.

In 2025, Põhja-Tallinn became one of the city’s most active new apartment markets – with 323 transactions and a turnover of €107 million – and recorded the highest average price per square metre (€5,345/m²).
Built on the area’s industrial heritage, a new “golden mile” of the real estate market has emerged here, where former factory quarters have given way to a modern urban environment.
The private and secure quarter operates on the principle of the “15-minute city” – everything needed for everyday life is within walking distance.
The recently completed Volta HUB is home to the largest MyFitness sports club in Põhja-Tallinn, and the quarter also has its own padel club.
The area features cafés, shops, a bakery and childcare facilities, with a kindergarten set to open in the near future.
Volta SKAI offers stunning views of the sea, the marina, and the silhouettes of Tallinn’s city centre and Old Town.

Forma Toronto | King West Condos by Frank Gehry Menu Condominiums Gehry News Register Gallery Film Renderings A Homecoming Masterpiece Designed by Frank Gehry Frank Gehry (1929–2025) On December 5, Canada lost a legend.
Born in Toronto, Gehry became one of the world’s most influential architects, creating icons like the Guggenheim Bilbao and Walt Disney Concert Hall.
His final Canadian project, Forma, is more than a building—it’s a homecoming masterpiece that redefines Toronto’s skyline and celebrates the creative spirit that shaped his life.
Despite global acclaim, Gehry never forgot his roots.
And as Canadians, we will never forget him.

A Homecoming Masterpiece Designed by Frank Gehry "I Wanted to Create an Ensemble of Buildings That Were Respectful to The City And Referential to The Toronto That I Once Knew" - Frank Gehry AN EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY TO LIVE IN A WORK OF ART Forma presents unparalleled architecture and interior design to create a world-class condominium masterpiece.

Standing 73 and 84 storeys tall at the nexus of the entertainment and financial districts in Toronto, Forma will be Frank Gehry’s tallest residential towers, offering breathtaking views, bespoke suite finishes, elevated lifestyle amenities and services, wellness spaces, entertainment lounges, creative coworking spaces and an outdoor terrace to call home.

THE MAESTRO OF FORM IS COMING HOME From the Guggenheim Museum in Bilbao, the Fondation Louis Vuitton in Paris, to the Walt Disney Concert Hall in LA, visionary architect Frank Gehry has changed the course of architecture and design on a global scale.
Now, he is coming home to Toronto with Forma.
Gehry’s tallest creation in the world, devoted to the city where he was born.
