Description Porters Palms is a boutique collection of 36 thoughtfully designed luxury residences on Barbados’ prestigious Platinum Coast in Porters, St James.

GENERAL DESCRIPTION Porters Palms is an exclusive off-plan development of 36 contemporary villas delivered in two phases on the Platinum Coast — Phase 1 comprising 16 units (expected completion September/October 2026) and Phase 2 comprising 20 units.
The architecture was envisioned as a testament to the subtle beauty found in the interplay of textures, simplicity and materiality.
From stone to natural wood, each element has been carefully selected to evoke a sense of understated elegance, with sophisticated simplicity as the guiding ethos.
Each residence is finished to a very high-end standard featuring quality natural materials, earthy tones and top-of-the-line appliances.
Every detail has been meticulously chosen to highlight craftsmanship and elegance.
The development also demonstrates a clear commitment to sustainability by sourcing materials locally to minimise carbon footprint and support surrounding communities.
Located directly opposite the white sands of Alleynes Bay, Porters Palms delivers privacy, sophistication and exceptional long-term value.
RESIDENCE OVERVIEW The residences are designed around sophisticated simplicity, with open-plan living and dining areas that maximise natural light and airflow.
Seamless indoor-outdoor flow is central to every home.
Available configurations include: Phase 1 Ground Floor 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom villas (1,117 sq ft interior) with covered patio, expansive garden terrace (up to 1,144 sq ft) and private plunge pool.
Phase 2 Ground Floor 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom villas (1,117 sq ft interior) with covered patio and expansive garden space (up to 1,144 sq ft).
Phase 2 First Floor 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom villas (1,117 sq ft interior) with covered patio and generous private rooftop terrace (1,138 sq ft).
Phase 2 First Floor 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom villas (1,696 sq ft interior) with dual covered patios and private rooftop terrace.
All homes feature air conditioning, very high-end finishes and thoughtfully proportioned spaces that create a refined yet practical living environment.
LIFESTYLE FEATURES Porters Palms was envisioned as an interior-exterior project, seamlessly blending indoor comfort with outdoor living.

The landscape design is an integral part of the architecture, meticulously planned so that lush greenery and oversized vegetation form a visual narrative from the moment of entry, deliberately blurring the boundaries between built and natural environments.
Every residence enjoys a generous private outdoor space — whether a serene garden or a sprawling rooftop terrace — significantly expanding the livable area.
Residents can enjoy the tranquillity of their own outdoor oasis or entertain guests in complete privacy.
Select homes feature an exclusive plunge pool, set either within a lush ground-level garden or on a sun-drenched rooftop terrace, creating a private sanctuary surrounded by verdant vegetation.
A beautifully appointed communal luxury pool is also available just steps from every residence.
The location is exceptional: opposite Alleynes Bay beach, a short stroll from Lone Star Restaurant, and within easy reach of Holetown’s shops, beach clubs, fine dining and nearby golf courses.
This is calm, sophisticated West Coast living with genuine privacy and a deep connection to nature.

INVESTMENT FEATURES As a boutique off-plan development of just 36 residences (16 in Phase 1 and 20 in Phase 2) in a prime Platinum Coast location, Porters Palms offers a strong capital appreciation opportunity, with pre-construction prices building in value as the development progresses.
Phase 1 is expected to complete in September/October 2026.
Contemporary design, very high-end finishes, low-maintenance ownership and excellent proximity to the beach and Holetown amenities further support attractive short-term rental yields.
Ideal for buyers seeking a modern villa near the beach for personal use, relocation or as a high-quality investment asset on Barbados’ most prestigious coast.

What types of residential developments are featured on Zuri Estates?
Zuri Estates curates modern off-plan and newly completed residential developments across prime growth corridors in Nairobi and coastal Kenya.
Our portfolio features functional 1 to 4 bedroom apartments, executive penthouses, duplex residences, and secure gated townhouses.
Each development is selected based on verifiable developer delivery records, architectural approvals, and high rental or capital growth potential.
How does purchasing an off-plan development work in Kenya?
Purchasing off-plan typically begins with selecting a specific unit layout, signing a formal letter of offer, and placing a commitment deposit, usually between 10% and 20% of the purchase price.
The remaining balance is structured into staged milestone payments tied directly to verifiable construction phases.
The final balance is cleared upon practical completion, snagging inspection, and formal handover.
How can diaspora buyers safely purchase off-plan properties from abroad?
Diaspora buyers can complete their entire acquisition remotely with full legal peace of mind.
Zuri Estates coordinates live, unedited video walkthroughs of construction sites, shares stamped architectural plans, and facilitates direct communication with developers.
All transaction contracts and escrow payments are handled through independent conveyancing advocates registered with the Law Society of Kenya, removing the need for immediate travel.
What due diligence does Zuri Estates conduct before listing a development?

Before featuring any development on our platform, our team verifies that the project possesses full National Construction Authority (NCA) registration, National Environment Management Authority (NEMA) environmental impact licences, county government architectural and structural clearances, and clean, unencumbered land ownership records.
We also inspect the developer past construction delivery track record.
What legal ownership title is issued for apartments under Kenyan law?
Apartment owners in Kenya receive individual sectional title deeds under the Sectional Properties Act 2020.
This legislation guarantees individual registered ownership of your specific unit along with an undivided share in the common property.
Sectional titles replace older, outdated long-term sublease arrangements and can be used directly as collateral with commercial lenders.
What additional closing costs and taxes should buyers budget for?
Buyers should budget approximately 5% to 7% above the agreed purchase price to cover closing costs.

Key statutory expenses include Stamp Duty (4% of property valuation for urban properties, 2% in rural areas), independent legal conveyancing fees (typically 1% to 2% plus 16% VAT), utility connection deposits for electricity and water, and nominal land registration disbursements.
Can I schedule a private site visit or tour a show house?
Yes.
We arrange accompanied site inspections and show house tours from Monday through Saturday.
Our property advisors walk you through unit layouts, examine construction finish samples, assess natural light, and discuss neighbourhood infrastructure.
You can easily schedule a viewing directly on any project page or by contacting our team via WhatsApp.
What is the difference between buying off-plan versus a completed residence?

Off-plan purchases allow buyers to enter developments at early discounted pricing and spread capital payments over the construction timeline, making them attractive for investors seeking capital appreciation.
Completed residences, by contrast, offer immediate physical inspection, certificate of occupation verification, and the opportunity for immediate personal move-in or immediate rental income.

high-street retail, premium office spaces and expansive green parks define Dubai’s newest self-contained lifestyle hub Sobha Central launches with 1225 new residences in The Horizon, adding to Sobha Realty’s portfolio of luxury residences in Dubai The development features 250,000 sq.
ft.
of lush green parks, 175,000 sq.
of leasable office spaces and 160,000 sq.

of retail spaces including an in-built mall Sobha Realty, the leading global luxury real estate developer has announced the launch of its newest landmark masterplan development in Dubai – Sobha Central on Sheikh Zayed Road.
Envisioned as the next transformative lifestyle hub, Sobha Central will rise as a vertical urban sanctuary with six premium residential towers.
Sobha Central is designed as a self-contained, future-forward address where luxury, lifestyle, and business converge.
It offers a comprehensive mix of world-class amenities, working spaces, entertainment venues, and futuristic retail experiences, truly making it a global hub within itself.

The development launches with 1,225 homes; a curated mix of one and two bedroom residences crafted for those seeking prestige, accessibility, modern amenities, functional design, and exceptional investment.
Commenting on the launch, Mr.
Ravi Menon, Chairman of Sobha Group, said: “Sobha Central is a bold expression of our vision to shape the future of urban living in Dubai.

Strategically located on the most powerful corridor of the Middle East – Sheikh Zayed Road, this development goes beyond architecture to create a self-sustained high living community that blends design, connectivity, and functionality.
Every element reflects our ‘Art of The Detail’ philosophy, an uncompromising commitment to quality and precision.

With Dubai’s real estate market on an upward trajectory, Sobha Central caters to the evolving aspirations of modern homeowners and investors seeking long-term investment value in a vibrant, central location.” Backed by Sobha Realty’s unique Backward Integration Model, the masterplan was unveiled with the first tower slated for delivery December 2029.

At the heart of the development, six towers are seamlessly linked by an elevated circulation path that connects residents to an array of indoor amenities - including the gym, theatre, clubhouse, and more.

This pathway extends to select lift cores, providing direct internal access to a world-class shopping mall, restaurants, supermarkets, and a Grand Hall for the convenience of both the residents and the surrounding community.
The project delivers mixed use versatility with residential, retail, healthcare and office offerings.
The integrated retail podium also delivers a car-free luxury shopping & dining experience right at the residents’ doorsteps.
Outdoors, private themed courtyards are nestled within a lush central park, offering moments of calm, community, and recreation.
Residents will also enjoy over 250,000 sq.
of open space, with sky-level amenities such as landscaped terraces, infinity pools, wellness lounges, and recreational decks- all designed to elevate everyday living.

Strategically located along the spine of Dubai, Sobha Central offers exceptional connectivity to beaches and major destinations nearby like JBR, Dubai Marina, Dubai Internet City, and Dubai Media City — enhancing both lifestyle and investment value.

“ Recent industry reports highlight Marina, JLT and surrounding corridors among Dubai’s most resilient sub-markets, recording rental yields of 7–10% and consistent capital appreciation; positioning Sobha Central as a prime asset for both end-users and investors, ” added Ravi Menon .

In line with Sobha Realty’s commitment to sustainable, forward-thinking development, Sobha Central incorporates eco-smart solutions such as double-glazed façades, energy-efficient HVAC systems, EV charging stations, and advanced district cooling.
The use of locally sourced materials further reduces environmental impact and reinforces the brand’s responsible design ethos.

The two striking towers offer a selection of well-designed apartments.
Mercer House is ideal for those looking for a comfortable and modern home in one of Uptown Dubai’s most sought-after areas.
With its close proximity to key business hubs, restaurants, and entertainment options, Mercer House provides the perfect balance of work and leisure.
Each apartment in Mercer House is thoughtfully crafted with modern interiors, spacious layouts, and floor-to-ceiling windows offering breathtaking views of the surrounding lakes and city skyline.
The development is equipped with world-class amenities such as a 45,000 sq.
ft.

beach club, an array of retail and shopping options, and a multi-sports complex featuring various ball games and sports, to resident-access family and skyline pools, and state-of-the art fitness studios, and spa rooms, ensuring the finest lifestyle for all residents.
Mercer House offers the perfect balance between convenience and leisure, with exclusive access to a scenic sauna and ice room, ideal for relaxation after a workout.
The multi-sports hall includes padel and squash courts, providing residents with a diverse range of sports activities.
For those seeking something different, the sing and dance revolution area, alongside the arcade-themed section, are exciting additional features.

The clubhouse and fitness studio cater to health and wellness enthusiasts, while the rooftop skyline pool provides unparalleled views of the city, creating an oasis of serenity amidst the bustling urban landscape.

A residence designed around human performance and longevity.
KORE draws its name from the word core.
The body’s centre of strength and stability and the foundation of movement and well-being.
It is not simply a residence with a gym.
It is a residence designed around three pillars: TRAIN, NOURISH, RECOVER.
Through intelligent fitness technology, nutrition-focused living and advanced recovery experiences, KORE helps residents to live with greater energy, balance and focus.
KORE completes a neighbourhood that was already moving towards healthier, more connected living.
Set in Dubailand, the residence sits among landscaped walkways and cycling routes, with Downtown Dubai just 20 minutes away.
Less time commuting means more time for what matters: training, recovery and a community to share it with.

A pool, jacuzzi, fire pit, and indoor lounges provide the perfect setting for connection and relaxation.

Condominio Marea Jacó nace en una ubicación estratégica, combinando cercanía al mar, conectividad inmediata con la GAM y una propuesta moderna diseñada para maximizar plusvalía y demanda de alquiler.
El proyecto ofrece apartamentos de 1 y 2 habitaciones, ideales tanto para inversión en alquiler vacacional como para quienes buscan un estilo de vida cerca del océano.
Su diseño contemporáneo, facilidad de acceso y formato “lock & leave” lo convierten en una opción inteligente para generar ingresos pasivos con bajo mantenimiento y alta seguridad.

Más que un condominio: una inversión inteligente frente al mar Marea Jacó eleva la experiencia residencial con amenidades tipo resort: piscinas y casas club privadas, sky deck con vistas panorámicas, fire pits, gimnasio de última generación, cancha de pádel y más de 25.000 m² de áreas verdes.
Todo pensado para atraer al inquilino y comprador más exigente, y sostener una rentabilidad constante.
Vivir o invertir en Marea Jacó es apostar por un estilo de vida activo, vibrante y rentable.
Surf, gastronomía, vida social, naturaleza y servicios urbanos se integran en un solo destino.
Una inversión sólida hoy, en una ubicación que seguirá creciendo mañana.

1980 yılında kurulan Emlak Planlama İnşaat Proje Yönetimi ve Ticaret A.Ş.

(EPP), geniş yelpazede sunduğu proje yönetimi, kontrollük, müşavirlik, gayrimenkul pazarlaması, mühendislik, müteahhitlik, işletmecilik ve ticari hizmetleriyle Türkiye’nin öncü firmalarından biridir.

Emlak Konut GYO’nun 2018 yılından itibaren tek pay sahibi olduğu EPP, tek bir sözleşme kapsamında 20.000’den fazla konutun yapımında danışmanlık (müşavirlik) hizmetini üstlenen Türkiye’deki tek firmadır.

Tek bir sözleşme kapsamında kontrolünü gerçekleştiği konut projelerine ilave olarak hastaneler, okullar, camiler, emniyet binası, vergi dairesi, askeri binalar, üniversite, arşiv sitesi, kentsel dönüşüm uygulamaları ve genel altyapı işlerinin de kontrol ve denetimini yapmıştır.
75.000 adetten fazla konut üretimi gerçekleştirerek Türkiye’nin konut üretimi alanında önde gelen firmalarından biri olmuştur.
Yüksek kalite standartlarına bağlı kalarak Türkiye’nin en büyük konut projelerine katkı sağlamaya devam etmektedir.

1992’den bu yana, tüm projelerinde global tasarım standartlarını, bölgesel faktörleri, modern tasarım trendlerini kullanarak estetik ve fonksiyonelliği bir araya getiren ŞUA İnşaat, güçlü finansal yapısı ve köklü geçmişiyle geleceğe yön veriyor.

Kalite ve yenilikçilik anlayışından ödün vermeden binlerce konut ve ticari ünitenin altına imzasını atan ŞUA İnşaat, sadece mimari ve tasarım alanında yapılar inşa etmekle kalmıyor, yaşam tarzlarını da şekillendiren özgün ve doğa dostu projeleriyle gelecek nesillere sürdürülebilir yapılar miras bırakıyor ve kent mimarisine değer katmaya devam ediyor.

ŞUA İnşaat tüm projelerinde global tasarım standartlarını, bölgesel faktörleri, modern tasarım trendlerini kullanarak konut tasarımına yön veren özgün proje tasarımları oluşturmayı ilke edinmiş ve bu sayede beğeni toplamıştır.

How far is Saraya from Bali?
Saraya Beach Resort is just a 30-minute flight from Bali.
Fly from Bali's Ngurah Rai airport to Lombok International Airport, then take a scenic 90-minute drive to Sekotong.
Fast ferries from Bali's southern coast are also available.
Is Lombok better than Bali for property investment?
Lombok offers significantly lower entry prices — beachfront villas in Sekotong start from A$249,000, while comparable properties in Bali's Seminyak or Canggu typically sell for 3–5× more.
With Indonesia's government investing heavily in Lombok infrastructure through the Mandalika Special Economic Zone, the island is positioned as the next major destination.
How do I get to Sekotong from Seminyak?
From Seminyak, take a 30-minute domestic flight from Ngurah Rai airport to Lombok International Airport, or catch a fast ferry from Padang Bai or Serangan harbour.
From Lombok airport, Sekotong is approximately 90 minutes by car along a scenic coastal road.
